Louis Tomlinson, a member of One Direction and lifelong supporter of Doncaster Rovers, is reportedly in advanced negotiations to purchase the football club. Tomlinson, 22, who was born in Doncaster and has previously played for the club’s reserve team, is working with businessman and former club chairman John Ryan on the potential deal. If successful, the pair would act as co-chairmen, aiming to return the club to the Championship within a year, with hopes of reaching the Premiership within three years.

The purchase discussions are reportedly at an advanced stage, but Tomlinson is said to be concerned that recent controversy could impact the deal. Recently, footage emerged showing Tomlinson and fellow band member Zayn Malik allegedly smoking cannabis and using inappropriate language while in Peru. Neither Tomlinson nor Malik has publicly addressed the incident.

The video has resulted in backlash from fans, politicians, and anti-racism organizations, with calls for an apology from the band. Tomlinson’s father, Troy Austin, has also expressed worry, saying that fame has changed his son. Despite the controversy, Tomlinson remains committed to acquiring his hometown club and has described it as his passion project.

If the takeover succeeds, Tomlinson would become the first pop star to chair an English football club since Elton John led Watford. Supporters hope that Tomlinson’s global profile will attract new investors and fans to Doncaster Rovers. His appearance for the club's reserve team previously brought an additional 2,000 supporters to the stadium.

The band has largely remained silent about the incident. During a recent concert in Sunderland, member Liam Payne joked about wanting less media attention, but no formal apology was issued. Reports suggest that the controversy may have strained relationships within the group, with members Harry Styles and Niall Horan reportedly distancing themselves from Tomlinson and Malik's behavior.

article_content: Apple is preparing to unveil its latest device, the iPad Mini, at a San Jose event at 6pm. The compact tablet is designed to rival lower-cost competitors such as Amazon's Kindle Fire and Google's Nexus 7. Featuring a rumored 7.8-inch display, the iPad Mini is more portable compared to the larger, original iPad, making it convenient for travel and easy to carry. Although it may forgo the retina display found in newer iPhones and iPads, reports indicate it will utilize a 1024 x 768 pixel screen. The iPad Mini is also expected to incorporate Apple's newer Lightning connector, requiring adapters for older accessories. The device’s expected price is approximately £200—higher than the Amazon Kindle Fire’s £129, but less than the full-size iPad. Analysts project that Apple could sell five million iPad Minis this December, though this might reduce standard iPad sales. To reinforce its market presence as competition stiffens, Apple has allegedly ordered 10 million units from suppliers. Photos and leaks circulating online show a visibly smaller device compared to earlier iPads. Competitors are ramping up activity: Amazon is expanding its Kindle Fire availability internationally, while Microsoft prepares to launch its Surface tablets. Research shows more than 20% of consumers now use tablets, with affordable models reducing Apple’s dominance. A Pew Research Center report revealed Apple’s tablet market share has fallen from over 80% to around 52% in the last year, as Amazon’s and Samsung’s devices capture more buyers. The abundance of budget tablets poses increasing challenges for Apple. Interestingly, Steve Jobs, Apple’s former CEO, was famously skeptical of smaller tablets, but consumer interest in compact devices appears to have shifted the company’s approach.

article_content: Early in my venture capital career, I encountered a statistic about women in the industry that stood out to me. Media often reported that 11% of people in venture capital were women, but that number seemed exaggerated. In practice, I found it hard to gather enough women investors for even a small industry lunch. When I examined the data and focused specifically on women who actually served on investment boards, not those in marketing, operations, or finance, the real percentage was closer to 3.5%. Fifteen years later, little has changed. Today, just 2.4% of U.S.-based VC partners who are women are founding partners—positions with genuine decision-making influence. As a founding partner myself, I see how rare this is and how it affects gender diversity among funded startup founders. According to Pitchbook, in 2022, startups in the U.S. founded exclusively by women attracted only 2.1% of total venture funding. For comparison, companies with at least one female co-founder received 16.5% of the funding; the rest went to companies with all-male founding teams. Throughout my career, I’ve worked to address this gap, even while being told that being a woman in venture capital didn’t necessarily qualify as diversity. This week, Governor Newsom signed California’s Senate Bill 54 (SB 54) into law, mandating that nearly all venture capital firms connected to California must gather and report founder diversity metrics. While well intentioned, I doubt this will truly solve the problem. In my experience, meaningful impact comes from the ground up—especially by encouraging more young women to enter and remain in STEM fields. As the first in my family to go to college, I nearly quit at times, but support from professors and supervisors helped me persevere. Now, I mentor young women, offering advice and motivation, much like mentors once did for me. My concern is that SB 54 may allow firms to meet surface-level requirements without creating real change. Reporting mandates can distort incentives, enabling larger firms with more resources to comply while potentially manipulating statistics. Since reporting is based on the percentage of founders instead of investment dollars, firms might improve their diversity figures by making small investments in new, diverse founders but concentrating most funding elsewhere. Comparing VC diversity data may highlight some trends, but using checklists can weaken the effort of those doing the deeper, more difficult work—like fortifying the STEM pipeline for underrepresented groups. Organizations truly investing in long-term solutions could have their efforts overshadowed by numeric comparisons to larger firms. I urge prospective partners—founders, limited partners, and employees—to consider a firm’s actions, not just metrics. At Canvas Ventures, we've prioritized diversity since our inception. In our upcoming Annual Meeting, we’ll report that 56% of our active portfolio companies have a diverse founder or CEO, and 21% feature a female founder or CEO. But these are just numbers, not the finish line. There’s much work ahead. Real, lasting change comes from mentoring young people and encouraging them into STEM, just as mentors did for me. It involves studying and improving the pipeline from early to higher education for women and people of color—efforts not directly addressed by after-the-fact diversity metrics. VC firms must offer early, tangible support—funding, mentorship, and connections—well before entrepreneurs enter the pitch room. At Canvas Ventures, we’re committed to methodically finding outstanding, diverse founders and strengthening the pathway for future leaders. Our progress and insights will continue to be shared with the wider industry, our partners, and now, the State of California.

Yommuu qabiyyee qoradhu, inni dhugaa board irratti tajaajilan qofa irratti xiyyeefachuun harki isaanii 3.5% akka ta’e arge. Waggaa kudha shan booda, jijjiirama xiqqoon jiru. Akka Pitchbook ibsutti, bara 2022 keessatti, dhaabbileen dubartoota qofaan hundaa’anii US keessatti, qabeenya venture invest harka 2.1% qofa argatan. Kareerii kiyya keessatti, garaagarummaa kana irranfuuuf hojjechaa ture, yeroo baay’ee garuu, 'dubartiin venture capital keessa jirtu garaagarummaa miti' jedhamee hin fudhatamne. Torban kana, Gavaanaar Newsom SB 54 (Senate Bill 54) mallatteessan, shororkeessumma venture capital kamiyyuu kan Kaaliiforniyaa waliin wal qabatu akka gabaasa gurmuulee hundeessitootaa dhiheessu barbaada. Kaayyoo gaarii qabaatus, rakkoo furuun isaa sirrii miti jechuunan amana. Waan ani muuxannoo qabu irraa, jijjiirama barbaachisu foundatiota (from the ground up) irraa uumama—dubartoota hedduu STEM keessa galchu fi turuuf jajjabeessun murteessa. Amma immoo, ana keessatti gorsa fi jajjabina dargaggoota dubartootaaf kennuudhaaf carraa qabuudha. Yaaddoo kiyya, seerri SB 54 firmoota hedduu caalaatti qajeelfamaa bituuf mijatee jira soorata jijjiiramaa fida hin danda’u. Qajeelfamni gabaasaa yeroo qabatamaan jijjiirama fiduu dhiisuu hubachuun sirriidha. (Sadarkaa gurmuulee irratti, harki gurmuulee hundeessitootaa qofa irratti, qarshiin keessaa jallachuu danda’a). Gariin isaanii garaagarummaa data isaanii mirkaneessuuf deggersa xiqqoo gara gurmuulee garaagaraatti raabsuu ni danda’u. Gabaasni venture capital sadarkaa qabiyyee dudduuba jiru agarsiisu danda’a, garuu qajeelfamni checklisti ta’ee hojiilee yeroo dheeraf hojjetaman miidha. Gareen qajeelfama dhugoomsuuf fedha qabu ka'umsi isaanii bifa ormaa dha. Kanaaf, waliigalatti, abbootii hojii, hirmaattota, fi hojjattoota garee, hojiiwwan qabiyyee ilaaluun barbaachisaadha. Kaampanii Canvas Ventures jalqabaarraa garaagarummaa irratti fuulleffatteetti. Guyyaa wal ga'insa bara dhufu, 56% portfolio keenya keessatti hundeessitoonni/Jalqaba CEO garaagaraa akka jiran, 21% ammoo dubartoota co-founder ykn CEO ta’an akka jiran gabaafna. Garuu, kun lakkoobsa qofa; hanga ammaatti hojii keenya itti fufna. Jijjiiramaan dhugaa dargaggoota jajjabeessuu fi STEM keessatti akuma anaaf godhameen, isaanis waliin taasisuu irraa ni dhufa. Haa ta’u malee, pipeline barnoota jalqabaa hanga gara olaanaatti geessu keessatti dubartootaa fi namoota bifa garaagaraa qaban jajjabeessuu barbaachisa. Hojiin kun gabaasaa diversity booda qofa fayyada miti. Venture capital’n deeggarsa, beekkomsa fi hariiroo isaanii yeroo jalqabaa duree, gurusni isaanii gara bulchiinsaatti dhufan dura kennuu qabu. Canvas Ventures keessatti gareewwan garaagaraa barbaaduun, pipeline cimsuun fi odeeffannoo keenya hirmaattotatti fi mootummaa Kaaliifoorniyaaf qooduun itti fufna.

article_content: Former Manchester City defender Benjamin Mendy has filed a multi-million-pound lawsuit against the club at an employment tribunal, alleging Manchester City unlawfully stopped paying his wages while he faced criminal charges. According to Sky Sports, Mendy, 29, who now plays for French club Lorient, claims the club ceased his salary in September 2021 after he was accused of rape and sexual assault. This year, Mendy was acquitted of all charges in two separate trials. His lawyer, Nick De Marco KC, confirmed legal action has been taken to recover all unpaid wages up to the end of his contract in June 2023. The claim alleges that Manchester City withheld pay for almost two years while the legal proceedings were ongoing. Mendy joined Manchester City from Monaco in 2017 for £52 million, making him the most expensive defender in the world at the time. He won three Premier League titles with the club but last played in August 2021, just before his arrest. A statement from Mendy’s legal team says that he was paid nothing over a period of 21 months until his deal ended, despite being cleared of all charges, and argues the club had no contractual right to impose such a lengthy wage suspension. "Nick De Marco KC (instructed by Laffer Abogados, Madrid) is acting for former Manchester City player Benjamin Mendy in a multi-million-pound claim for unauthorized deductions from wages. Manchester City FC failed to pay Mr. Mendy any wages at all from September 2021, following Mr. Mendy being charged with various offenses, all of which he was subsequently acquitted of, until the end of his contract in June 2023. The claim will come before an Employment Tribunal," the statement reads. As of the time of this report, Manchester City has not commented on the lawsuit.

Mendy bara 2017 Monaco irraa Manchester City’tiin paawundi miliyoona 52’n bitame, yeroo sanatti eegdota addunyaa keessaa guddicha ta'ee, injifannoo Premier League sadii argate. article_content: London (CNN) -- The red carpet is fashion's biggest stage, where stars gather to be seen as much for their clothing as their celebrity. For Livia Firth, wife of Academy Award-winning actor Colin Firth, the material you wear is becoming just as important as who you are. Now in its third year, the Green Carpet Challenge was launched to encourage leading designers to dress celebrities in clothing that is both environmentally friendly and socially responsible. "First of all, you want to wear something made with non-toxic materials and dyes, and created by people working under good conditions," Firth says. She has worn outfits made from recycled plastic bottles to the Golden Globes, sourced materials from repurposed thrift store finds for the Oscars, and even donned discarded fabric for an event with Queen Elizabeth II. Firth is encouraging well-known figures in film and fashion such as designer and director Tom Ford, Hollywood legend Meryl Streep, and rising actor Michael Fassbender to participate in the movement. "A designer will create a gown for an actress anyway, so we work with them to switch the fabric to eco-friendly options," Firth explains. One of Firth's own 'green carpet' highlights was an emerald green gown crafted from upcycled fabric by British designer Henrietta Ludgate, who produces her designs in a small London workshop/showroom. "We source from mills in Scotland and England, upcycle fabrics, and produce everything locally—so there are zero clothing miles," Ludgate states. Overseeing each production step, Ludgate believes this process leads to a higher quality product, though perhaps not higher profits. "People often buy for design, not sustainability. But when they learn about sustainability, I hope they choose to buy more," she says. Fashion journalist Lucy Siegle, who co-founded the Green Carpet Challenge with Firth in 2009, wants people to consider reusing existing clothes and exploring new materials. "Mainstream fashion often talks about innovation as simply the latest look worn by celebrities," Siegle notes. "Ironically, we're working with celebrities, but the focus is on unique techniques, tailoring, heritage fabrics, and the story behind each piece." Firth is hopeful the trend will grow. "Next year, we hope to have a dedicated lane at the Oscars for Green Carpet Challenge participants," Firth says.
translated_content: London (CNN) -- Kutaan diimaa jechuun bakka faashinii guddichaati, iddoo beektotni uffata isaanii muul’isan. Livia Firth, haadha warraa aktara beekamaa Colin Firth, uffatni biyya irraa hojjetame akka barbaachisaa ta’u amantaa qabdi. Amma waggaa sadaffaa keessaatti, Green Carpet Challenge’n jalqabamee, dizaayineroota gurguddaa akka nama beektota uffata naannoo fi hawaasaaf gaarii ta’e uffataniif kakaasuuf qophaa’e. "Jalqaba irratti, wanti summii hin qabne fi meeshaan isaa namoota gammachuu qabaniin hojjetame uffachuun barbaachisaa dha," jette Firth. Isheen uffata recycled plastic bottles irraa hojjetame Golden Globes irratti uffatte, kaan immoo thrift store irraa argametti Oscars irratti, akkasumas faaya darbamaa waliin Queen Elizabeth II waliin turteetti. Firth nama faashinii fi filmii filmii keessa beekamoo akka Tom Ford, Meryl Streep fi Michael Fassbender hirmaachisuuf yaalaa jirti. "Designer tokko uffata aktaraaf ni tolcha, kanaaf nuti isaan waliin taanee meeshaa gara kan ekootti jijjiirra," jette Firth. Uffata emeraalda magariisaa isa British designer Henrietta Ludgate, kan mana hojichaa xiqqoo London keessa jiru, irraa hojjetamee ‘green carpet’ keessaa tokko ta’e. "Meeshaalee Scotland fi England irraa arganna, ni upcycle godhanna, hunda bakka tokkotti oomisha – fageenyi uffata jiraachuu baatus," jette Ludgate. Hojii irraa jalqabee hanga xumuraatti hordofuudhaan, Ludgate oomishni isaa sadarkaa olaanaa akka ta’u amana, baay’inni gatiin ol hinta’us. "Namoonni hedduun design irraa bitu, garuu fayyadamummaa yoo beekan, bitachuu akka danda'an abdiin qaba," jette. Barsiiftuu fi barreessitu faashinii Lucy Siegle, kan Green Carpet Challenge waliin Firth bara 2009 jalqabde, namoonni uffata duraan jiru fayyadamuun fi meeshaa haaraa qorachuu akka danda’an barbaaddi. "Faashinii ammayyaa keessa innooveshinii jechuun haala haarawaa nama beektota irraa argamu jechuu dha," jette Siegle. "Ironically, beektota waliin hojjachaa jirra, garuu xiyyeeffannaan mala ammayyaa, qorannoo, meeshaa aadaa fi seenaa uffataa irratti argama," jette. Firth iddoon kun akka babal’atu abdii qabdi. "Waggaa dhufuu, Oscars irratti karaa addaa Green Carpet Challenge hirmaatotaaf ni taasisna," jette Firth.

article_content: The Confederation of African Football (CAF) has released a shortlist of 30 footballers for the 2023 Men's African Player of the Year award. This list includes prominent players such as Victor Osimhen from Nigeria and Mohamed Salah from Egypt. The awards are scheduled to take place on December 11, 2023, in Marrakech, Morocco. CAF explained that the nominees were selected by a panel including technical experts, African football legends, and media representatives based across Africa. The selection was based on player performances from November 2022 to September 2023. Alongside the main men's award, CAF will honor recipients in other categories: Interclub Player of the Year, Coach of the Year, National Team of the Year, Club of the Year, and Young Player of the Year (for players under 21), each with their own nominees. Notably, this year marks the introduction of the African Goalkeeper of the Year category for both men and women, recognizing the efforts of goalkeepers with ten nominees for the debut award. Award winners will be determined by votes from a panel comprised of the CAF Technical Committee, media professionals, and the head coaches and captains of member associations and clubs involved in the interclub group stages. CAF also mentioned that the nominees for the women’s categories will be announced soon. At the last CAF Awards in July 2022, Senegal’s Sadio Mane received the Men’s Player of the Year prize, and Nigeria’s Asisat Oshoala secured her record fifth Women’s Player of the Year title. The full alphabetized list of men’s Player of the Year nominees follows as published by CAF.

Bakka bu’oota beekamoo keessaa: Victor Osimhen (Najeeriyaa) fi Mohamed Salah (Ijiptii) ni argamu. Sagantaan badhaasaa kun Muddee 11, 2023, Marrakech, Mooraakoo keessatti geggeeffama. article_content: Falling asleep with the TV on in bed is becoming less common, as more people now use their tablets or smartphones for late-night video watching. According to a new survey from Motorola Mobility, 9,500 people across 17 countries reported significant changes in how and where they watch videos. The results show that 46% of respondents have watched videos on their smartphones in the master bedroom, while 41% have done so on tablets. By comparison, just 36% still use a TV in bed. The study, part of Motorola's fourth annual Media Engagement Barometer, highlights that consumers increasingly want flexibility and control over how they view their content. John Burke, a senior vice president and general manager at Motorola Mobility, noted that people desire seamless transitions across their devices, enabling them to enjoy shows and movies anytime and anywhere. For instance, one in ten people said they watch mobile video in the kitchen. The survey also found that weekly TV viewing has nearly doubled over two years—from 10 hours in 2011 to 19 hours this year. Adding five to six hours spent watching movies, many spend more than a full day per week in front of screens. Americans lead this trend, reporting an average of 23 hours of TV and six hours of movies per week. Recording TV is increasingly popular, with 29% of all TV watched via DVR. Most respondents use DVRs to watch other programs that air at the same time (77%), save favorite shows (72%), or skip commercials (68% overall, rising to 74% in the U.S. and 75% in the U.K.). These commercial-skipping features have sparked legal battles. Last year, TV networks such as Fox, NBC, and CBS sued Dish Network over its AdHop feature that lets users automatically skip commercials. Networks argue that ad-skipping could undermine funding for programs, while Dish Network maintains viewers have always found ways to avoid ads.

Qorannoo haaraan Motorola Mobility'n namoota 9,500 biyyoota 17 keessa jiran irratti gaggeeffame, garaagarummaa akkaataa fi iddoo viidiyoo itti daawwatamu agarsiisa. %46n isaanii viidiyoo smartphonen ciisichatti daawwataniiru, %41n ammo tablet irratti. Kan waliin walbira qabu ammo, %36 qofatu amma TV ciisichatti itti fayyadama. Barreeffamni kana Motorola Media Engagement Barometer bara afraffaa keessaa ba'e, uummanni bilisummaa fi to'annoo akkaataa fi iddoo viidiyoo isaa daawwachuuf qabu akka barbaadu mul'isa. John Burke, Itti aanaa Pireezidaantii fi Bulchaa Olaanaa Motorola Mobility, akka jedhetti namoonni daawwan isaanii gara meeshaa gara garaatti sochoosuu (seamless transition) akka barbaadan ibsan, kunis isaan yeroo fi iddoo barbaadanitti taphaalee fi fiilmii isaanii akka daaw’atan isaan gargaara. Fakkeenyaaf, namoota keessaa tokko keessaa kudhaniin tokko viidiyoo mobayiliin mana nyaataa keessatti daaw'achuu isaanii dubbataniiru. Qorannichi ni agarsiisa akka sa'aatii TV dhaabbataa daawwachuun torbanitti isaa dhufaa dhufaatti dacha'ee jira – bara 2011 keessati sa'aatii 10 ture, amma garuu sa'aatii 19 gaheera. Sa'aatii shanii hanga jaha filmii daawwachuu isaani illee yoo dabalame, baay’een torban tokko keessatti guyyaa guutuu ol saree ekraanitti maxxanfamani jiru. Ameerikaan gama kanaan dura, TV sa'aatii 23 fi filmii sa'aatii 6 torbanitti daawwata. Sagantaalee TV galmeessuun ammo baay'attee jira; TV'n %29 DVR’n galmaa’ee daawwatama. Deebii kennaniin, namoonni DVR fayyadamanii yeroo sagantaa biraa daawwachuuf (%77), taphaalee isaanii galchachuuf (%72), ykn beeksisaa darbuu (%68; US keessatti %74, UK keessattis %75) jedhu. Amalawwan kun falmii seeraa kaasaa jiru. Bara darbe, dhaabbileen TV Fox, NBC, fi CBS Dish Network irratti waan AdHop jedhamuuf himata barreessan, kunis viidiyoo galmaa'ee beeksisaa darbusu oola. Dhaabbileen TV’n kun beeksisaa darbuu galii sagantaaleef miidha jedhan, Dish Network immoo namoonni waggaa TV jalqabee as beeksisaa darbuu akka turan jedhu.

article_content: Giovanni Carlucci, a 12-year-old boy from southern Italy, tragically died after being struck by lightning while on holiday with his family at Campomarino di Maruggio in the Puglia region. Known affectionately as 'Harry Potter' because of his metal-rimmed glasses, Giovanni was playing football with his father on the beach when a sudden storm struck on Monday afternoon. Despite no prior warning or rain, a lightning bolt hit Giovanni, possibly attracted by the metal in his spectacles. He suffered cardiac arrest instantly. A retired doctor at the scene tried to resuscitate him, but was unsuccessful. Giovanni’s 14-year-old cousin, Piergiorgio, was also struck but survived. He is recovering in hospital from minor burns and shock. Witnesses described Giovanni's father desperately attempting to help his son, who was only meters away from him. The father was later hospitalized in a state of shock. Giovanni's hometown of Altamura, near Bari, has declared a day of public mourning. Mayor Mario Stacca stated that the town shares 'the most profound sense of loss for the absurd death of little Giovanni Carlucci,' noting that words are insufficient to express the tragedy that has befallen his family. This incident occurred as Italy continues to experience unseasonal storms, which have led to flooding and the closure of a Metro station in Rome.

Giovanni, maqaa 'Harry Potter' jedhuun waan xiyya warqii qabuufi waamamu, guyyaa Wixata galgala yeroo abbaa isaa waliin kubbaa miilaa tapha taphataa turetti, ganna cimaa cimaa tokko dhufe. Roobaa yookaan mallattoo gannaa duraan hin turre; urjii magariisa Giovanni simate, kan akka warqii xiyya isaa jalaa ga'u himameera. Akka tasaa onneen isaa dhaabbate. Ogeessi fayyaa hundee ykn yeroo boqonnaa argatu tokko achi ture, lubbuun isaa deebisuuf yaale, garuu hin milkoofne. Obboleessa isaa waggaa 14, Piergiorgio, illee adamsameera, garuu lubbuun isaa bade hin qabu. Hospitaalatti miidhaa salphaa fi naasa eegalaa irraa fayyaa argachaa jira. Namoonni argan haalli Giovanni itti du'e abbaa isaa dirqamatti gargaaruuf yaaluu fi waliin argamuu dubbatu. Abbaa isaatis miira gadda cimaadhaan hospitaala geeffame. Magaalaa Giovanni dhalootaa Altamura, Bari irraa gara dhiyaatti argamtu, guyyaa gadda uumattee beeksiste. Maayorii Mario Stacca akka jedhetti, magaalachuun 'miira gadda ciccimoo fi dhabamuu mucaa Giovanni Carlucci bakkaan ga'u' ibse, jechoonni gadda maatii isaatiif gahaa hin taane. Dhimmichi kun biyya Itophiyaa keessatti yeroo kana ganna cimaa fi roobaa haala hin eegamne, burkeessaaha fi dhaabbata baaburaa Roma cufee jiru irratti dhufe.

article_content: Happy birthday, Harry Potter! On July 31, the Boy Who Lived turns 33 years old—according to the Harry Potter book timeline. He is likely enjoying a calm day with Ginny, James Sirius, Albus Severus, and Lily Luna, appreciating family life now that his days aren't dominated by conflict. With his children not attending Hogwarts yet, Harry's life is much more peaceful without the shadow of dark wizards looming over him. It's clear why J.K. Rowling's stories focus on his adventurous teenage years instead of a quiet adulthood (though fans would undoubtedly read it if it existed). Looking back, Harry's post-Voldemort life is relatively straightforward compared to his challenging Hogwarts years—filled with trials, dangers, and heroic moments spanning over 4,000 pages. While defeating Voldemort is legendary, Harry’s smaller, impactful actions deserve celebration too. To honor Harry’s 33rd birthday, here are 33 memorable examples of his courage and kindness beyond simply defeating the Dark Lord: 1. Sharing snacks with friends on the Hogwarts Express earned Harry a reputation for generosity. 2. At 12, he freed Dobby from servitude, showing empathy and initiative. 3. Pretending to give Ron Felix Felicis to boost his confidence was an act of thoughtful friendship. 4. Making peace with Dudley in 'Deathly Hallows' was a touching moment, even though it wasn't in the films. 5. Showing kindness by inviting Luna Lovegood to Professor Slughorn's party. 6. Helping Luna search for her missing shoes—likely lost to Nargles or pranksters. 7. Supporting Nearly Headless Nick by attending his Deathday Party, even if reluctantly. 8. Ensuring Cedric Diggory’s body was returned to his parents after tragedy. 9. Acting as secretary for S.P.E.W., supporting Hermione’s activism. 10. Burying Dobby without magic, as a sign of respect and mourning. 11. Founding and leading Dumbledore’s Army to train his classmates. 12. Facing danger yearly, but constantly risking himself for others’ safety. 13. Showing mercy by sparing Peter Pettigrew’s life, staying true to his values. 14. Welcoming Ron back after a fallout, showing true forgiveness. 15. Empathizing with Snape after understanding his story. 16. Using Parseltongue as a child to confound the Dursleys. 17. His iconic line: “I don't go looking for trouble. Trouble usually finds me.” 18. Saving Neville’s Remembrall, uncovering his flying talent. 19. Donating his Triwizard Tournament prize to the Weasley twins. 20. Witty retorts like, “No need to call me Sir, professor.” 21. Using the Marauder's Map to explore Hogsmeade despite rules. 22. Casting the Patronus that saved Sirius Black, thinking his father had done it. 23. Warning Cedric about the dragons in 'Goblet of Fire' as an act of fairness. 24. Kissing Ginny during the Quidditch Cup celebration, prioritizing happiness. 25. Standing up to Scrimgeour and defending Stan Shunpike. 26. Urging Remus Lupin to remain with his family, highlighting responsibility. 27. Teenage romance with Ginny, celebrating normal moments amid chaos. 28. Saving Hermione from the mountain troll at only 11 years old. 29. Using humor to cope, like wondering what a difficult life would be like. 30. Remaining kind to Neville Longbottom throughout school. 31. Snarky comments about Professor Quirrell’s connection to Voldemort. 32. Rescuing Gabrielle Delacour in the Triwizard Tournament lake challenge. 33. Growing up to marry Ginny and raise a family—'all was well.' Fun fact: July 31 is also J.K. Rowling’s birthday. Original story available at EW.com.

article_content: Frank Miles, a 69-year-old retired civil servant from Magor, South Wales, was left waiting in the rain for over three hours after fracturing his kneecap in a fall outside the Waterloo Hotel in Pill, Newport. Miles slipped on rain-soaked decking while leaving a Rotary Club meeting, rendering him unable to move due to pain and risk of further injury. Passersby, Rotary Club members, and hotel staff sheltered Miles with umbrellas, covered him in blankets, elevated his head with a pillow, and supported his injured leg with a cardboard box. Concerned citizens dialed 999 six times seeking help, but were told ambulances were busy responding to more urgent emergencies. On one occasion, a call was cut short so the operator could answer another emergency. After more than three hours, a rapid response vehicle arrived, and the attending paramedic apologized for the delay. Miles was then transported to hospital by ambulance fifteen minutes later. Witnesses, including Bob Evans, owner of the Waterloo Hotel, expressed frustration about the lengthy wait and the risks involved in moving Miles themselves. Dr. Malcolm Bright, a former GP who made two emergency calls, criticized the system as in need of improvement. A spokeswoman for the Welsh Ambulance Service acknowledged the prolonged response time, attributed it to a period of high call volume, and stated that the service would investigate the incident further, inviting the patient or his family to contact them with concerns.

Miles yeroo walgahii Rotary Club keessaa bahaa turetti, riqicha jiidha bokkaan irra jiru irratti kufe; miilaa isaa cabee, dhiphinaaf hammaataa fi balaa dabalataa sodaachuun yaalu hin dandeenye. Namoonni karaa darbu, miseensonni Rotary Club fi hojjettoonni hoteelaa Frank Miles bokkaatti eeganii, bukkattaniif, mataa isaa bifa baay’ee quufaa ta’een irratti ol kaa’anii fi miilaa isaa caccabee kartonaa irra kaa’an. Yeroo tokko waa’ee hatattamaa ilaaluuf, waamichi silaa godhamu danda’u itti cituu danda’e. Eega sa’aatii sadii olii booda, mootummaan deeggarsa hatattamaa geesse, paraamedikiin as ga’ee dhiifama gaafate. Fifteen daqiiqaa booda, Miles gara hospitaalaatti ambulaansii irratti deemsifame. Namoota argan keessa Bob Evans, abbaa Waterloo Hotel, turtii dheeraa fi balaa ofiin of sosso’an irratti mufii qaban himan. Dr. Malcolm Bright, ogeessa fayyaa kan waamicha lama godhe, sirni kun fooyya’iinsa barbaachisaa ta’uu hime. Dubartiin Welsh Ambulance Service bakka bu’uu akka turtii gabaabaa hin kennamne fi yaada qaban akka isaan quunnaman waamicha dhiyeesse; baay’ina waamicha irratti dhiibbaa jiraachuu beeksise.

article_content: This season's AP Top 25 college football poll has seen little change, with only 42 teams making the rankings as of now—Toledo being the latest at No. 23. This number is lower than the usual yearly average of around 50 teams. With just three more polls left, matching previous seasons' diversity in ranked teams isn't likely. At the top, Georgia holds firm at No. 1, Ohio State has advanced to No. 2, overshadowing Michigan at No. 3, while Washington now sits at No. 4, ahead of Florida State. The top eight have largely stayed the same for about a month. The poll has been described as 'chalky'—meaning stable and predictable—with few teams moving significantly. However, teams like SMU, UNLV, and North Carolina State are on the brink of joining the rankings if they finish strong. Players in the spotlight include Georgia quarterback Carson Beck, who could enter the top-10 for the Heisman with strong performances, and Ohio State’s running back TreVeyon Henderson, leading the Big Ten in rushing despite earlier injuries. Michigan's offense struggled without wide receiver Roman Wilson, particularly in passing against Maryland. Washington continues to win even when their quarterback Michael Penix Jr. isn't performing at his best, and Florida State shifts to quarterback Tate Rodemaker after Jordan Travis's injury. Oregon's Brandon Dorlus stands out in defense, while Texas remains dominant against the run. Additional highlights include Alabama’s Jermaine Burton’s 100-yard receiving games, Louisville's effective running back tandem of Isaac Guerendo and Jawhar Jordan, and a strong Missouri defense led by Darius Robinson. Penn State's evolving QB situation, the impact of new faces at Oklahoma, and LSU’s Jayden Daniels’ near record-breaking contributions are also noted. There's debate over certain teams being ranked slightly too high or low—Arizona’s improved run defense and Notre Dame’s consistent pass defense are among those getting positive recognition. Tulane is nearing consecutive AAC title games, and Liberty leads in interceptions. As the season nears its end, the AP Top 25 continues to be marked by few surprises and reliable performances from its leading teams, with only a few potential entrants depending on results in final matchups.

Kun waggoota darban kanneen laaluun gareewwan sadarkaatti ramadaman baay’ina isaanii xiqqeesseera. Sadii qofatu hafee, gareewwan dabalataa galma gahuuf carraa xiqqoo qabu. Gareen Georgia No.1 irra jirtu haala wal fakkaatuun, Ohio State bakka lammaffaa gale; Michigan bakka sadaffaa, Washington No.4 gara fuulduraa cehe, Florida State ammoo duubatti deeme. Gareewwan sadarkaalee olii kanneen guyyoota afur darbaniif bakkee isaanii hin jijjiiramin turan. Rankiin 'chalky' jechuun jijjiirama xiqqaa fi tasgabii argisiisu. Michigan taphattoota isaa keessaa WR Roman Wilson dhabee dadhabbiin taphii darbe keessatti mul’ate, addatti Maryland waliin waliin taphatetti. Washington injifannoo isaanii itti fufan kan Marsaa QB Michael Penix Jr. taphni isaa caalaa hin ta’inillee. Florida State QB ishee haarawa Tate Rodemaker fayyadamuuf qophaa’aa jirti booda rakkoo Jordan Travis irra gahuushee. Oregon keessatti, Brandon Dorlus taphataa ittisa cimaa ta’uu mul’ise, Texas ammoo ittisa jabaa agarsiisaa jira. Dabalataan, Alabama irraa Jermaine Burton tapha galaana 100 irratti galmeessisan, Louisville irraa RB Isaac Guerendo fi Jawhar Jordan waliin tapha qooddatanii gumaachan, Missouri keessatti Darius Robinson ittisaan mul’ateera. Tulane tapha AAC irra deebise galmee itti fufa, Liberty ammoo qabachuu kubbaa irratti duraa dha. Yeroo xumuraa baayyee dursa taasifamaa jirutti, AP Top 25 sirna tasgabbii fi hin turree agarsiisu itti fufe, gara xumuraatti garuu gareewwan muraasatu galma gahuu mala.

article_content: Serena Williams defeated Dominika Cibulkova 6-2, 6-2 on Wednesday to advance to the Australian Open semifinals, marking another strong showing at the first major of the year. As the world No. 1, Williams has never lost a semifinal or final in Melbourne, holding a 10-0 record in these rounds and an impressive 40-7 in all grand slam semifinals and finals. She has not lost a grand slam semifinal or final since the 2011 U.S. Open. In the semifinals, Williams will play fellow American Madison Keys, who prevented an all-Williams matchup by defeating Venus Williams 6-3, 4-6, 6-4. At 19, Keys becomes the third young, unexpected semifinalist at the Australian Open in the past three seasons, joining Eugenie Bouchard and Sloane Stephens. Williams expressed happiness at making the semifinals in Melbourne, which she last reached when she won the tournament in 2010. 'It's finally good to get past the quarterfinals or the fourth round,' she said. Williams played despite battling a sore throat, saying, 'I've been sick the past few days. It's just getting worse and worse. But hopefully, it will start getting better. I heard there's a virus going around among the players.' Keys also faced physical challenges, calling the trainer for a thigh injury during her win over Venus Williams. She hopes to recover quickly, as there is no day off before the semifinal. 'It still hurts,' said Keys, adding she would seek treatment. Against the experienced Venus Williams, Keys rallied from a break down in the final set. Venus, appearing in her first major quarterfinal in five years, made 38 unforced errors and hit only 10 winners. In the third set, she managed just three winners but committed 13 unforced errors. Venus praised Keys but remained hopeful for future improvement, saying, 'This is her moment today...Next time I'll be able to play more solid.' Venus reflected positively on her recent form, despite the loss. In the other women’s semifinal, Maria Sharapova will face Ekaterina Makarova in an all-Russian match. On the men’s side, defending champion Stan Wawrinka continued his strong run by defeating Kei Nishikori 6-3, 6-4, 7-6 (6). Wawrinka overcame a near-miss in the tiebreak and closed out the match with a big serve. He has a 16-4 career record in tiebreaks in Melbourne, including 5-0 this year. Wawrinka’s next opponent will be world No. 1 Novak Djokovic, after Djokovic beat Milos Raonic 7-6 (5), 6-4, 6-2 without facing a single break point. Wawrinka and Djokovic have met in Melbourne’s semifinals for three straight years, with their previous encounters going to five sets. They also had a five-set match at the 2013 U.S. Open. In the first men’s semifinal on Thursday, Andy Murray will play Tomas Berdych. Berdych upset Rafael Nadal in the quarterfinals and has not dropped a set during the tournament so far.

article_content: Katherine Russell, the widow of Boston Marathon bomber Tamerlan Tsarnaev, has reportedly remarried and has had a baby with her new husband, according to a relative. Russell, 25, was previously married to Tamerlan Tsarnaev, who was killed in a police shootout after he and his brother were suspected of detonating explosives at the Boston Marathon in 2013. A year after Tamerlan's death, Russell left her parents' home in Rhode Island and moved to New Jersey to live with Tamerlan’s sisters, Bella and Ailina Tsarnaeva. She was recently seen leaving their home in North Bergen, New Jersey, carrying a baby. Ailina Tsarnaeva confirmed to the New York Post that Russell had remarried and had another child. Katherine Russell has declined to answer questions about her late husband or her brother-in-law, Dzhokhar Tsarnaev, who is awaiting federal trial for the April 15, 2013, Boston Marathon bombing. The Tsarnaev brothers, originally from the Chechen region, were accused of planting two bombs near the marathon finish line, which killed three people and injured more than 260 others. After the attacks, Russell's attorney said she first learned of her husband's alleged involvement from news reports and that she had no prior knowledge of his actions. Since then, Russell has stayed out of the public eye and focused on supporting her family by working long hours as a home health aide. The Tsarnaev sisters have faced separate legal issues, with Ailina charged with misleading police in a counterfeit money investigation and Bella charged with marijuana possession. Dzhokhar Tsarnaev is currently awaiting trial, and both sisters have visited him in jail.

article_content: Commander Peter Loughborough, who has led royalty protection for more than a decade, has been appointed Master of the Household at Clarence House, responsible for Prince Charles's personal and household arrangements. Lord Loughborough, the 7th Earl of Rosslyn and aged 56, will take over from Wing Commander Richard Pattle, who held the position since 2008 and is now pursuing other opportunities. Lord Loughborough's career included managing several high-profile security incidents, such as the 2003 break-in at Prince William's birthday party, a Fathers 4 Justice protest in 2004, and a 2009 security breach involving undercover journalists at Buckingham Palace. In 2023, a man was arrested for suspected burglary inside Buckingham Palace, and soon after, police mistakenly challenged Prince Andrew in the gardens. Despite these challenges, Metropolitan Police sources indicate Lord Loughborough is well-regarded by the Queen. A Clarence House spokesperson said, 'Commander Peter Loughborough was the successful candidate in a very large field. His credentials spoke for themselves.' In this new position, Lord Loughborough will receive a full police pension and a salary exceeding £100,000, although the exact figure is not publicly disclosed.

article_content:
Imagine a camera that can see around corners. While it sounds like science fiction, this technology—called femto photography—is now a reality. At MIT, researchers developed a camera system capable of capturing light in motion at speeds close to a trillion frames per second, essentially visualizing the speed of light itself.

Before joining MIT in 2008, Ramesh Raskar worked in computational photography, seeking ways to capture and process images beyond traditional means. His goal was to create a camera that looked beyond direct sight. Since light travels about one foot every billionth of a second, building such a camera for real-world environments was a major challenge.

Despite skepticism and initial setbacks—including a grant proposal rejected due to an administrative error—the team continued working. With collaborators from UC Santa Cruz and MIT’s Media Lab, several years of research and prototyping finally led to a breakthrough. After nearly three years, a software system demonstrated the ability to see around corners.

Femto photography works by emitting extremely brief laser pulses and using a device called a streak tube to capture light as it scatters through the scene. The camera collects hundreds of ultra-fast images from slightly different angles and merges them into a detailed slow-motion composite. Millions of exposures are averaged together to gather enough data, as each low-light exposure is almost instantaneous.

By analyzing how scattered light returns to the camera at varying times, algorithms reconstruct images of objects not directly visible—even three-dimensional shapes like a running person. Though not yet ready for commercial use, possible applications include helping cars detect oncoming vehicles around blind curves, enabling medical imaging without X-rays, or allowing firefighters to see through smoke in burning buildings from a safe distance.

The advent of femto photography pushes imaging far beyond previous boundaries, giving new ways to see and understand our world. This work was accomplished by a team from MIT, UC Santa Cruz, the University of Toronto, Universidad de Zaragoza, Cornell University, Rice University, and Harvard University.

—Ramesh Raskar (with thanks to collaborators)

Kameraan konkolaataa irraa dura maal arguu danda’a? Fakkii ifatti hin mul’anne quunnamuu keessaniin, teeknoolojii femto photography jedhamee waamamu dhugumaan dhufee jira. MIT keessatti qorattoonni kameraa ifa sosso’a keessaatti sekoondiitti tiriliyoona frame fidan, saffisa ifa ittiin ilaalu danda’an hojjatan.

Ramesh Raskar bara 2008 dura, damee computational photography keessatti hojjechaa jiraachaa ture, suraa jireenya hin ilaalamne argachuuf yaalii gochaa ture. Ergamni isaa, kameraa wantoota kallattii lafee hin jiru arguu danda’u tolchuu ture. Ifni sekoondiitti biliyoona tokko tti miilla tokkotti darbaa waan deemuuf, kameraa akkanaa ijaarsisuun ulfaataa ture.

Rakkoolee fi dogoggora deeggarsa maallaqaa irraa eegaluun, gareen itti fufee hojjetaa ture. Hojjattoota UC Santa Cruz fi MIT Media Lab waliin waggoota hedduuf qorannoo taasisee booda, milkaa’ina argatee, waggaa sadihiif yaalii taasiseen, demosnitraashinii agarsiisuu danda'ame.

Femto photography jechuun, gadi bu’aa gabaabaa harka laaserii baasuun streak tube jedhamuun saanduqa akkaataa ifni iddoo gara garaa keessa socho’u suraa fiduudha. Kameraan suuraalee saffisa ol’aanaa gara garaa irra jiraata, garagalcha xiqqaa waliin walduraa duubaan fiduun, walduraa duubaan walitti makuun suuraan bal’inaan agarsiifama. Suuraalee miliyoona hedduu walitti qabachuun shaakalaa bu’uura godha, sababni isaa ifni yeroo gabaabduu tilmaamameen hin qophaa’u.

Akka ifni gara kameraatti yeroo gara garaan deebi’uu danda’u qorannaan, algoritiimii gurguddaatiin fakkiin wantoota iddoo tokkotti argaman hin ilaalamne, fakkaattota sadanitti makama. Hojii kana ammas gara daldalaa ol hin galin, garuu qar.atingii guddaa qaba: konkolaataa karaa kallattii hin mul’annetti konkolaataa biraa agarsiisuu, qorannoo fayyaa X-ray malee taasifamuu, yookiin konkolaataan guyyuu gubbaa keessa nama ilaaluu nama lubbuu itti hin sodaachisne.

Furmaan femto photography daangaa suuraalee duraanii dhiphisee, keennaa lafa irraa argame qaba. Hojii kana MIT, UC Santa Cruz, University of Toronto, Universidad de Zaragoza, Cornell University, Rice University fi Harvard University irraa gareen hojjeteera.

—Ramesh Raskar (hiriyoota galateeffatee)

article_content: Xu Jianyin, chairman of Chinese real estate group Evergrande and ranked as China's 15th richest individual with an estimated net worth of $7 billion (according to the Hurun Report), is widely believed to be the secret purchaser of one of Sydney’s most exclusive properties, Villa del Mare. The property, located at 63-67 Wolseley Rd, Point Piper in Sydney’s east, sold for approximately $39 million in October. Villa del Mare, which offers panoramic views of Sydney Harbour, was previously owned by recruitment agent Julia Ross, who is listed as number 20 on BRW’s Rich Women list with a wealth of $65 million. The mansion features six bedrooms, eight bathrooms, several living areas, an entertainment bar, an infinity pool, and Mediterranean-style courtyards and gardens across a 1,500 square metre block. The sale was facilitated by real estate agents from LJ Hooker Double Bay, who declined to comment on the buyer. Settlement documents listed Golden Fast Foods Pty Ltd, a company believed to be associated with Evergrande, as the purchaser. Reports indicate that Chinese investors have been the top source of foreign investment in Australian real estate. According to the Foreign Investment Review Board, Chinese nationals invested nearly $6 billion in Australian commercial and residential property between 2012 and 2013. Foreign buyers accounted for 16.8% of new residential property demand in the third quarter of 2014, a figure expected to grow. Australian regulations require foreign non-residents or temporary visa holders to invest in ways that add to the housing stock, such as by acquiring new dwellings, off-the-plan properties, or land for development. Local property agents note that Chinese buyers are especially attracted to prestigious homes featuring expansive views and large plots of land. Many prefer to purchase off-market to avoid competition. In recent years, other high-end properties in Sydney’s eastern suburbs have been purchased by Chinese buyers, who reportedly pay amounts ranging from $5 million to $30 million. Agents like Danny Doff from Laing and Simmons Double Bay, and Paul Pfeiffer from RT Edgar Toorak, have noted the positive impact of Chinese investment on the local property market, including the creation of new jobs through redevelopment. Julia Ross first bought the Villa del Mare residence for $21.5 million in 2005. The property has been on and off the market since 2011 before selling this year.

Manni kun 63-67 Wolseley Rd, Point Piper, naannoo bahaa Sydney irratti argama, Onkolooleessa keessa doolara miliyoona 39 irratti gurgurame. Villa del Mare, kan argaa bal’ina Haroo Sydney qabu, dura kan turte Julia Ross taha, isheenis lakkoofsa 20faa irratti BRW Rich Women list irratti argamti, badhaasa qabeenya doolara miliyoona 65 qabaatti. Manni kun kutaa ciisichaa jaha, mana fincaanii saddeet, kutaa jireenyaa hedduu, baara bashannanaa, boolla daakaa turoomee fi balbala fi margaa walfakkaatu gara Mediterranean qunnamsiisu qaba, bal’ina lafa mitira murteessaa (1,500) irratti ijaarame. Gurgurtaa kanaaf Ajeensoota LJ Hooker Double Bay gargaarsa godhan, garuu sadarkaa bitataa irratti yaada kennuu didani. Waraqaa waliigalaa irratti maqaan Golden Fast Foods Pty Ltd, kan Evergrande waliin hariiroo qabaachu mala, akka bitataa galmaa’eera. Gabaasaaleen agarsiisu, Chaayinaan abbaa investimentii biyya alaa olaanaa ta’e Awustraaliyaa keessaa dha. Akka gabaasa Foreign Investment Review Board, Chaayinaan bara 2012-2013 keessa qofa lafa fi mana Awustraaliyaa keessatti doolaara biliyoona jaha kan ijaarame. Bittootni biyya alaatiin hirmaatan %16.8 mana jireenya haaraa gurguramee irratti bara 2014 gosaa sadii keessatti argamuu danda’u jedhamee eegama. Seerotni Awustraaliyaa investera biyya alaa ykn kan visaa yeroo gabaabaa qaban manneen bitan ijaarsa manaaf dabalataa akka ta’u ni barbaadu, fakkeenyaaf manneen haaraa, hojii ijaaramaa jiruu fi lafa bilisaa bituu keessatti. Ajeensoonni gurgurtaa lafaawwan, investeroota Chaayinaa bakka ol-aanaa fi lafa bal’aa qaban irratti xiyyeeffatu; hedduus gurgurtaa dorgomaa jalaa ba’uuf alatti bitu filatu. Bara ammaa kana, manni sadarkaa olii naannoo bahaa Sydney keessa argaman hedduun investeroota Chaayinaa irraa bitaman, qarshii doolaara miliyoona 5 hanga 30tti gurgurameera. Ajeensoonni akka Danny Doff fi Paul Pfeiffer, investimentiin Chaayinaa irratti bu’aalee ijaarsi fi hojii uumuun argamanii mul’atu jedhanii himan. Julia Ross, Villa del Mare bara 2005tti doolaara miliyoona 21.5 irratti bitatte. Manni sun bara 2011 as gurgurtaa irratti turuus, bara kanatti gurguramuun raawwateera.

article_content: Tom Hicks Jr. has resigned from his position as Liverpool director and from Kop Holdings, the club’s parent company, following controversy surrounding an abusive email he sent to a fan. Hicks Jr., son of co-owner Tom Hicks, faced scrutiny after it was disclosed that he responded inappropriately to a supporter who raised concerns about the club's financial situation. While Hicks Jr. later issued an apology, his resignation has now been confirmed. Spirit of Shankly, a Liverpool supporters' group advocating for the removal of American co-owners Hicks Sr. and George Gillett, had called for his departure. Since his father remains a co-owner, there had appeared to be limited internal pressure for him to step down. Hicks Jr. previously served on the Anfield board with his father, Gillett and his son Foster, and managing director Christian Purslow. At the time of his resignation, Liverpool announced further boardroom changes, naming Casey Coffman, executive vice-president of Hicks Holdings, as his replacement. Additionally, chief financial officer Philip Nash and commercial director Ian Ayre have been appointed to the boards of both Liverpool and Kop Holdings. In recent months, Purslow, Nash, and Ayre have played growing roles in efforts to strengthen the club’s finances. This work has included securing a new shirt sponsorship deal with Standard Chartered Bank, valued at approximately $120 million. Since taking over from Rick Parry last June, one of Purslow’s priorities has been attracting new investment and securing funding for a new stadium. Because Hicks Jr. was not heavily involved in daily decisions, his departure is not expected to impact current club plans.

Hicks Jr. erga dhiifama gaafatee booda, aangoo irraa bu’u isaa mirkaneeffameera. Sababni isaas abbaa isaa sadarkaa abbaa qabeenyaatti hafuudhaan olola guddaa irratti hin bu'ureffamne. Hicks Jr. duraan boordii Anfield irratti abbaa isaa, Gillett fi ilma isaa Foster fi bulchaa olaanaa Christian Purslow wajjin tajaajilaa ture. Yeroo aangoo isaa irraa galuu isaa, Liverpool labsii jijjiirama boordii dabarsee, Casey Coffman, itti aanaan preezidaantii Hicks Holdings, bakka isaa filate. Akkasumaas, bulchaan maallaqaa Philip Nash fi daayireektarri daldalaa Ian Ayre boordii Liverpool fi Kop Holdings irratti makamaniiru. Ji’oota darban keessatti, Purslow, Nash fi Ayre, humna malee hojii isaanii irratti fooyya’iinsa maallaqa garee irratti hirmaannaa olaanaa qabaachuun isaanii galmaa’eera. Hojiin isaanii waliigaltee suuraa Standard Chartered Bank waliin taasifame, doolara miiliyoona 120 gadi fageenya qabu argamsiiseera. Purslow ammo, erga Rick Parry bakka bu’ee Waxabajji bara darbe irraa eegalee, maallaqa haaraa galii galchuu fi guyyoota dhufuuf istaadiyamii haaraa ijaaruuf maallaqa walii galu barbaacha ture. Sababni isaas Hicks Jr. duuba hojii guyyaa guyyaa irratti hirmaannaa guddaa waan hin qabneef, ba’uun isaa karoorri garee itti fufu irratti dhiibbaa hin fidu jedhameera.

Kim Henares stressed there is no political motivation behind the investigation, saying, 'There's nothing wrong with being wealthy if you pay the correct taxes.'

article_content: Researchers in France have uncovered what could be the world’s largest deposit of natural hydrogen—also known as white hydrogen—a promising development for clean energy and the fight against climate change. Jacques Pironon and Phillipe De Donato, directors at the French National Centre of Scientific Research, located a site believed to contain between 6 and 250 million metric tons of white hydrogen, CNN reports. White hydrogen is found naturally underground, as opposed to other types that are manufactured in laboratories. The scientific community began seriously considering its importance after a 2018 study of a well in Mali revealed that it produced nearly pure hydrogen gas. This discovery has since attracted global scientific attention. Hydrogen energy is clean because it only creates water as a byproduct when burned. Until recently, experts assumed that finding large quantities of naturally occurring hydrogen was unlikely. Geoffrey Ellis, a geochemist with the US Geological Survey, recalled that he once doubted the existence of natural hydrogen reserves. White hydrogen originates from chemical processes in the Earth’s crust, while other colors of hydrogen—like green (from electrolysis) and gray (from methane)—come from manmade procedures. Although hydrogen is the most abundant element, it’s usually combined with other elements, making extraction difficult and energy-heavy, often involving fossil fuels. White hydrogen stands out because it avoids energy-intensive production, making it much more affordable—around $1 per kilogram compared to $6 for green hydrogen, according to CNN. The lower cost has led startups to explore how to produce and market white hydrogen commercially. Experts say it’s crucial to move quickly to take full advantage of white hydrogen’s potential to address the climate crisis. Still, researchers like geochemist Viacheslav Zgonnik are hopeful, noting that with some technology updates, harnessing this resource is within our reach. This discovery comes just months after Earth experienced its hottest summer ever—a sobering reminder for climate scientists and advocates of the urgent need for climate solutions.

Jacques Pironon fi Phillipe De Donato, daayirektronni qorannoo Kaampaanii Qorannoo Saayinsii Faransaay keessatti hojjetan, meeshaa hydrogen adii hanga meetirikii miiliyoona 6 hanga 250 qabaachu mala jedhamu argachuu isaanii CNN gabaase. article_content: Los Angeles Lakers star Kobe Bryant is expected to miss the remainder of the season due to a torn rotator cuff. Bryant suffered the injury during the second half of the Lakers' 96-80 loss to the New Orleans Pelicans on Wednesday night in New Orleans. Sources informed ESPN that Bryant has been dealing with this shoulder issue since the preseason. The Lakers announced on Thursday that a preliminary MRI taken in San Antonio found a rotator cuff tear. On Friday, the team confirmed the diagnosis after additional examination, and said Bryant is discussing his options with doctors. He is scheduled to be examined by Dr. Neal ElAttrache on Monday, when a decision about possible surgery is expected. The 36-year-old Bryant has played in 35 games this season after returning from an Achilles injury that kept him out last year. This season, he is averaging 22.3 points, 5.7 rebounds, and 5.6 assists per game for the Lakers, who are currently last in the Pacific Division with a 12-31 record.

article_content: Chelsea Clinton, the only child of former U.S. President Bill Clinton and former Secretary of State Hillary Clinton, has indicated that she might consider running for public office in the future. While she has often responded 'no' when asked about entering politics, Chelsea now says she cannot completely rule out the possibility. In a recent interview with Fast Company, she explained that she currently supports her elected officials, but if that changes, she might need to reconsider her stance. Chelsea suggested she could be open to running for positions ranging from mayor to senator. At 34, Chelsea serves as vice chair of the Bill, Hillary and Chelsea Clinton Foundation. She has previously made similar comments to Marlo Thomas, published on The Huffington Post. After speaking at the South by Southwest conference in Austin, Texas, Chelsea said her views on public service have been slowly evolving, according to BuzzFeed. She also shared her experiences growing up in a prominent political family, telling MailOnline about participating in family debates from a young age. Chelsea noted that, despite her parents’ prominence, she had to teach them basic tech skills like texting and charging their phones. She expressed disappointment that few of her peers consider running for public office.

article_content: Jani von Wielligh, from Adelaide, and Natasha Strydom, from Waiuku near Auckland, had been close friends since their kindergarten days in South Africa. Both 20 years old, their lives were sadly cut short in a car crash while traveling together in New Zealand. Their trip took them along State Highway 25 near Thames, where another car is believed to have crossed into their lane, causing a fatal collision. Earlier that day, they had visited Natasha’s family in Waiuku before heading to Palmerston North to look at Natasha’s university and living arrangements. After their families moved—Jani’s to Australia and Natasha’s to New Zealand—the friendship endured, with the two frequently visiting each other and maintaining contact through the years. Family members, including their fathers, have remarked on the strong bond the two shared, describing their friendship as inspiring and full of love. Natasha’s mother, Charmaine, publicly thanked God for the twenty years she had with her daughter. Friends and community members are mourning both women, sharing heartfelt tributes and acknowledging the special connection between them. The other vehicle’s driver, involved in the collision, remains hospitalized in critical but stable condition. The Serious Crash Unit is investigating; early indications suggest the other car crossed the center line. Officials have ruled out speed and alcohol as causes.

article_content: Monty Don has voiced strong criticism against the BBC for temporarily removing his gardening series, Gardeners' World, in favor of broadcasting snooker. The program, which attracts around 2.6 million viewers, is absent from its regular Friday 8:30 pm slot on BBC Two this week due to the World Snooker Championship semifinals. Fans and gardening supporters have expressed frustration online, contending that their interests are often sidelined in favor of sports. Aside from the annual snooker break in May, Gardeners' World also routinely loses its slot to Wimbledon coverage during the summer. Don, who is 57, labeled the interruption a 'crazy hiatus' that he felt would undoubtedly upset both viewers and himself. He accused the BBC’s schedulers of lacking concern for the show and its audience. With many people turning to gardening during the Bank Holiday as the weather improves, viewers like Bryan Appleyard have highlighted the importance of consistent programming for Gardeners' World. Don concurred, suggesting BBC executives don’t fully recognize the need for regularity, and pointing out that such schedule changes would not happen with football. Additional fans, such as Roz Smith, have pushed for an extended duration for the program and questioned why sports consistently take precedence. Don attributed these rearrangements to the BBC’s preference for cheaper programming. Smith advocated for an increase in gardening content, but Don was skeptical, noting that the BBC already considers the current program sufficient for its gardening remit. A previous presenter urged fans to write formal letters to the broadcaster, emphasizing that tweets can be easily overlooked. Matthew Appleby from Horticulture Week argued that the BBC is failing gardening enthusiasts at a key moment in the season—especially given recent poor weather—and said that dropping the show during spring is a missed opportunity. He suggested that the BBC’s only gardening series, lasting just thirty minutes, should be prioritized during peak periods. The BBC responded that Gardeners' World is aired year-round except during major sports events, explaining that scheduling must occasionally shift different types of programming to accommodate these events, and that such changes are made with minimal disruption.

Xabi Alonso, who is now managing Bayer Leverkusen, has long been recognized for his composed and strategic approach. Throughout his playing career, his calmness and precise timing set him apart as a leading midfielder of his time. He has carried this methodical style into his career as a coach, choosing not to rush or adhere to a rigid career plan but to move forward at a deliberate pace.

Given his background, it was widely anticipated that Alonso would transition into management. He played for some of Europe’s most successful clubs—Liverpool, Real Madrid, and Bayern Munich—achieving significant honors such as Champions League victories, domestic league titles, the World Cup, and European Championships with Spain.

Alonso's development was shaped by learning under many top managers: Rafael Benítez at Liverpool; José Mourinho, Carlo Ancelotti, and Zinedine Zidane at Real Madrid; and Pep Guardiola and again Ancelotti at Bayern Munich. In the latter part of his playing days, Alonso took a keen interest in the managerial side of football, often seeking insights from his coaches and their staff.

After retiring, Alonso opted for a thoughtful path into management, preferring to build his knowledge and skills over time rather than jumping directly into high-profile positions. This measured approach highlights his commitment to learning and his belief in the value of patience.

article_content: Helen Mann, 43, head teacher at Sytchampton Endowed First School in Worcestershire, died by suicide in her office less than seven months after taking up her position, an inquest heard. Mrs. Mann, a mother of two, had reportedly been struggling significantly with her workload and expressed concern that the school might lose its 'outstanding' Ofsted rating. Her anxiety increased following a governors’ meeting where it was decided to make part-time teacher Angela Mercer redundant. Mrs. Mercer subsequently indicated she would file an unfair dismissal claim, which left Mrs. Mann feeling overwhelmed. The 80-pupil primary school had previously achieved ‘outstanding’ Ofsted ratings for several inspections, but had gone five terms without a permanent headteacher before Mrs. Mann's appointment. Dr. Stephanie Gait, chair of governors, testified that soon after Mrs. Mann started, a local authority adviser suggested a likely downgrade at the next Ofsted inspection. Dr. Gait said Mrs. Mann was very concerned about this upcoming review, although the risk of losing the rating was not attributed to her. Initially described as enthusiastic, Mrs. Mann appeared exhausted after the summer break, and the emotional strain surrounding Mrs. Mercer’s dismissal contributed to her distress. Angela Mercer learned about her redundancy through her son, who was informed during a school event. When she approached Mrs. Mann, she saw the headteacher was visibly distressed by the situation. Kirsten Rowan, who served as acting head before Mrs. Mann, said that staff had felt she was attempting too many changes too quickly. Following Mrs. Mann’s death, Mrs. Rowan was signed off with post-traumatic stress disorder. Three weeks into the autumn term, Mrs. Mann collapsed during a meeting and was signed off due to illness. When she briefly returned, colleagues described her as appearing very unwell. The inquest into Mrs. Mann’s death is ongoing.

Mann, haadha ijoollee lamaa, hojii ishee irratti ulfaataa fi dhiphina cimaa keessa turte, sadarkaa 'bayeessa' Ofsted irraa akka dhabuu danda'u sodaachaa turte. New York City, known for its dense population, is quietly losing housing density in certain areas as residents expand their apartments. According to preservationist Adam Brodheim, over the past 70 years, around 50,000 multi-family buildings in the city have been converted into one- or two-family homes, resulting in a loss of approximately 100,000 housing units. 

Brodheim, referencing his master’s thesis covered by The City, explained that many row houses previously served multiple families but have since been altered to accommodate fewer residents. Of the 320,777 row houses in NYC, 51,221 have gone from multi-family to housing just one or two families; among those, about 7,219 are now single-family homes.

Urban planner Matthew Pietrus found that apartment consolidations are most common in some of New York’s wealthiest neighborhoods, including the Upper East Side, West Village, and Cobble Hill. While some consolidation is understandable as families seek more space—especially given the scarcity of larger apartments—it also intensifies a city-wide housing shortage, making New York less affordable and forcing lower- and middle-income residents out.

New residential construction in New York has slowed dramatically, with rents and home prices soaring. Since 2010, while the number of jobs in the city has increased by 22%, the housing supply has grown by only 4%. More than half of city renters are considered rent-burdened, paying over 30% of their income in rent.

Studies suggest that growing housing supply—even at market rates—can curb rising rents and home prices. Manhattan, the city’s wealthiest borough, is at the heart of the problem. For instance, the number of new housing permits in Manhattan dropped from 1,208 in July 2013 to zero in July 2023. Citywide, permits fell from 2,525 to 279 over the same period. Manhattan has lost about 27,000 units to consolidation, and the city’s housing shortfall is worsened by even slower construction in many suburbs.

Some developers are now targeting both the housing shortage and post-pandemic office space glut by converting vacant offices into apartments. The Adams administration is promoting this approach, and one such conversion will soon offer nearly 600 rental units. However, this makes only a small dent in the city’s housing deficit.

Mayor Eric Adams’ “City of Yes” zoning reforms aim to create 100,000 new homes for 250,000 New Yorkers over 15 years. His broader target is 500,000 new homes in the next decade, nearing the estimated 560,000-unit shortfall. By comparison, only 25,936 new homes were built in the city last year—about half of Adams’ annual goal.

Magaalaa New York, baay'ina namoota waliin beekamtu, bakkeewwan muraasa keessatti baay'inni mana jireenyaa ni xiqqaachaa jira; kun sababaa namoonni mana jireenya isaanii babal'ifachuufi. Akka qorataa eegumsa seenaa Adam Brodheim jedhutti, waggoota 70 dabran keessatti, mana jireenyaa maatii hedduutiif ijaaraman 50,000 ol gara mana jiruu tokko ykn lamaatti jijjiiramaniiru, kunis gartokkeen baay'ina mana jireenyaa 100,000 ol dhabeera.

Brodheim, qorannoo hoji-duraa isaa irratti The City irratti ibsee, manneen gamaa hedduun dura maatii addaddaa waliin turan, garuu ammaaf lakkoofsi maatii irraa xiqqaateera. Mana gamaa 320,777 keessaa, 51,221 gara mana maatii tokko ykn lamaatti jijjiiraman, isaan keessaa 7,219 gara mana maatii tokkichaatti jijjiiraman.

Qorataan naannoo Matthew Pietrus akka dubbatuutti, jijjiirama manneen hedduu gara tokkootti godhamu naannolee badhaadhinaa magaalaa keessa, fakkeenyaaf, Upper East Side, West Village, fi Cobble Hill keessatti mul'ata. Jijjiiranni kun yeroo tokko tokko akka dhugumatti barbaachisu kan hubatamu yoo ta'u, maatiin bal'ina barbaachisanii argatanii jiraachuu qaba, oomisha mana jireenyaa gara-gara hayaatus rakkoof taasisa, sababni isaas jeequmsa hanqina mana jireenyaa magaalattii cimuuf sababii ta'a.

Ijaarsi mana jireenyaa haarawaa New York keessatti hedduu laafachaa jira, jireenyaan baay'ee qaala'aa ta'era. Bara 2010 as, hojii magaalattii 22% dabaleera, baay'inni mana jireenyaa ammoo 4% qofa dabale. Kireeffattoonni magaalattii keessaa harka caalaan isaanii gatii karaa seeraatiin ol kiraaf baasuu irra jiran.

Qorannooleen hedduun baay'inni mana jireenyaa yoo dabale, gatii fi kiraa mana jireenyaa gara laafinnaa dhaqaa akka deemu agarsiisu. Manhattan, kutaa magaalaa sadaffaa badhaadhinaa qabu, rakkina kana keessatti hirmaata hapahee qaba. Fakkeenyaaf, July 2013 keessatti hayyama ijaarsa mana haarawaa 1,208 argatame, July 2023 garuu tokkoyyu hin kenname. Magaalattii guutu keessatti, hayyama ijaarsa sanaan 2,525 irraa gara 279 tti gadi bu'e. Manhattan manneen kiraa 27,000 ol jijjiirama kanaan dhabeera; rakkoon kun ammoo naannolee magaalaa alaatti ijaarsi gadi ta'uun hammaateera.

Ijaarsitoonni murtaayoon gara rakkoo mana jireenyaa fi bakka hojii of keessaa hin qabne gara mana jireenyaa jijjiiruu irratti xiyyeeffannaa kennu. Bulchaan magaalattii Eric Adams karoora kana jabeessaa jira, baay'een keessa mana kiraa 600 ol bara kana xumura keessa banamuuf deema. Haa ta'u malee, kun rakkoo mana jireenyaa magaalattii furuuf baay’ee xiqqoodha.

Karoora “City of Yes” jedhamu hojiirra oolchuudhaan, bulchaan magaalattii Adams waggoota 15 keessatti mana jireenyaa 100,000, nama 250,000 oolchuuf karoorfateera. Kan bal’inaan, waggoota 10 keessatti mana jireenyaa 500,000 ijaaruu fi hanqina mana jireenyaa 560,000 tti dhihaachuuf deemudha. Bara darbe keessatti qofa, mana jireenyaa haaraa 25,936 ijaaramuufi dandeettii karoora Adams bara tokkoof barbaadu harka lammaffaadha.

article_content: Actor Isha Talwar, known for her role in the Amazon Prime Video series Mirzapur, says that working in the film industry can be daunting as artists struggle with insecurity, competition, and constant pressure to succeed. Isha began her film career with the Malayalam movie Thattathin Marayathu in 2012 and went on to act in Tamil and Telugu films, before appearing in Salman Khan’s Tubelight in 2017. Her Bollywood credits also include Kaalakaandi, Article 15, and Sharmaji Namkeen. Talwar achieved breakthrough success with Mirzapur in 2020 and later appeared in Saas, Bahu Aur Flamingo. She is now preparing for her next project, Chamak, a SonyLIV musical thriller set in Punjab that releases on December 7. In an interview with Indianexpress.com, Isha discusses moving away from societal pressures to 'make it big', choosing to pursue acting out of passion, and the importance of recognizing actors for their resilience. Reflecting on her decade-long career, she credits South Indian cinema for giving her foundational exposure and notes the immense self-doubt and pressure faced by artists in the industry. She has consciously stopped chasing external definitions of success and now focuses on personal fulfillment. Talwar shared that she no longer feels competitive and instead values growth, having spent seven months taking an acting course in Kerala, which she describes as a career reset. After her success with Mirzapur, she had to wait over a year for new work. She states that time has helped her come to terms with the unpredictability of the industry and that growing up with a father in the field did not fully prepare her for its realities. Discussing her next film, Chamak, Isha sees it as a new beginning, allowing her to break away from being typecast in traditional roles and to play a character closer to her own age. She says that her recent acting course has renewed her enthusiasm and that she is excited for the diverse roles the future might bring. For more entertainment updates and Bollywood news, visit The Indian Express.

Waggoota ishee keessattis hojii gaggeessaa jirtu yaadachuun, sinimaawwan kibbaa irraa muuxannoo guddaa argachuu ishee fi dhiibbaa fi shakkii cimaa aktistoonni filmii keessa darban ibsite. article_content: Melissa Kwan, CEO and co-founder of eWebinar, has spent the past 13 years building three companies without relying on venture capital. She chose to bootstrap her startups, allowing her to prioritize a balanced lifestyle over chasing maximum profits. This strategy gives her the flexibility to design her daily routine—sleeping in, working late, taking breaks or traveling as she pleases, often alongside her life partner and cofounder. Avoiding venture funding means Melissa doesn't answer to a board or outside investors and maintains control over the company’s direction. She employs a team of remote contractors, allowing everyone to choose their own schedules, which she believes fosters greater productivity. Rather than attending traditional business events or frequent calls, she prefers to communicate digitally, keeping her work aligned with what she enjoys. With a focus on happiness rather than only revenue, Melissa and her team took three years to build up to $1 million in recurring annual revenue, carefully listening to customer feedback for product improvements. While bootstrapping brought sacrifices—like forgoing a salary for some time—she relishes the freedom not to be driven by investor demands or artificial growth expectations. She also notes that bootstrapping doesn’t always mean never raising capital; it means being able to make those choices based on what’s best for the business, often after reaching notable revenue milestones. For Melissa, this path allowed her greater independence and freed her from the worries her VC-backed friends often faced about growth rates and funding rounds. For Melissa, bootstrapping represents an intentional choice about lifestyle as much as business, allowing her to shape her company and personal life according to her own vision and priorities.

article_content: Staff at a Kenyan morgue were astonished when a man who had been declared dead regained consciousness and called for help. Hospital authorities have initiated an investigation into why Paul Mutora, 24, was pronounced dead and sent for embalming. He was admitted to the hospital in critical condition after ingesting insecticide in an apparent suicide attempt following an argument with his father. On Thursday afternoon, two mortuary attendants heard noises from a side room. When they discovered Mr. Mutora was alive and breathing, they reportedly ran away in shock, according to a witness quoted by Kenya's Star newspaper. Mr. Mutora, a husband and father from the town of Limuru, was transported about 30 miles to Naivasha District Hospital, located 55 miles northeast of Nairobi. On Wednesday night, his condition worsened, and he was declared dead around 11pm before being moved to the morgue. His father and other relatives visited his body at the morgue the following morning and then left to begin funeral arrangements. After his unexpected recovery, Mr. Mutora was transferred back to the hospital ward, where doctors said he is now out of danger. Hospital superintendent Dr. Joseph Mburu told KTN Kenya that medications given to Mr. Mutora, including atropine, may have caused signs such as a slowed heart rate and dilated pupils, which can sometimes lead to a mistaken declaration of death. Dr. Mburu said the hospital was investigating how such a misdiagnosis occurred and suggested that a staff member may not have fully understood the effects of the drugs administered. A groggy Mr. Mutora later said, 'This was a mistake from the start.' Several family members criticized the hospital for negligence. Mr. Mutora apologized to his father and said he is preparing to care for his wife and child.

article_content: Dozens of climate activists interrupted Transportation Secretary Pete Buttigieg's presentation at a Baltimore event, criticizing his involvement in a proposed Texas petrochemical project. They chanted slogans like "Stop Petro Pete!" and "Which side are you on, Pete?" The protestors, affiliated with Climate Defiance, confronted Buttigieg, who was attending a conference at Meyerhoff Symphony Hall organized by The Baltimore Banner. One protestor stated, 'Your DOT just approved the Seaport Oil Terminal, a project that will emit as much greenhouse gas as 80 coal plants and worsen air quality in communities already facing health risks.' Buttigieg responded cautiously, saying, 'I respect where you're coming from,' but was soon forced to leave the stage as chanting escalated. Security intervened to hold back protestors. After Buttigieg exited, a protestor urged, 'Think about why he said he can't "speak off the cuff" on climate. We're ready to have a conversation with Secretary Pete.' According to The Baltimore Banner, Trevor Carroll of Better Brazoria explained that activists want the Department of Transportation to deny permits for the Seaport Oil Terminal (S.P.O.T.) export facility, planned 30 miles off the coast of Brazoria County, near Houston. If approved, the terminal would export two million barrels of crude oil daily from the region considered the country's energy capital. Security was unable to fully clear the stage and eventually asked the audience to leave. Protestors continued their chants and singing for several minutes. After their departure, Buttigieg returned to discuss the project, climate concerns raised by the protesters, and the Biden administration's actions, such as the Inflation Reduction Act, aimed at reducing reliance on fossil fuels. Outside, Carroll highlighted the intent to draw attention to new oil export terminals and voiced concerns about pipeline infrastructure running through residential areas and ending in Surfside Beach, a tourist and retiree destination. Activists worry about potential oil spills from the proposed export terminal. Protesters asserted: 'We just chased Secretary Pete Buttigieg off the stage. He is forcing the Sea Port and GulfLink oil terminals—projects activists claim could be worse than Keystone—on local communities. We must resist and will continue to do so.'

Isaanis sagalee olka'aa "Petro Pete dhaabi!" fi "Keessummaa Pete gara kamtu jirta?" jedhanii dhageessisan. Hirmaattoonni garee Climate Defiance ta'uun beekaman, Buttigieg’n yeroo konferansii Meyerhoff Symphony Hall keessatti The Baltimore Banner qindeessite irratti argamanitti isaan fuulduratti dhufan. Hirmaataan tokko akkana jedhe: 'DOT keessan Seaport Oil Terminal filatteen, kan yeroo guutuu humna coomaa warshaa 80 qabu gadhiisu fi qilleensa naannoo fayyaa irratti rakkina qabu haalaan hammeessuu danda’a.'
