In an interview with CNN's Piers Morgan, actor Charlie Sheen spoke openly about his life and career. Sheen recounted meeting cyclist Lance Armstrong at a party years ago, describing Armstrong as unfriendly during their brief interaction, though he assumed Armstrong might have been in a bad mood.

Commenting on Armstrong's later admission to doping, Sheen reflected on his own substance use. He confessed to using steroids in 1988 while filming 'Major League.' Sheen explained that steroids increased his energy but also made him irritable and aggressive. He stressed that athletic skill cannot be gained from drugs alone.

Sheen shared his lifelong dream of playing professional baseball, particularly for the Cincinnati Reds, admitting he did not have the necessary talent for a career in the sport.

Discussing his television experience, Sheen spoke about his well-known fallout with Chuck Lorre, the executive producer of 'Two and a Half Men.' He said they have not been in contact since his firing but would be civil if they met again. Sheen acknowledged Lorre's creative talent and early enthusiasm for the show, though he disagreed with how the show continued after his departure.

Sheen described Jon Cryer, his former co-star, as a comedic genius and spoke positively about Ashton Kutcher, who replaced him on the show. He clarified that he gave Lindsay Lohan $100,000 to supplement her pay for 'Scary Movie 5,' noting that she was grateful, albeit not immediately.

The conversation touched on the difficulties associated with fame, substance use, and maintaining public image. Sheen remarked that too much access could quickly turn overwhelming. He also discussed his family arrangements, including his upcoming role as a grandfather and his collaborative approach with ex-wives Denise Richards and Brooke Mueller, who live nearby with their children.

To his children, Sheen said he would pass on the advice to always 'lead with the truth,' a principle he learned from his father.

article_content: By Spencer Matthews. Supporting friends is important, and last night was no exception as I attended Binky Felstead’s book launch at Whisky Mist, a top London nightclub near Park Lane. Binky, my Made In Chelsea co-star, is very popular on the show, and after more than three years working together, we get along well—probably because she’s wisely avoided any romantic entanglements with me. The event was attended by several cast members, friends, family, and the publishing team from Simon & Schuster, who were all there to celebrate the launch of 'Being Binky'—165 pages covering the life so far of Alexandra 'Binky' Felstead. It’s been a lot of hard work for Binky, and the finished autobiography looks fantastic. The lilac-colored book tells her stories about life and relationships, includes photos from her childhood, and offers big-sister style advice on topics like boys, bullying, parents, and make-up. The book will be available in stores starting Thursday, 8th May. Apparently, there’s a fair amount about me in the book—all flattering, I hope. Arriving late from filming at Longleat Safari Park in Wiltshire due to heavy traffic, Binky was more than fashionably late, but looked stunning in an elegant Joseph jacket and was warmly welcomed. Binky’s book also shares advice on boys, bullying, and beauty. The launch party was joined by cast members both past and present, such as Emma Miller, Rosie Fortescue, and Ollie Locke. I attended with Hugo Empson, who organizes the Grand Tour luxury motor event, and the celebration quickly got underway. While Ciroc vodka was flowing, Binky herself just had one 'Skinny Bitch' (vodka, lime, soda)—she’s in full workout mode, using Forza Raspberry K2 supplements to get in great shape for a Bluebella lingerie photo-shoot later this week. We made up for her restraint with our own drinks. Binky's mother Jane was there to celebrate her daughter's achievement. Renowned jeweller Vashi Dominguez attended, offering to make me an engagement ring, which I declined as I don’t foresee needing one soon. Vashi’s jewellery from Vashi.com will be featured in Binky’s upcoming shoot. I enjoyed chatting with Jane Felstead before Binky arrived. We get along well, likely because she knows her daughter is wise enough not to get involved with someone like me. Also at the party were Ollie Locke and Rosie Fortescue, both looking impeccable. Surprisingly, Rosie wore high street brands—an H&M skirt, Topshop top, Kooples cape, and Steve Madden shoes. Binky seemed to get on well with new MIC cast member Emma Miller and her friend Victoria Gucci. On fashion, leopard print was the theme for singer Stacey Jackson and me, as we both wore statement shoes. When the DJ played Stacey’s new single 'Dance the Night Away'—which features Binky in the video—we danced along. Emma Miller looked elegant in a backless dress with a choker, accompanied by Victoria Gucci, who wore a tasteful outfit. Most of the guests had left by 10pm, so we took Emma and Victoria in search of an after-party. All the best, Spencer. 'Being Binky' by Binky Felstead is published by Simon & Schuster on 8 May, priced £12.99, and available at Amazon for £6.

Binky, hiriyaa koo Made In Chelsea irratti, namichaa beekamaa sagantaa kanaa dha. Sirna eebbaa irratti miseensotni sagantaa, hiriyoonni, maatiin, fi gareen maxxansaa Simon & Schuster argamuun kitaaba 'Being Binky'—fuula 165 waa'ee jireenya Alexandra 'Binky' Felstead—kabajuuf walii gahan. Hojiin ulfaataa irraa qoodameen booda, kitaabni seenaa ishee dhugummaa fi bareedina qabu. Kitaabni halluu lilaanaa kun, dhimmoota jireenyaa fi jaalala ishee, suuraawwan ijoollummaa, akkasumas gorsa obboleettii dargaggeeyyii dubartii akka dhiira, tuffii, maatii, make up fi kkf irratti dhiyeessa. Kitaabni Binky gorsa akka obboleettii dubartootaatti waa'ee dhiiraa, tuffii fi bareedummaa of keessaa qabu. Sirni eebbaa kunis Emma Miller, Rosie Fortescue, fi Ollie Locke kan dabalatu, miseensota ammaa fi kan durii keessummeesse. Anis Hugo Empson wajjin—kan hojii Grand Tour motora dabalata—sirna bashannanaa jalqabne. Akka Ciroc vodka ciisaa jiru, Binky of eeggannoo godhachuudhaan, 'Skinny Bitch' tokko qofa dhugde—innis vodka, laayimii fi soodaa—hojii suuraa Bluebella dhufuuf Forza Raspberry K2 fayyadamte; nuti garuu ishee caalaa dhugnne. Haadha ishee, Jane, sirna eebbaa irratti argamte. Masakarri beekamaa Vashi Dominguez affeeramanii, ringii narraa tolchu akka barbaadde natti hime; garuu yeroo ammaan tanaaf hin barbaadu jedheen. Masakan Vashi.com irraa Binky suuraa dhuftu irratti fayyada. Duraan, Jane Felstead waliin mari’achu koo bareeda. Walitti galteen keenyaa cimaadha; sababa intaltii ishee nama narraa itti of eeggachuu beektu waan taateef. Sirni eebbaa irratti Ollie Locke fi Rosie Fortescue, uffata bareedaatiin, argamanii turan. Rosie ammoo uwwisa high street—H&M skirt, Topshop top, Kooples cape fi Steve Madden kaphachaa—uffattee turte. Binky waltajjiin ishee Emma Miller fi Victoria Gucci waliin argaa gaarii fi new MIC miseensaa waliin qabaachuu ishee agarsiifte. Faayaan Stacey Jackson fi ana waliin, leopard print theme ta’ee, kaphachaa addaa uffanne. DJ'n sirba haaraa Stacey—‘Dance the Night Away’—kan Binky viidiyoo irratti hirmaatte—fachisiise; nurra gammachuun bashannanne. Emma Miller uffata dugda banaa fi choker faayadamee bareedduu fakkaatte; Victoria Gucci ammoo uffata ofii garaamumaan faayadatte. Namoonni hedduun sa’aatii 10 irratti ba’anii turan, nutis Emma fi Victoria waliin bashannana biraa barbaadnee darbuun murteessine. Galatoomaa, Spencer. article_content: Ozzy Osbourne canceled his concert in Reno, Nevada Sunday night after experiencing a sudden illness, the event’s promoter Live Nation confirmed. Spokesperson Chris Martinez said Osbourne followed doctor’s advice in postponing the performance at the Reno Event Center, but no further details about his condition were revealed. The show has been moved to April. At 62, Osbourne remains active in music. While he’s famous as the frontman of Black Sabbath, his solo career has also thrived, with around 29 million albums sold, according to the Recording Industry Association of America. He found a new audience through the MTV series 'The Osbournes,' which showcased his Birmingham, England roots. Osbourne is in the middle of the U.S. leg of his Scream tour, which will extend to Latin America and Europe. Fans know him for hits like 'Crazy Train,' 'Flying High Again,' and 'Mama, I'm Coming Home.' This Super Bowl week, he will also appear in a TV commercial with pop star Justin Bieber.

article_content: While many children Stella Ehrhart's age are focused on Halloween costumes, this 8-year-old from Nebraska spends her days choosing which influential person to emulate each day of the week. According to her mother, Stella is not just 'dressing up,' but rather 'dressing in character,' using items from her closet and her imagination. With a black dress and a red tissue-paper flower in her hair, Stella becomes jazz legend Billie Holiday. Wearing a flannel shirt and carrying a stuffed chimp, she transforms into Jane Goodall. In a khaki shirt with a toy police badge, she's her Aunt Pam, a police officer. Stella's mother, Stephanie Anderson, says her daughter gravitates toward characters known for resilience and inner strength. Stella's role models come from books, history, and even among family and friends. Remarkably, Stella hasn't repeated a single character since starting this tradition at the beginning of second grade. Inspired by reading Laura Ingalls Wilder's 'Little House' books, Stella first dressed as the author, sparking a daily routine that continued into her third grade year. In a phone interview, Stella explained that she avoids repeating characters to make room for new experiences. 'If I wear the same outfit five times, that's five opportunities missed for a new character,' she said. Many of Stella's character choices are subtle and do not distract from class, her mother notes. In fact, teachers and classmates appreciate learning about the people Stella highlights each day. "I think it's just in her genes," says Anderson, who worked in Omaha's local theater scene before Stella was born. Stella's father directs Omaha's Rose Theater. 'She does everything on her own,' says Anderson. 'We don't buy special costumes; we shop at stores like Target and Goodwill.' Stella shared her five favorite characters and what inspires her about each: -- Harriet Tubman: 'I like that she led people on the Underground Railroad and risked her life to help them.' -- Helen Keller: 'She never gave up on learning, and she kept trying until she learned Braille.' -- Rosa Parks: 'She stood up for fairness by refusing to give up her bus seat.' -- Anne Frank: 'She had to move three times and did whatever was necessary to survive.' -- Jane Addams: 'It's important to help people, especially those in need.' As for Halloween, Stella says she hasn't decided yet and will likely go with whatever character she has in mind that day.

Haati ishee akka jettetti, Stella 'uffata uffachuun' qofaa miti, garuu eenyummaa namaa muuxannoo ishee fi meeshaalee uffata ishee keessa jiraniin calaqqisiisti. Halloween irratti, Stella hanga ammaatti murteessuu baatte; guyyaa sana eenyummaa yaadatetti deemuuf jirti.

article_content: Nigeria’s National Anti-Doping Agency (NADO) has been accused of failing to comply with the World Anti-Doping Code, resulting in a WADA deadline of December 8 to address all issues or face significant consequences. WADA warns that Nigerian athletes could be banned from participating in the Paris 2024 Olympics and other major global competitions if NADO does not comply. WADA has also accused Venezuela and Tunisia of similar non-compliance, with these findings announced during its executive committee meeting in Montreal, Canada last Thursday. The agency noted that Nigeria's anti-doping organization has not resolved several key deficiencies identified in an October 2022 audit. If Nigeria's NADO misses the December 8 deadline, it will lose WADA privileges until all reinstatement conditions are met. Sanctions include being ineligible to host or co-host WADA events, losing access to WADA funding, and exclusion from all WADA programs and committee seats. Nigeria will also lose the right to host regional, continental, or world championships organized by major event bodies and will not have its flag displayed at these events (except the Olympic and Paralympic Games), until it regains compliance.

Kanaaf, WADA NADO’f amma hanga Muddee 8 waggaa kanaa turtii kennee jira, rakkoolee jiraatan yoo hin furuin adabbii cimaa akka irra gahu akeekkachiisee. WADA ni akeeka atileetotni Naayjeeriyaa dorgommii Olompiiksii Paariisii 2024 fi taphoota idil-addunyaa biroo irratti akka hin hirmaanne yoo NADO rakkoowwan hin furuin. Biyyoonni Veenezuweelaa fi Tuuniiziyaas walgahii koree raawwachiiftuu WADA, kan Kamisa darbe Montreal, Kanadaa keessatti geggeeffameen, himatamanii jiru akka seeraa kana hin hordofne. Ibsi WADA akka jedhuutti, NADO Naayjeeriyaa rakkoolee gurguddoo qorannoo Onkoloolessa 2022 ittiin himamee ture furuu hin dandeenye. Yoo NADO hanga Muddee 8tti furuu baate, mirga fi faayidaa WADA irraa qabu hundumaa dhabee, hanga shira sirreeffama guutamee deebitee argatutti turuuf jira. Adabbiiwwan keessaa: NADO taphoota WADA qopheessuu, konfiraansiiti, deeggarsa maallaqaa fi hojii koree WADA irraa hirmaachuuf mirga ni dhabdi. Naayjeeriyaan akkuma kanaan, mirga taphoota naannolee, konteenentii fi addunyaa gaggeessuu ni dhabdi; akkasumas bifa alaa ishee taphoota kanniin irratti hin mul’atu (Olompiiksii fi Paaraolompiiksii ala) hanga hojii barbaachisu raawwatamutti.

article_content: Tiger Woods faces two main challengers as he tries to retain his position as the world's No. 1 golfer for the 271st week at the WGC-Bridgestone Invitational, starting Thursday in Ohio. The 34-year-old has held the top ranking for a record total of 612 weeks. However, Woods could lose his spot to fellow American Phil Mickelson or to world No. 3 Lee Westwood. Mickelson, who is ranked second, did not capitalize on Woods’ recent struggles and finished tied for 48th at the British Open. Meanwhile, Westwood has accumulated points after finishing second at his home major last month. The Englishman could become No. 1 if he wins at Firestone and Woods finishes outside the top two, or if Westwood is second, Woods places 10th or lower, and Mickelson does not win. Mickelson can take over the No. 1 spot if he wins, or if he places in the top four and Woods finishes outside the top 37. "Am I conscious of the competition? Yes, because you remind me at every tournament," Woods told reporters on Wednesday before starting his bid for an eighth title at the event. "How I got here was by playing and winning golf tournaments." Woods will play alongside Westwood for the first two rounds in Akron, with Westwood having finished second in two majors this year and as runner-up at Firestone in 2008 behind Vijay Singh. "I've always enjoyed playing with Westy, he's a great guy. We've been competing against each other for a long time," Woods said of the 37-year-old Westwood, whom he also played with at the U.S. Open in June. "What he’s accomplished in the last few years shows his talent. Almost every big event, we’re paired together—it’s always enjoyable." Woods has dropped out of the U.S. team's automatic qualifying spots for October’s Ryder Cup following a series of poor results, including tying for 23rd at the British Open at St. Andrews, as he has struggled with his putting. "It’s been off all year. I’ve three-putted quite a few times, which is unusual for me, so I had to return to basics and practice more," he said. "I haven’t worked on putting as much as I should have over the last couple of years, so I’m going back to that." Masters champion Mickelson, whose only victory at Firestone came at the 1996 World Series of Golf, will partner young Northern Irishman Rory McIlroy in the first two rounds. U.S. Open champion Graeme McDowell will play with three-time major winner Padraig Harrington, who recently returned to form with second place at last weekend’s Irish Open.

article_content: Excitement in Major League Baseball continues to be overshadowed by doping scandals. Even during a season filled with memorable moments—like Mariano Rivera’s celebrated send-off at the All-Star Game, Chris Davis’s incredible home run streak, Dodgers’ rise with newcomer Yasiel Puig, and strong showings from the Red Sox and Pirates—the announcement of Ryan Braun’s suspension for the remainder of 2013 took center stage. Braun, a Milwaukee Brewers star who once won Rookie of the Year and MVP, had previously avoided punishment after winning an appeal in 2011 over a failed drug test. Now, he accepts his suspension and admits to unspecified mistakes, stating, "I am not perfect." While Braun’s absence doesn’t hugely impact the Brewers’ current season, he remains a pivotal figure to Milwaukee fans and holds a long-term contract through 2020. Despite Major League Baseball’s frequent crackdowns on performance-enhancing drug use, high-profile suspensions persist. Braun’s case isn’t unique—Alex Rodriguez also faces scrutiny linked to the Biogenesis clinic, and Melky Cabrera lost his All-Star MVP title after a positive test. Players like Mariano Rivera stand out as role models for clean competition, but many fans are frustrated as doping issues continue to overshadow the joys of the game. There’s a widespread hope that, someday, attention will shift back to great plays and teams’ true talents—without the shadow of scandal. For now, baseball is urged to keep working toward rebuilding trust as supporters await a future where on-field achievements are all anyone talks about.

Ammaaf, baseballiin amantaa isaa deebisuu fi yemmuu dhufu tapha qofaarratti mari'atamuuf carraaqqii itti fufa.

article_content: Apple’s AirTags, initially lauded for helping users find lost items like wallets and luggage, have become the subject of an expanding lawsuit. Originally filed by two women, the case now includes 37 plaintiffs who argue that AirTags are being misused by stalkers and criminals to track individuals without consent. The central issue revolves around privacy risks the devices pose. One Houston woman, Lauren Hughes, alleges her ex-boyfriend secretly placed an AirTag in the wheel of her car, tracking her to both her hotel and new residence. Plaintiffs argue that due to their small size and affordable price—$29—AirTags are easily concealed and misused. Numerous incidents back these concerns: In 2022, an influencer claimed her movements were tracked after someone hid an AirTag in her coat at a New York City bar. In Canada, police have warned of thieves using AirTags to locate and steal luxury cars. Apple has introduced safety features, including alerts for unknown AirTags in close proximity, pop-up messages clarifying that non-consensual tracking is illegal, random beeping after separation from the owner, and software to disable unrecognized AirTags. Despite these steps, critics argue they fall short of fully safeguarding users. The lawsuit cites several violent events, including deaths tied to AirTag misuse—such as a case in California where an AirTag was used to find and kill a woman, and in Indiana where a woman used an AirTag to track and fatally confront her boyfriend over infidelity suspicions. Apple has not responded to requests for comment regarding the lawsuit.

article_content: Cedar Fair and Six Flags have agreed to merge, creating a large-scale amusement park operator with operations in 17 U.S. states as well as Canada and Mexico. The merged company will be valued at over $3.5 billion and will own 27 amusement parks, 15 water parks, and nine resorts throughout North America. It will also oversee entertainment partnerships and manage popular franchises, such as Looney Tunes, DC Comics, and Peanuts. While amusement parks have seen revenue growth recently, attendance numbers lag behind those from before the pandemic, despite other entertainment sectors recovering. Analyst James Hardiman, from Citi Investment Research, said Six Flags’ pricing and attendance strategies haven't stabilized visitor numbers and may have alienated loyal customers. After the merger, Cedar Fair has reported a slight rise in attendance to 12.4 million over the recent quarter, up 1% from a year ago, while Six Flags has had a 16% increase to 9.3 million visitors, despite ongoing industry difficulties. Since their locations don’t overlap significantly, Cedar Fair and Six Flags expect to reduce costs by $120 million within two years of closing the deal. Attempts to combine the companies in the past failed—Six Flags’ 2019 offer and a recent bid from SeaWorld were both declined by Cedar Fair. According to the terms, Cedar Fair unitholders will get one new share for each unit, while Six Flags shareholders receive 0.58 shares per share owned. Cedar Fair investors will own about 51.2% of the merged business, with Six Flags shareholders holding 48.8%. Richard Zimmerman, Cedar Fair's CEO, will lead the new company as president and CEO, with Six Flags CEO Selim Bassoul becoming executive chairman. The board of directors will have an even split, and while the headquarters will move to Charlotte, North Carolina, significant administrative operations will remain in Sandusky, Ohio. The company will keep the Six Flags name and list on the NYSE under the ticker 'FUN.' Both boards have approved, and the deal is expected to be completed in the first half of next year, subject to Six Flags shareholder approval. Shares in both companies rose by over 9% this week after news of the possible merger.

article_content: Elon Musk has ambitious plans for Tesla’s humanoid robot, Optimus. At Tesla’s annual AI Day last year, the CEO stated the robot could be ready for orders in three to five years, according to Reuters. He added that Optimus is expected to cost significantly less than a car—likely under $20,000. Tesla seems to be accelerating development by hiring, with the company’s careers page listing over 50 jobs mentioning 'Tesla Bot' (also called Optimus) in the job title, as reported by EV news site Electrek. Many of these roles are based in Palo Alto, California, and include positions such as 'Humanoid Controls Engineer, Tesla Bot,' 'Systems Design & Integration Engineer, Tesla Bot,' and others. In a May update on X, Musk noted the 'Optimus Team is making excellent progress.' Last month, Tesla shared a YouTube video highlighting that Optimus can now self-calibrate its arms and legs. The video also shows the robot sorting building blocks by color using its hands, vision system, and Tesla’s onboard neural network. The clip ends with Optimus performing yoga stretches. Despite this progress, Tesla faces competition from US-based robotics companies. Apptronik, based in Texas, launched its Apollo robot in August. Apollo stands over five feet tall and can carry up to 55 pounds. Jeff Cardenas, Apptronik’s cofounder and CEO, told Insider that one or two units of Apollo have been deployed at each customer site. Apptronik, which partnered with NASA last year, is focused on improving the technology before wider deployment. Cardenas said their customers are in retail, manufacturing, and third-party logistics but did not disclose names. Similarly, Agility Robotics is building a factory in Oregon, and its robot Digit is being tested at an Amazon research-and-development center near Seattle. Tesla did not immediately respond to Insider’s request for comment, which was made outside of normal business hours.

Bangalore-based property developer Puravankara Limited reported strong growth in the second quarter of fiscal year 2024, recording sales of Rs 1,600 crores—a 102% increase from the same quarter last year. The company’s sales volume was 2.01 million square feet, up by 89% year-on-year, while collections grew 70% to Rs 879 crores. The average price per square foot rose 7% to Rs 7,947.

According to Managing Director Ashish Puravankara, these results stem from the company’s solid brand presence and varied project offerings. While the overall residential real estate sector grew 6% year-on-year, Puravankara’s pre-sales saw remarkable growth, a sign of strong demand and reliable operations.

For the first half of FY24, operating cash inflows reached Rs 1,756 crores (an increase of 31% year-on-year), and project revenues totaled Rs 368 crores (up 54%). The company delivered 927 units spanning 1.01 million square feet, earning a gross profit of Rs 130 crores. Net loss decreased to Rs 11 crores, improving 45% from last year’s Rs 21 crores in the comparable period, as increased deliveries benefitted revenue booking.

Despite this, high sales and marketing costs, as well as general and administrative expenses totaling Rs 168 crores for planned growth, contributed to a net after-tax loss of Rs 29 crores for the first half of the year.

In the upcoming half, Puravankara aims to deliver nearly 2,500 units (2.5 million sq ft). The company launched the Provident Ecopolitan project in Bengaluru, along with new phases of Purva Park Hill (Bengaluru) and Purva Windermere (Chennai), comprising 2.09 million sq ft of new offerings.

As of Q2 FY24, Puravankara reported Rs 1,992 crores in net debt, with a net debt-to-equity ratio at 1.01 and an average debt cost of 11.61%.

Elsewhere, the Indian economy is forecast to grow 6.7% in the July-September 2023 quarter, supported by the services sector. In telecom, operators are resisting direct-to-mobile TV broadcasting over technological concerns. The government is also considering raising the GST evasion prosecution threshold to Rs 3 crore, to foster a more business-friendly environment.

article_content: The Deputy Minority Leader of the Senate, Dr. Lere Oyewumi, has called for a deliberate plan to address Nigeria’s food production challenges. Speaking in Ikire on Friday at an empowerment programme for the people of Osun West Senatorial District, he facilitated the distribution of 500 bags of fertilizer, 120 motorcycles, and a N25 million grant to women and youths. Oyewumi mentioned that this initiative was developed after consulting with different groups in the Senatorial District to identify their most pressing needs. He explained that the motorcycles would enable beneficiaries to transport farm produce from remote locations, while the fertilizer would help increase agricultural productivity. He emphasized that food insecurity remains a significant problem in the country and highlighted the importance of strategic action. He noted that fertilizer is now essential for farmers, especially with the current ban on its import making it less accessible. Oyewumi pledged that the support would expand in the next planting season to at least a thousand bags of fertilizer to assist rural farmers in boosting their yields. He added that this programme will be held annually, not only providing fertilizer but also including sprayers, chemicals, and improved seedlings, in alignment with his campaign promises.

The Chinese film Finding Mr. Right, inspired by the 1993 American classic Sleepless in Seattle, has become a box office sensation in China, earning around $85 million since its March debut. Drawing from both the visual and narrative elements of Nora Ephron’s film, Finding Mr. Right is set largely in Seattle and has sparked a surge in Chinese tourism to the city as fans seek to recreate the movie’s most memorable moments.

According to Seattle tourism official Janet Christopher, local interest from Chinese visitors has skyrocketed. 'The phones started ringing and haven’t stopped. We have been amazed at the response,' she told KOMO, noting that the attention surpasses even that of Sleepless in Seattle itself. The film’s success led CCTV, China’s national broadcaster, to host a live New Year’s Eve broadcast from Seattle.

Finding Mr. Right stars Tang Wei as JiaJia, a wealthy Beijing businessman’s mistress who travels to Seattle to secretly have his child. In Seattle, she meets Frank, the film’s male lead, and gradually transforms into a better person, echoing the journey seen in Sleepless in Seattle. This romantic story has particularly resonated with young Chinese women, inspiring many to travel to Seattle in hopes of finding their own 'Mr. Right.'

For American audiences, Finding Mr. Right was released in select US theaters in November. Notably, Sleepless in Seattle was itself inspired by the 1957 classic An Affair to Remember.

Fiilmiin kuni karaa akkaata fi dhaamsa Nora Ephron’tiin kennameen, Seattle keessatti bal’inaan geggeeffamee, daawwattoota Chaayinaa heddu bakka filimitii sana ilaaluuf gara magaalaa kanaa akka imalan godheera.

Janet Christopher, hoogganaan tajaajila turiizimii Seattle, akka jedhutti, daawwattoota Chaayinaa irraa dhufan hedduun dabalaa jira. 'Bilbiloonni jalqabanii hin dhaabbanne. Comedy films don’t dominate the box office the way they once did. Many modern comedies bypass theaters altogether and premiere directly on streaming platforms. This shift is unfortunate for some, as watching a comedy in a packed theater can be a uniquely cathartic experience. Yet, we believe the best days for the genre still lie ahead—some of the past five years’ comedies easily stand alongside classics from the ’80s, ’90s, and 2000s.

For this list of five standout comedies released between 2018 and 2023, we stuck strictly to titles launched within that window, whether in theaters or on streaming. Interestingly, no comedies from 2020 or 2021 made our final cut, but we are confident these five films will endure.

“No Hard Feelings” isn’t Jennifer Lawrence’s first foray into comedy, but she fully commits to the role of Maddie Barker—a woman struggling after her car is impounded, leaving her unable to work as an Uber driver. Desperate for cash, Maddie responds to an unusual Craigslist ad from Laird (Matthew Broderick) and Allison Becker (Laura Benanti), who offer her money to date their introverted son, Percy (Andrew Barth Feldman), before he leaves for college. Maddie’s attempts to seduce him largely fail, as Percy seems oblivious, and he remains unaware of her true motivations. “No Hard Feelings” is now available on Netflix.

In “Game Night,” Max and Annie Davis (Jason Bateman and Rachel McAdams) are an ultra-competitive couple who regularly host elaborate game nights with friends. When Max’s overachieving brother Brooks (Kyle Chandler) takes over organizing the next event, the group is shocked when he is suddenly kidnapped by armed criminals. Initially assuming it’s an immersive part of the game, Max and Annie soon realize the danger is real and have to rescue Brooks. You can watch “Game Night” on The Roku Channel.

“Weird: The Al Yankovic Story” is a biopic parody starring Daniel Radcliffe as Weird Al, with Diedrich Bader voicing the older version. Rather than sticking to the facts, the film invents outrageous events from Al’s life, focusing on his love of song parodies. Notable appearances include Rainn Wilson as Dr. Demento and Evan Rachel Wood as Madonna. The film leans into irreverent, relentless silliness from beginning to end. Stream it on The Roku Channel.

Netflix’s “To All the Boys I’ve Loved Before” spawned sequels and a TV spinoff, thanks to the original’s charm and wit. Lana Condor stars as Lara Jean, a shy high schooler whose secret love letters are accidentally sent to past crushes—including Peter (Noah Centineo) and Josh (Israel Broussard). To save face, she agrees to a fake relationship with Peter, only to find real feelings developing. “To All the Boys I’ve Loved Before” is available on Netflix.

Olivia Wilde’s directorial debut, “Booksmart,” stars Beanie Feldstein and Kaitlyn Dever as two studious friends, Molly Davidson and Amy Antsler. On the eve of graduation, they realize they’ve focused too heavily on academics and decide to cut loose at a party. Their quest for fun proves complicated, challenging their friendship and opening them up to new experiences. “Booksmart” can be streamed on Freevee.

article_content: According to IDC India, Xiaomi, together with its sub-brand Poco, secured the top spot in India's smartphone market by volume for the September quarter, achieving a 17.4% market share. Poco's year-on-year growth reached 50% during this period. Xiaomi India saw its 5G smartphone sales rise by 200% year-on-year during the Diwali season, primarily due to strong demand from smaller towns for affordable 5G models introduced earlier in the year. The company credits this surge to the expansion of 5G services by Bharti Airtel and Reliance Jio, as well as increased live-streaming of cricket matches. Xiaomi India's President, Muralikrishnan B, highlighted robust demand beyond metro areas. The top sales cities were Delhi, Mumbai, Ahmedabad, Kozhikode, and Surat. Muralikrishnan noted that Xiaomi has made a significant recovery from the difficulties faced in 2022 and is poised to end 2023 with renewed momentum. The company's advancement in market ranking is attributed to a clear strategy and solid execution. He emphasized that Xiaomi's main priorities are now building trust, focusing on efficiency, and practicing sustainability, rather than just aiming to be the leading brand by market share. The company will continue to work on premium products and expanding offline sales. Looking ahead, Xiaomi sees India's 5G market—with over 500 million potential users—as a major opportunity, and plans to announce further initiatives to reinforce 5G adoption within the next month. Additionally, Xiaomi's TV business grew by about 30% year-on-year during the same period, driven by the Cricket World Cup and seasonal festivals. There was a notable trend of customers upgrading from 32-inch to 43-inch 4K panels, with this segment growing over 75% year-on-year. Xiaomi plans to leverage its large smartphone customer base to expand in the Artificial Intelligence of Things (AIoT) sector, considering it a key growth area beyond traditional smartphone market share. In broader business news, India's IPO market is experiencing high enthusiasm, with recent offers from Tata Technologies, Flair Writing Industries, and Gandhar Oil Refinery fully subscribed within hours of opening. IndiGo is set to introduce a premium class of seats, enhanced meal options, and a loyalty program by the end of 2024, targeting more business customers. Since the adoption of the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code (IBC), creditors have withdrawn over 26,500 insolvency cases, involving defaults totaling ₹9.33 lakh crore, before these cases reached adjudication.

article_content: Luke Shaw, aged 19, is set to make his official debut for Manchester United this Saturday when the team faces West Ham at Old Trafford. Signed from Southampton in the summer for £30 million, Shaw missed the start of the season due to a hamstring injury but has recently returned to full fitness. His anticipated inclusion in the starting lineup is, in part, a response to United’s ongoing defensive difficulties. Manager Louis van Gaal plans to shift Marcos Rojo into central defense, creating an opportunity for Shaw at left back. During United’s pre-season tour in the United States, Shaw’s fitness was closely monitored, and Van Gaal put him through additional training after noting his condition wasn’t ideal following the World Cup with England. Shaw’s limited playing time so far this season has fueled speculation that Van Gaal might not have full confidence in the young defender, an opinion echoed by former United coach Rene Meulensteen. Now fully recovered, Shaw is ready to compete for his place in the team.

article_content: President Bola Tinubu will present the 2024 Appropriation Bill to a joint session of the National Assembly on Wednesday, following approval by the Federal Executive Council (FEC) of a N27.5 trillion budget for 2024, up from N26.01 trillion previously considered. The Minister of Budget and Economic Planning, Abubakar Bagudu, made this announcement after FEC’s weekly meeting chaired by President Tinubu at Aso Rock Villa, Abuja. Bagudu stated that the Federal Government expects to generate N18.32 trillion in revenue for the 2024 fiscal year, with further details to be revealed during the President's presentation. Bagudu explained that the Medium Term Expenditure Framework (MTEF), already passed by the National Assembly, has been reviewed by the Council. The updated MTEF sets the exchange rate at N750 to $1 and the benchmark crude oil price at $77.96 per barrel, both increases from earlier estimates. He highlighted that government revenue projections have gone up while the deficit for 2024 will be lower than in 2023. Further details, including key features of the 'Renewed Hope' budget, are to be disclosed during the President's address to the National Assembly. Additionally, Minister of Finance Wale Edun announced the approval of a $1 billion concessionary loan from the African Development Bank (AfDB) for general budget support and to boost availability of foreign exchange. The loan has a 4.2% interest rate, 25-year maturity, and an eight-year grace period. Edun noted the progress of the Fiscal Policy and Tax Reform Committee, focusing on increasing the tax-to-GDP ratio to 18% through digitization, increased efficiency, and rationalization of taxes. Other economic measures are also under consideration. To further strengthen fiscal stability, the FEC has authorized the Ministry of Finance to utilize up to N2 trillion for market operations, which is expected to reduce government debt servicing costs by approximately N50 billion or more through refinancing at lower rates. Dr. Ali Barde Umoru, Secretary of Research and Information at the National Assembly, confirmed preparations for the budget presentation. President Tinubu had previously submitted the 2024–2026 MTEF and Fiscal Strategy Paper to both legislative chambers proposing N26.1 trillion for 2024. Speaker of the House of Representatives, Tajudeen Abbas, confirmed the upcoming budget presentation and announced plans for a Budget Town Hall Meeting, enabling citizens to provide input. He emphasized the House’s dedication to inclusivity and timely budget passage. Acknowledging challenges faced by parliamentary committees, leaders called for improved resources to bolster oversight and legislative effectiveness. Lawmakers, including Oluwole Oke and Sunday Umeha, expressed support for a thorough, deliberate budget process under President Tinubu’s team, and affirmed parliament’s commitment to passing the 2024 budget in the best interest of Nigerians.

Bagudu akka ibsetti, Medium Term Expenditure Framework (MTEF) Mana Maree Bakka Bu'ootaa irra darbe gareen ministaera irraa ni ilaallame. Ministeerri Maallaqaa, Wale Edun, liqii $1 biliyoonaa deeggarsa baajataaf AfDB irraa argame mirkaneesse, gabaabaatti haala qarshii biyya keessaa foyyeessuuf oolu jedha. Duraan dursee Prezidaantichi MTEF fi mala dinagdee waggaa sadiif Mana Maree erge, kan bara 2024f N26.1 Tiriliyoonaa lafa kaayyeffame. Afyaa'ii Mana Maree Bakka Bu'ootaa, Tajudeen Abbas, dhiheessii baajataa fi marii ummata waliin taasisuuf karoorri jiru ibse. article_content: Mariah Carey has cemented her reputation as the 'Queen of Christmas' thanks to the ongoing popularity of her classic holiday song, 'All I Want for Christmas Is You.' On November 25, 2023, the song returned to the Billboard Hot 100 at No. 17. Since its release, it has accumulated 59 weeks on the chart—a testament to its enduring appeal. With the holiday season starting, the track is expected to climb even higher, already boasting 14 million official streams (a 29% increase) and 7.6 million in radio airplay (a notable 333% jump), according to Luminate. Originally featured on Carey's first holiday album, 'Merry Christmas' (released in 1994), the song was not eligible for the Billboard Hot 100 at the time because it was not commercially available as a physical single. Chart rules changed in 1998, and 'All I Want for Christmas Is You' finally reached the top in December 2019, making it only the second holiday song to hit No. 1 after David Seville & the Chipmunks’ 'The Chipmunk Song.' The song has surpassed the Chipmunks, holding the No. 1 spot for a total of 12 weeks over several years, and is now the highest-charting holiday single ever by a solo artist. Mariah Carey also stands out as the first artist to win No. 1 hits in four different decades and has spent the most cumulative weeks atop the Hot 100, ahead of artists like Rihanna, The Beatles, Drake, and Michael Jackson. In total, Carey boasts 19 Billboard Hot 100 No. 1 singles, including 'Vision of Love,' 'Emotions,' 'One Sweet Day,' and 'We Belong Together.' She has the most No. 1s for a solo artist, while The Beatles retain the overall record. Financially, 'All I Want for Christmas Is You' brings in significant royalties—estimates range from $2.5 million to $3 million per year, with total earnings surpassing $60 million by 2017, according to The Economist and The New York Post. Carey's revenue is likely to increase further this holiday season with her 'Merry Christmas One and All!' tour, running from November 15 to December 17, and through partnerships with brands like The Children’s Place, Barbie, and Victoria’s Secret.

article_content: Ashley Oldham, an avid fan of Oldham Athletic from Dallas, Texas, traveled 4,600 miles to see her team face Rochdale live. Currently, Oldham Athletic are 14th in League One, enduring a run of three straight defeats. Luckily, there's still time for Ashley to see them play, as the club hosts Doncaster Rovers the following Saturday. Oldham has notable FA Cup history, including forcing a fifth round replay against Everton in 2013, with Matt Smith playing a big role.

article_content: A mother and daughter were rescued early this morning after a fire broke out in a £4 million mansion on Campden Grove, Kensington, London. The home, which was undergoing renovations, was engulfed by flames as more than 70 firefighters responded to the scene around 6am. Neighbors described evacuating as smoke and debris entered nearby properties. The mansion's owner reportedly arrived about four hours after the fire started and was visibly distressed. At its height, smoke from the blaze was visible from London Heathrow Airport, approximately 13 miles away. In a neighboring home, Ronda Challoy and her eight-year-old daughter Arlette were rescued by firefighters after their roof caught fire. Fearing the flames at the front entrance, they retreated to the garden, where firefighters used a ladder to help them to safety over a fence. Alan Challoy and his employer, Alasdair Nagle, exited with two dogs through the front of the house. Firefighters managed to control the fire, but the three-storey Georgian mansion was described as 'looking like a chimney' after being gutted. Some adjacent homes experienced smoke and minor fire damage. The affected mansion, reportedly owned by a French couple with two young children, was unoccupied at the time. Renovations included stripping paint from the exterior, installing a new basement, and a new roof. London Fire Brigade Station Manager Rhodri Horton noted that the fire had already spread from the basement to the roof when crews arrived. Firefighters had to enter neighboring properties to prevent the flames from spreading further. A spokesman for London Fire Brigade said ten fire engines and 72 firefighters responded. The entire three-storey building was alight, with part of a neighboring property's roof also on fire. Fire crews from several nearby stations attended the scene. Most residents escaped unharmed, although one neighboring family was rescued, and there was a fear that a family with a baby may have been inside another property, but it is believed that they were away at the time.

article_content: Professor John Ashton has resigned from his position as president of the Faculty of Public Health after a heated exchange on Twitter. Ashton, an independent Government health adviser, stepped aside following the incident in which he sent offensive messages to e-cigarette supporters online. Known for his strong opposition to e-cigarettes, Professor Ashton used inappropriate language, including referring to a user with profane terms and making derogatory remarks comparing e-cigarette users to former schoolmates. The debate centered on the benefits and risks of e-cigarettes, with supporters suggesting they help smokers quit, while opponents like Professor Ashton caution about their long-term effects and suggest the tobacco industry is targeting young people. During the Twitter exchange, Professor Ashton stated he was being targeted by e-cigarette advocates and accused some of supporting the industry. He directed further offensive comments at several users. As president of the Faculty of Public Health, Ashton provided independent advice to Government ministers on public health issues. The Faculty released a statement apologizing unreservedly for Professor Ashton’s remarks, stating that his behavior personalized a public health debate inappropriately and was under investigation. Professor Ashton later tweeted his regret, saying he was sorry for his choice of language and any offence caused.

article_content:
Few matches in the football calendar encapsulate the extremes of the Premier League quite like Burnley versus Chelsea: West London sophistication against Lancashire determination. Just a year ago, Burnley played Yeovil Town at a half-full Turf Moor, considered likely candidates for relegation from the Championship. Their supporters would scarcely have imagined what was to come. Now, as they host Jose Mourinho’s Chelsea—a team of global stars worth hundreds of millions—the stadium will be packed and watched by a worldwide audience.

The contrast is dramatic. This time last year, Burnley’s squad cost just about £5 million to assemble, with players like Michael Duff signed for £30,000 and Danny Ings for £900,000. Chelsea’s starting lineup, in comparison, cost over £200 million, including summer recruit Diego Costa (£32m), Cesc Fabregas (£30m), and Filipe Luis (£16m).

It is reminiscent of Burnley’s previous Premier League appearance, when they beat Manchester United 1-0 at Turf Moor five years ago—Robbie Blake scored the winner that night, sending the stands into celebration. If Burnley produced another surprise against Chelsea, the atmosphere would be just as electric.

Burnley’s team is built on resilience and team spirit, guided by Sean Dyche (nicknamed 'The Ginger Mourinho'), who has inspired his players—many free transfers, experienced league players, and former cast-offs—to defy expectations. To prepare for the challenge of staying in the Premier League, they've even worked with a sports psychologist.

Chelsea enters the match as clear favorites, with Mourinho expected to deliver success after a trophy-less season. Yet Burnley’s defensive veteran, Michael Duff, will face Diego Costa, highlighting the enormous difference in resources between the clubs. Duff has worked his way up through all levels of English football, celebrating a decade at Turf Moor, while Costa arrives as a marquee signing from Atlético Madrid with World Cup and Champions League experience.

Jason Shackell, Burnley’s captain and Duff’s defensive partner, is confident in their ability to handle the challenge. He points to their strong defensive record and the freedom that comes from being underdogs: "With the pressure off, we can give everything and see what happens."

Only Michael Duff remains from the last Burnley team to face Chelsea at Turf Moor in 2010; John Terry's late header secured a 2-1 win for the visitors. Much remains unchanged: Chelsea are again among the title contenders, Burnley are expected to struggle, but the Premier League has a reputation for surprises.

article_content: The Indian Air Force’s Suryakiran aerobatics team is set to perform an aerial show at the ICC Cricket World Cup 2023 Final, happening this Sunday at Ahmedabad’s Narendra Modi Stadium. Prime Minister Narendra Modi is likely to attend, along with several well-known politicians, sports stars, and celebrities, such as Sachin Tendulkar, Virender Sehwag, Amitabh Bachchan, Rajinikanth, Kamal Haasan, and others. The much-awaited match between India and Australia is expected to draw a record crowd of about 140,000 people to the stadium, marking a memorable occasion for the world’s largest cricket venue. Established in 1996, Suryakiran is the Indian Air Force’s aerobatics demonstration team and is part of its 52nd Squadron, usually flying nine aircraft at shows. They have practice sessions planned for Friday and Saturday at 1:30 pm ahead of the big event. The Narendra Modi Stadium, first opened in 1982 and fully reimagined by 2021, is a modern facility covering 63 acres with over 130,000 seats, numerous team amenities, and luxury boxes. The stadium has witnessed several historic cricket moments, like Sunil Gavaskar’s 10,000th Test run, Kapil Dev’s record for most Test wickets, and memorable matches such as India vs Australia in the 2011 World Cup quarterfinal. It also hosted Sachin Tendulkar’s 30,000th international run and high-profile occasions including the ‘Namaste Trump’ event in 2020. During previous big matches, artists like Arijit Singh and Sunidhi Chauhan have performed, enhancing the overall experience for fans.

article_content: Walter Crompton, 83, was held in a cell for seven hours and required to give DNA samples after being accused of poisoning his wife, Eileen, whom he has been married to for 60 years. Mr. Crompton, a grandfather, was arrested and initially barred from seeing his wife after he applied a prescription painkiller patch to her arm while visiting her at Allendale Care Home in Blackley, Manchester. Eileen, who suffers from dementia and arthritis, had complained of severe discomfort, prompting Walter, who had been her sole carer for 15 years, to try to help. Care home staff contacted police because the patch contained morphine. Four days later, Mr. Crompton was arrested on suspicion of administering a noxious substance. He was detained for seven hours, had his fingerprints and DNA taken, and his home was searched. He was interviewed at midnight and released at 1am but was not allowed to contact his wife as part of his bail conditions. Over the following months, Mr. Crompton lost weight and struggled to sleep. His bail conditions were later relaxed so that he could see Eileen, but only if accompanied by a social worker, which was not always possible. This limited his contact with his wife to only a few days a week. After a two-month investigation, Greater Manchester Police cleared Mr. Crompton of any wrongdoing, and all allegations were dropped. Police explained that the investigation aimed to safeguard Eileen due to her health vulnerabilities. Detective Superintendent Joanne Rawlinson noted that a thorough investigation was necessary to protect potential victims. The Crown Prosecution Service concluded there was insufficient evidence to charge Mr. Crompton. A spokesperson for Allendale Care Home stated they strictly follow guidelines regarding patient care and protection to ensure residents receive the highest standard of care.

Christine Edun, 55, is a forensic psychiatric nurse from Formby, Merseyside, who wholeheartedly embraces the 1940s lifestyle. Since her teenage years, Christine has dedicated herself to seeking out authentic period clothing, furniture, and memorabilia. Her passion for the era extends to every part of her life, including her home, which is decorated entirely in the style of the 1940s.

With support from her husband Ray, 58, a mechanical marine engineer, Christine has restored a 1946 Rolls Royce and regularly attends vintage-themed events such as lindy-hop tea dances. Driven by her love for the delicate elegance of 1940s fashion, she founded Femme Fatale, an online business selling period-inspired lingerie.

While her husband Ray and adult children Jay (28), Yvette and Gemma (25, twins), support her lifestyle, Christine is the only one in her household fully committed to living this way. She consistently wears 1940s clothing both at work and at home and styles her hair and makeup to reflect the era, sitting at her Edwardian dressing table each morning to perfect Victory rolls and classic red lipstick.

Christine's admiration for the decade is rooted in her family's experience during World War II and a respect for the era's community spirit and fashion. She treasures the femininity and sophistication of 1940s attire, especially lingerie, which inspired her business. Although she sometimes receives curious glances due to her style, Christine considers her home a peaceful haven that allows her to embrace a simpler, more genteel time.

Along with collecting antiques and attending vintage fairs, Christine has built a social circle with friends who equally appreciate 1940s culture, often gathering at era-inspired events. Her lifestyle choice reflects nostalgia, individuality, and an appreciation for the aesthetics and values of a bygone era.

article_content: Ray Rice, previously a running back for the Baltimore Ravens, is seeking to return to the NFL and to claim the $3.5 million salary he says is rightfully his. Rice was removed from the team after a video emerged of him assaulting his then-fiancée, Janay Palmer (now his wife), in an elevator. While Rice acknowledges he broke the NFL’s domestic violence policy, he points out the agreed punishment is a two-game suspension, and that being dismissed goes beyond that, potentially constituting double punishment for the same violation. In his formal grievance, Rice relies on the NFL collective bargaining agreement, which prohibits penalizing a player twice for a single infraction. He has filed official complaints against both the Ravens and the NFL to contest his dismissal and indefinite suspension. Legal experts indicate that existing league policies may give Rice a strong case. Winning either grievance would result in Rice receiving his base salary; losing both would mean no further payments under his contract. Rice's appeal on reinstatement is set for November 5 and 6 and will be overseen by former U.S. District Judge Barbara S. Jones, acting as an independent arbiter. Another key development is that NFL Commissioner Roger Goodell could be required to testify at the hearing, although the league prefers that officials like general counsel Jeff Pash and vice president for labor policy Adolpho Birch (both of whom met previously with Rice's representatives) appear instead. The resolutions of these grievances will determine whether Rice remains indefinitely suspended and if he will collect the remainder of his salary. The process has brought renewed focus to the consistency and fairness of NFL disciplinary actions.

Rice erga viidiyoo inni haadha manaa isaa turte (ammaa niiti isaa taate) Janay Palmer rukute ifatti ba'ee booda garee irraa ari'ame. Yakki seeraa garee fi NFL irratti dhiheessuus, kufaatii fi adabbii xumura malee irratti murtaa’e mormaa jira. article_content: David Berglas, one of the most influential magicians and mentalists of the 20th century, has died at the age of 97. The Magic Circle, widely regarded as the world’s most prestigious magic society, confirmed that Berglas passed away in London on Friday night. Known as the ‘International Man of Mystery’, Berglas made history as the first magician to host his own British television programme, ‘Meet David Berglas’, in 1954. His son, Marvin, described him as a ‘giant in the magic fraternity’. In the 1980s, Berglas presented a second television series, ‘The Mind of David Berglas’, where he performed for celebrities such as Omar Sharif, Christopher Lee, and Britt Ekland. Throughout the decades, Berglas appeared frequently on British television and radio, becoming a household name for his daring feats—including driving a car blindfolded through London. He was especially renowned for devising the ‘Berglas Effect’, a card trick that allowed him to locate a spectator’s chosen playing card at any number in the deck. This trick is considered by many as the ‘holy grail’ of magic effects, with Berglas taking the secret to his grave. Born to Jewish-German parents who fled Nazi Germany in the 1930s, Berglas later worked with US military intelligence after World War II before settling in Bradford, where he studied textiles, according to the Jewish Bradford Heritage Group. In 2018, Berglas was appointed an MBE for his remarkable contributions to magic and psychology. Reflecting on the honour, he said, ‘I am delighted to accept this honour but even more pleased that the art of magic has at last been recognised. I have spent over 60 years entertaining people in person, on radio and television—reading their minds—but I certainly didn’t see this one coming.’ Marvin Berglas described his father as a pioneer, noted for his originality, creativity, and showmanship. ‘His mysteries have not only baffled audiences but also his peers. However, to us, his family, he will always be best remembered as a loving husband, father and grandfather.’ Illusionist Derren Brown praised Berglas as ‘one of our greatest living magical performers’ upon the awarding of his MBE, stating, ‘Generations of magicians owe him a debt of gratitude. Each of my shows is indebted to his artistry and astonishing body of work. The Magic Circle, waldaa siinqeewwan addunyaa keessatti beekamaan, Jimaata galgala London keessatti Berglas du’u isaa mirkaneesse. Kan 'International Man of Mystery' jedhamee beekamu, Berglas bara 1954 sagantaa siinqee TV biyya Ingiliizii mataa isaa 'Meet David Berglas' jalqabe. Ilmi isaa Marvin abbaa isaa akka 'giant in the magic fraternity' ibse. Bara 1980’ti, Berglas sagantaa TV isa lammataa, 'The Mind of David Berglas', geggeesse; irratti namaa beekkamaa akka Omar Sharif, Christopher Lee fi Britt Ekland waliin bashannansiise. Yeroo dheeraaf, Berglas TV fi raadiyoo Ingilizii irratti baay’ee argamuu fi hojii ajaa’ibaa isaa, isaan keessaa konkolaataa London keessa ija cufamee oofu, keessummeessuun beekamaadha. Inni siinqee keessaa kan baay’ee beekamaa, 'Berglas Effect' jedhamee waamamu, naamusa nama hirmaataa filatame bakka barbaadameetti kaardii galchee argachiisuu danda’a. Kallattii siinqee kanaa baay’iin akka ‘holy grail’tti ilaalaa jiru, Berglas immoo dhoksa kana du’a isaa waliin fudhate. Berglas, maatii isaarraa haadholii Yahuudota Jarman kan bara 1930 keessa Naaziin biyyattii gadhiisaniin dhalate. Erga Addunyaa Lammaffaa booda tajaajila basaasa waraana Ameerikaa keessa tajaajiluun, gara Bradford deemuun meeshaa daldalaa barate, akka Jewish Bradford Heritage Group jedhutti. Bara 2018tti, Berglas hojiiwwan ajaa’ibaa siinqee fi qorannoo sammuu irratti qabuuf MBE’n badhaafame. Badhaasa kana fuula ilaalchisee, akkana jedhe: 'Badhaasa kanaan gammada, garuu siinqeen ammas beekamtii argachuun guddaa natti fakkaata. Waggaa 60 oliif namoota fuuldura, raadiyoo fi TV irratti bashannansiisa turen—hafuura isaanii ‘dubbisuun’—garuu badhaasa kanaan eeggachuus hin dandeenye.' Marvin Berglas abbaa isaa akka fakkeenyaatti, uumamaa fi muuxannoo akkasumas ogummaa isaarraa beekamuu isaa ibse. ‘Sirna isaa baay’ee siinqeewwan birattis guyyaa qaba. Garuu maatii keenyaaf, inni ainaan abbaa mana gaarii, abbaa fi akaakayyuu jaallatamaa ta’ee yaadatama’ jedhe. Illusionist Derren Brown yeroo MBE’n badhaafamu, 'Berglas namoota siinqeewwan guddaadha' jedhe, akkasumas 'Dargaggoota magicians hedduun galata isaan irraa qabu. Sagantaalee kiyya hunda irratti ogummaa fi hojii isaa ajaa’ibsiisaa miira natti gale. Hamilee isaa eegaa tureef galateeffadha,' jedhe. article_content: During a high-level EU meeting in Vilnius, Prime Minister David Cameron challenged leading EU officials after Employment Commissioner Laszlo Andor criticized the UK’s plan to limit migrant welfare benefits. Andor suggested these plans could damage Britain’s reputation in Europe. Cameron labeled Andor’s comments as inappropriate for his office and brought the issue to EU Commission President Jose Manuel Barroso. Emphasizing the need for stronger reforms to the EU’s freedom of movement rules, Cameron argued that member states should avoid repeating past mistakes, like giving new EU members unrestricted job access in other countries. He stated that public concerns about migration should be addressed seriously by EU officials. Home Secretary Theresa May supported this stance, advocating for measures to restrict EU migration as a way to assist unemployed Britons. However, May acknowledged that significant economic disparities across EU countries continue to motivate migration to the UK despite policy changes, such as restricting welfare access and introducing health service fees for migrants. France and Germany have also indicated a willingness to reconsider free movement policies amid growing immigration concerns. May detailed actions the UK has taken, including restricting visas for non-EU workers and families, closing fraudulent colleges, and generally reducing non-EU immigration. Recent migration figures show net migration at 182,000 for the year ending June 2013—a drop from the 2010 peak but higher than the previous year. While non-EU net migration continues to fall, migration from within the EU remains a pressing challenge. May concluded that future policies could include requiring new EU members to attain certain economic benchmarks before being granted full freedom of movement.

Andor bittaa faayidaa baqattoota irratti murtoon qoratamu kun maqaa Briteen balleessuu danda’a jedhe. Cameron immoo yaada Andor ‘maqaaf hin malle’ jedhee, akka Komishinarri kun ifatti qoratamu fi komishinaricha ol’aanaa Jose Manuel Barroso biratti yeroo isaa gaafatee jira. Cameron seera sochii bilisaa namooma EU irratti jijjiirama cimaan barbaachisaa jedhe, miseensa biyyoota haaraa hojii biyya biraa irratti dantaa malee akka argatan akka hin taane dhorku barbaachisaa jedhe. Yaadota uummataa dhaga’uu fi ijoo godhachuun barbaachisaa ta'uu dubbate. Theresa May, sekreterii mootummaa dhimma keessa fi alaa UK, yaada kana deeggarte. Sochii baqattoota EU murteessuuf waan barbaachisu hojjachuu qabna jette, hojii dhabdoota Briteen fayyaduu danda’a jedhamuun. May garuu, garaagarummaa diinagdee biyyoota EU irratti jiru baqattoonni Briteeniif itti dheeratan, faayidaa fi tajaajila fayyaa irrattis murtoo haaraa mootummaan galchaa jiru ibsite. Faransaayii fi Jarmanis kennaa seeraa sochii namoomaa irratti qooda fudhachuuf fedhii qaban agarsiisan. May tarkaanfii mootummaa UK akka fakkeenyaatti: hayyama hojii biyya alaa murteessuu, hayyama maatii cufuus, fi kolleejjii sobaa cufuudhaan baqattoota biyya alaatii dhufan hir’isu ibsite. Lakkoofsi baqattootaa yeroo dhihoo bara 2013 hanga Waxabajjii irratti, walitti bu’iinsa baqattootaa 182,000 irratti hirkata, yeroo dursaa irra gad bu'uun qabaatus lakkoofsa bara darbe irra ol ta'uu agarsiisa. May filannoon fuulduraaf hojii bilisaa argachuu dura, miseensa haaraa EU sadarkaa diinagdee barbaachisu gahuu qaban jedhamuun murtoon akka kennamuu qabu yaada dabalatte.

article_content: Air travelers across the country are relieved that they might reach their destinations on time after Congress took steps to roll back part of the automatic spending cuts that led to furloughs among air traffic controllers. With a 2,300-mile commute, I understand how travelers felt when delays almost tripled, reaching nearly 9,000 by Thursday evening. I am glad air traffic controllers are back to work full-time. However, I am not reassured that Congress only gave the Obama administration the authority to end furloughs, yet has taken no action for the many Americans still suffering the consequences of these cuts. Congress made a temporary fix when the sequestration issue needs comprehensive reform. In my district and across the country, children are being turned away from early education programs like Head Start. Kids in military communities are especially affected because federal support for their schools has been cut. Communities also report that budget cuts are forcing them to remove some seniors from Meals on Wheels. Last week, business travelers and vacationers drew Congress’s attention. On Friday morning, just before many in Congress left for a weeklong district work period, the House of Representatives voted to end air traffic controller furloughs. Air travelers can now expect more reliable service. Still, children in my district who have lost their school bus can’t simply fly to class. When Congress passed sequestration, it was seen as an unacceptable option with serious consequences that would require a replacement. Members from both sides warned about the potential harm. Yet, Republicans seemed surprised by the flight delays caused by the cuts and blamed President Obama. It is unrealistic to expect to cut more than $600 million from the FAA in six months and not affect air travel. Similarly, cutting 4 million meals for seniors, as the White House reported, would obviously hurt them. America saw last week on CNN that the sequester has real impacts. While members of Congress may not get many calls about 4-year-olds being turned away from Head Start, those problems persist. The voices of these children and seniors might not have been as loud as those of air travelers, but their struggles are greater. Congress should pass legislation to replace the entire sequester with a balanced approach that includes spending cuts, slower growth of future spending, and new revenues. Congress created this problem, and we need to solve it. The views expressed here are solely those of Rick Larsen.

article_content: MARSEILLE, France: England rugby coach Steve Borthwick faces an important decision for the upcoming Rugby World Cup quarter-final against Fiji. There is debate about whether he will keep Owen Farrell in the starting lineup after England’s narrow 18-17 win over Samoa. Farrell started at inside centre, then moved to flyhalf in the second half when George Ford was substituted. Both Farrell and the team had an error-filled performance, with Danny Care scoring a late try to secure the victory. Borthwick must decide if he will continue with the Ford-Farrell partnership at 10/12—a combination that was highly successful in the previous World Cup but was used for the first time in a long period, possibly since the 2019 World Cup, against Samoa. Alternatively, he could revert to Ford at flyhalf, a setup that led to two man-of-the-match performances while Farrell was serving a suspension. Since becoming coach, Borthwick has consistently supported Farrell as captain, only briefly benching him in the 2021 Six Nations to give Marcus Smith an opportunity. Farrell soon returned as first-choice flyhalf. After Saturday’s match, Borthwick praised Farrell for surpassing Jonny Wilkinson as England’s all-time leading points scorer, saying: “It’s testament to a man who dedicates himself to being the best player, leader, and person he can be. He is an incredible role model, and it’s a privilege to coach him. I look forward to seeing him continue to represent England.” This commendation makes it unlikely that Borthwick will drop Farrell for the crucial game against Fiji, especially given his careful approach to significant lineup changes. When asked about Marcus Smith starting after his energetic performance off the bench at fullback, Borthwick said: “We’re accelerating progress, learning from every minute on the pitch and in training. We haven’t been able to try many different combinations recently.” England are expected to rely on tactical discipline and strong defence against Fiji, as shown in their controlled win over Argentina. They are unlikely to play an open, high-paced game like Portugal did against the Fijians. Against Argentina, Ford controlled the game and scored three drop goals. Farrell is also skilled at directing play with tactical kicking, and moving him to flyhalf could strengthen England’s midfield defence. Borthwick, like his predecessors Eddie Jones and Stuart Lancaster, values having key leaders like Farrell on the field. He commented: “The big players perform on the big stages. Everyone is looking forward to Sunday in Marseille.”

Deebiin Owen Farrell tapha jalqabaa keessatti akka taphatu ilaalchisee falmiin jira – Ingilaandiin mo’ii dhiphoo 18 irratti 17 Samoaa irra galmeessiteetti. Farrell marsaa jalqabaa keessatti taphatee, booda George Ford bakka bu’e yeroo hafu gara flyhalf jijjiirrame. Farrell fi gareen walumaa galatti dogoggora hedduu raawwataa turan, taasisa dhumaa Danny Care galmeessuun mo’icha isaaniitiif gargaare. Haalli fayyadamuu walitti dhufeewwan adda addaaf carraan xiqqaa ture." Ingilaandiin eegamaa jirti tooftaa seera-qabeessa fi ittisaa jabaa irra bu’uureeffattee Fiji waliin taphattu – akkasuma akka tapha Argentina irratti agarsiiftetti. Akkuma Portugal Fijii waliin tapha daddaffaan taphatte akka hayyamtu hin eegamtu. Taphni Argentina irratti, Ford tapha guutuu to’ate, drop goal sadihii galche. Farrellis tapha karaa toftaawaa mo’achuu danda’a, bakka flyhalf irra jiru ittisaa keessaa Ingilaandii cimsuu ni danda’a. Borthwick akkuma leenjistoota isa dura Eddie Jones fi Stuart Lancaster, hoogganoonni tapha keessaa akka Farrell bakka sanatti taphatan ni barbaada. Akka jedhetti: "Taphattoonni guddoon iddoo guddaa irratti tapha gaarii agarsiisu. Hunduu Sanbata dhufuu Marseille taphichatti eeggachaa jirra."

article_content: Sports Illustrated has published its first-ever list ranking the Top 50 fittest male athletes. Athletes were judged in four categories: speed, strength, agility, and endurance, each scored out of ten for a possible total of 40 points. Basketball star LeBron James achieved a perfect score of 40, placing him at the top of the list. Real Madrid and Portuguese soccer star Cristiano Ronaldo took second place, while Jamaican sprinter Usain Bolt placed third. The top ten also included boxer Floyd Mayweather and swimmer Michael Phelps. Sports Illustrated plans to release a similar list for female athletes. It has been a busy season for LeBron James. His Miami Heat reached the NBA Finals for the fourth year in a row but lost to the San Antonio Spurs in June. Following the loss, LeBron opted out of his contract with the Heat and returned to the Cleveland Cavaliers. Recently, LeBron has been on a low-carb diet, resulting in noticeable weight loss, as seen in a photo he posted to Instagram. According to ESPN, LeBron cut carbohydrates from his meals and lost significant weight. He is listed as 6-foot-8 and 250 pounds on the Cavaliers' roster. LeBron, showing his commitment to the Cleveland community, worked with his sons LeBron Jr. and Bryce to renovate the home of Mariah Riley, an 11-year-old student in his Wheels for Education program. Their efforts were filmed for the HGTV show 'Rehab Addict,' hosted by Nicole Curtis. The renovation included removing steps, a retaining wall, and porch railings. The Akron Beacon Journal reported that local businesses donated materials and labor for the project.

article_content: Billionaire investor Bill Ackman criticized university administrations in a Wednesday post on X (formerly Twitter), accusing them of failing to adequately address antisemitism. Ackman, the founder and CEO of Pershing Square Capital Management and a Harvard alumnus, has frequently spoken out against the 30 Harvard student groups that signed a controversial letter condemning Israel for the October 7 Hamas attacks. The letter has drawn intense backlash. Ackman called on Harvard to release the names of the students who signed, aiming to prevent CEOs from ‘inadvertently’ hiring them. Subsequently, a truck with a billboard displaying the names and photos of those thought to have signed the letter drove around the Harvard campus. Some critics believe Ackman's campaign has gone too far. Even Larry Summers, former Treasury secretary and Harvard president, said Ackman was 'getting a bit carried away' and compared the request for student names to McCarthyism. Joe McCarthy was a senator who led 1950s campaigns against alleged communists, often using exaggerated accusations and encouraging political witch hunts. On Wednesday, Ackman shared a letter from several law firms addressed to law school deans. The letter stated: 'There is no room for antisemitism, Islamophobia, racism, or any other form of violence or hatred on your campuses, in our workplaces, or in our communities.' Ackman commented: 'It's unfortunate that we have to rely on law firms and corporations to police antisemitism on campuses. None of them will hire racist students or those who support terrorists.' He said he spent the day at Harvard talking with students and faculty. Ackman claimed he learned that the university's diversity, equity, and inclusion staff do not seriously respond to complaints from Asian, White (non-LGBTQ), or Jewish students, which he believes partially explains the current situation. He did not provide specific evidence for this claim, and Insider has not independently verified it. Harvard did not immediately respond to Insider’s request for comment, which was sent outside US working hours.

article_content: Bottles of Extra Strength Tylenol will soon feature a new warning on their caps: "Contains acetaminophen. Always read the label." This updated labeling, in bold red lettering, comes as part of Johnson & Johnson’s efforts to reduce the frequency of accidental acetaminophen overdoses each year. The National Institutes of Health notes that acetaminophen overdose is among the most common types of poisoning worldwide. Taking excessive amounts of this pain reliever can result in severe liver damage. The Food and Drug Administration has set the maximum recommended dosage for adults at 4,000 milligrams per day. Each Extra Strength Tylenol gel tablet contains 500 milligrams of acetaminophen. According to the FDA, people should always inform their doctor and pharmacist about all the medications they are taking to ensure they do not exceed the recommended daily limit. Additionally, acetaminophen should not be taken together with alcohol. "With more than 600 prescription and over-the-counter medications containing acetaminophen on the market, this warning is an important step to remind consumers to always read the label," Johnson & Johnson stated regarding the new caps, which are expected in October. CNN’s Jacque Wilson and John Bonifield contributed to this report.

article_content: A strikingly unconventional film called 'Escape from Tomorrow' has become a major talking point at the 2013 Sundance Film Festival. The movie, directed by Randall Moore, was shot covertly inside Disney World in Florida and Disneyland in California—without Disney’s approval. Unlike the usual cheerful scenes, 'Escape from Tomorrow' depicts the theme parks in an unsettling and bizarre light. The narrative centers on Jim, a father who experiences a mental collapse during a family holiday. Strange and disturbing visuals sharply contrast the polished image Disney is known for. Moore’s crew managed a 24-day clandestine shoot, splitting their time between both parks. To stay undetected, they used hidden microphones, small cameras designed to look ordinary, and kept scripts on their phones. Blending in as average tourists, they even filmed during crowd-heavy moments like parades. Disney has acknowledged knowledge of the film but hasn't issued a public response. The filmmakers are bracing for potential legal challenges, as Disney might attempt to prevent the film’s release. Yet, legal scholars such as Professor Tim Wu from Columbia University think the film may fall under 'fair use,' making it tough for Disney to succeed if they claim infringement. Inspired by his own childhood experiences in Orlando, director Moore wanted to reflect on the artificial environments of theme parks and America’s obsession with escapism. The film acts as both a psychological thriller and a cultural satire. Critics have described the movie as 'hallucinatory,' 'bold,' and 'strange,' noting its daring filmmaking and its haunting musical score.

article_content: Dufry and Autogrill, both prominent in travel retail and food services, are preparing to rebrand as Avolta, pending shareholder approval. During the third quarter, North America was the slowest-growing region but still saw sales rise by 11.1% year-over-year, thanks to solid demand at U.S. airports from domestic and international travelers. Dufry's Canadian arm also gained modestly from a partial return of Asian visitors, though a quick rebound is unlikely. North America contributed about 31% of Dufry-Autogrill’s turnover, reaching $1.19 billion in Q3. This growth was supported by new store launches, such as an extended partnership at Las Vegas' Harry Reid Airport, and a 12-year duty-free concession at Boston Logan Airport’s revamped Terminal E. The company enhanced its food and beverage operations with multiple openings at major airports, including Chicago O’Hare, Atlanta, Orlando, Jacksonville, Fort Lauderdale, and San José. Asia-Pacific, while still the company’s smallest segment, showed the strongest growth at 45%, totaling $149 million in Q3, largely from domestic and intra-regional travel. The return of international travelers is happening but at a slow pace. In China, Dufry formed a joint venture with Hubei Airport Group to oversee retail and dining at Wuhan Tianhe Airport’s Terminal 2, which served 27 million passengers in 2019. The Europe, Middle East, and Africa (EMEA) division—Dufry-Autogrill's largest region—represented 52% of sales and reported a 12.3% rise to $2.21 billion for Q3, led by Mediterranean tourist destinations. The UK, the Nordics, and Central Europe saw an uptick in international travelers, including some from Asia-Pacific. Dufry invested in specialty retail concepts, notably debuting a high-end perfumery at Zurich Airport, with more sites planned. Across all operations, like-for-like turnover rose 14.3% in the third quarter, surpassing $4 billion. CEO Xavier Rossinyol stated this would be the last financial report presented under the Dufry name, as the company moves forward as Avolta following shareholder agreement. He emphasized strong market demand, effective integration and synergy realization, and ongoing cost management. The firm achieved full run-rate synergy savings ($94 million) a year early. Assuming current trends persist, Dufry-Autogrill anticipates about 20% organic revenue growth for 2023, expecting annual sales around $11.9 billion.
