Umuriin ishee 87, fayyaan dadhabaa fi yaadannoo gabaabaa dhabduu taatee argamti, kun ammoo irree dhiigaa citee booda mudateef jedhama. Manneen Belgravia keessa deemuuf rakkisaa waan ta’eef, The Ritz – iddoo ishii gammachuu qabdu – filachaa, tajaajiltoota fi kunuunsitoota lameen waliin boqonnaa jirti. article_content: Boston, Massachusetts (CNN) – Early on a Saturday morning, Sarah Markowitz prepares for her dance class by stretching at the Boston Ballet school while her fellow students arrive. The students are excited because today they will perform for their parents. "I like dance because I like Gino," Sarah says, referring to Gianni di Marco, the instructor for this class of more than a dozen enthusiastic dancers. Gianni di Marco, known as Gino by his students, has taught various classes at the school, but now mainly focuses on Adaptive Dance—a class specifically designed for children with Down syndrome. "It's about movement," Di Marco explains. "It's about coordinating the body with the music and experiencing joy." As a conga drumbeat fills the room, the class begins. Di Marco stands in front of his students, all seated and facing the dance studio's floor-to-ceiling mirror. He leads them through rhythmic motions, gradually helping them move to a standing position. The students smile as Di Marco encourages them with, "Oh, yeah!" They respond enthusiastically, swaying and stomping their feet. "Dance is something that has no limitations," Di Marco says. He gathers the group in a circle, leading them like a pied piper. One at a time, students take turns doing freestyle dances in the center. High-fives, hugs, and fist bumps are shared after each routine. The Adaptive Dance program began in 2002, an idea created by Michelina "Mickey" Cassella, a physical therapist from Boston Children's Hospital who also works with Boston Ballet Company dancers. "They've had physical, occupational, and speech therapy," Cassella says of her students. "I wanted them to come into this building and participate in a class like other children." Cassella, though not a dance instructor, assists in guiding students who may become distracted or need encouragement. "They're moving beautifully to music," she says. "They're developing skills we didn't even know they had!" Cassella has witnessed these children grow into teenagers and is amazed by their progress. "It's been wonderful to see." In the studio, Di Marco invites parents to watch their children perform. Anne Markowitz smiles as her daughter Sarah leads the class through spontaneous poses, taking the opportunity to ham it up. "I think it's fabulous," Anne says of the program, and Sarah loves every minute. Down syndrome is familiar to Markowitz, as are the many capabilities of her daughter and the other students. "It doesn’t matter what your special needs are," she says. "You can participate, dance, and express yourself." Di Marco recalls that some students were hesitant at first, but now believes dance has given them confidence that extends beyond the classroom. "It’s not just about dance," he says, "it’s about learning to be yourself, and I see them developing that very well here." Teaching the class is rewarding for Di Marco, too. He admits he was nervous seven years ago when he began, but now says, "I'm having the time of my life teaching these children." This is the last class of the session, and students will return in March. Di Marco invites parents to join their children in a group dance. Forming a circle, each student now dances with family members. The class ends with a large group hug, everyone exhausted and smiling. Di Marco, arms outstretched, says, "This is life. I love you all. Thank you for letting your children dance with me!"
translated_content: Boston, Massachusetts (CNN) – Ganama Sanbata tokko Sarah Markowitz tapha ishee jalqabuu dura bakka barnoota Boston Ballet irra taa'uun dhiphuu ishee dheereffatti, barattoonni biroonis achi ga'u calaqifachaa jiru. Barattoonni gammachuu qabu, sababni isaas har'a maatii isaaniif sirba dhiyeessu. "Sirba nan jaaladha sababii Gino'n jira," jette Sarah, barsiisaa barreessaa leenjisaa kanaa, Gianni di Marco, jechuun kan dubbattu barattoota hedduu gaarummaadhaan waliin taa'anii keessaa tokko. Gianni di Marco, Gino jedhamee barattoota isaa biratti beekamu, barsiisaa kutaa adda addaa ta’ee hojjeteera, amma garuu Adda Dance jedhu keessatti ijoollee Down syndrome qaban waliin hojjechuun xiyyeeffataa jira. "Miseensa qaamaa sochoosuun, miira gammachuu fiduu waa'ee itti dhiyoon," jedha Di Marco. Yeroo sagalee dhangala'aa conga dhageessisutti, mana barnoota keessatti tapha jalqabu. Di Marco fuulduratti dhaabbatee barattoota isaa, hundi isaanii teessoo irratti mirkanaa'anii fi ija yeroo xinnaa halluufii keessa jiru. Kallattiiwwan gara garaa waliin hojjetanii, xurree dhaabbatanii geessu itti fufani. Barattoonni gammadanii Di Marco'n "Oh, yeah!" jechuun kakaasa; isaanis harka fi miilla dhidhimfachuu irratti deebi’u. "Sirbi daangaa hin qabu," jedha Di Marco. Hundi isaaniitiin marfamee garee tokkoon as baasa. Tokko tokkoon gar'a gara tokko keessatti sochii of danda'e agarsiisu. Gammachuu, harka hiixachuu fi walii-hidhuun sirna irratti mul'ata. Barnootni Adda Dance bara 2002tti ka’e, yaada Michelina "Mickey" Cassella, ogeettii fayyaa qaamaa Hospitaala Boston Children irraa taateefi, kan Boston Ballet Company waliin hojjettu. "Isaan tajaajila fayyaa qaamaa, hojii waldhaansaa fi dubbii fudhataniiru," jette Cassella. "Barumsichatti akka hirmaatan fedhe, akka ijoollee biroo waanta sirba dansaa argachuu danda’an." Cassella, barsiisaa sirba dansaa hin taane, barattoota yoo xiyyeeffannaa dhaban yookiin kaka'umsa barbaadan gargaaruuf jirti. "Sirba sirriitti socho’u jiru," jettee, "wantoota duraan hojjachuun akka hin dandeenye yaadnu hojjetaa jiru!" Cassella ijoolleen kunniin yeroo guddinaaf deeman si’ee argiteetti. "Arguun bareedaa dha." Keessa mana barnoota keessatti, Di Marco maatiin ijoollee isaanii dhiibuu agarsiisanii ilaaluuf affeeree. Anne Markowitz, Sarah intalaa ishee, sirboota hin eegamne hoggantuin biyya keessaatti gammachuun ilaalaa jirti. "Barumsi kun nama dinqisiisa," jette Anne, Sarah immoo yeroo hunda jaalatti. Down syndrome Markowitz biratti haarawa miti, akkasumas dandeettii ijoollee ishee fi barattoota kaanii beektu. "Dandeettii addaa qabaattus, hirmaachuu, sirbuun fi of ibsuun ni danda'ama," jette. Di Marco barattoonni tokko tokko jalqaba hin fedhan turan jenne yaadatti, amma garuu dansiin ofitti walii amantii bal'aa akka horatan hubata. "Sirbu qofa miti, garuu of ta’uunis barachuu dha, asitti immoo waan sana gaarii taasisu argaa jira," jedha. Leenjisuun kun Di Marco'f is milkaa'ina guddaa dha. Waggaa torba dura jalqabuu isaa yeroo yaadatu ni sodaata ture jedha, amma garuu, "Guyyaa jireenya koo ijoollee tana barsiisunen dabaraa jira," jedha. Kun tapha xumuraa barruu kanaati, Barattoonni baatii Bitootessaatti deebi’u. Di Marco maatiin ilmaan isaanii waliin sirban akka jiru affeera. Marfamee garee jalatti, barattoonni tokkoon tokkoon maatii isaanii waliin sirba. Xumurri taphichaa, walii mar'achuun tokkoon tokkoon gammachuu fi dadhabina waliin fixu. Di Marco, harka bal’ifatee, "Kun jireenya. Isin hundumaa nan jaaladha. Ijoollee keessan na waliin taphachiiftaniif galatooma!" jedha.

Adidas and Bugatti have joined forces to create the limited edition X Crazyfast Bugatti football boots, engineered for both speed and lightness and finished with distinct Bugatti touches. Only 99 pairs have been produced, each accompanied by a digital twin and packaged in a box inspired by Bugatti’s carbon fiber designs. The boots will be sold via an exclusive Web3 auction on the adidas Collect platform from November 8 to 11. Successful bidders will receive a unique digital shoebox, redeemable for both the physical boots and their digital twin starting November 13. Buyers can pay using cryptocurrency, with the support of MoonPay for easy onboarding.

The boots feature adidas' Speedframe sole plate, designed for maximum lightness and rapid acceleration, an Aerocage lining for mid-foot support, and a breathable Aeropacity Speedskin mesh. The carbon fiber inlay and a flash of Bugatti Blue take visual cues from Bugatti’s legendary Chiron and early Grand Prix cars. Each boot displays the mottos “Impossible is Nothing” (adidas) and “Create the Incomparable” (Bugatti), as well as the Ettore Bugatti insignia across the heel. Rafael Leao and Karim Benzema are set to unveil the boots on the pitch this month.

This initiative follows a similar Web3 auction in August, where adidas Originals partnered with BAPE to release 100 Triple-White Forum 84 BAPE Low sneakers, each also coming with digital twins.

Kaffaltiin cryptocurrency dhaan godhamu ni danda’ama, MoonPay immoo gargaarsa kaffaltii salphaa kennuuf jira.

Kopheen kun Speedframe sole plate adidas qabu – salphaa fi saffisa ol’aanaa kennuuf, Aerocage lining gidduu miilaa jabeessu fi Aeropacity Speedskin, eenyummaa ykn hamaan, akka oolu godha. Inlay carbon fiber fi caalchisa Bugatti Blue halluu fi caasaa konkolaataa Buuggatii Chiron fi Grand Prix durii irraa fudhatamedha. Kophee irratti ‘Impossible is Nothing’ (adidas) fi ‘Create the Incomparable’ (Bugatti) akkasumas mallattoo Ettore Bugatti bakka dugda kophee irratti arguu dandeessu. Rafael Leao fi Karim Benzema yeroo dhiyootti kophee kanaa dirree irratti mul’isu.

article_content: Robert Lewandowski showed signs of low confidence as Bayern Munich played to a goalless draw against Manchester City at the Allianz Arena on Wednesday. The striker’s heavy touches, weak finishing, and lack of awareness reflected a player struggling to find his best form. Despite his talents and reputation as a prolific scorer, Lewandowski seemed frustrated as he failed to make a significant impact, especially when compared to City’s Edin Dzeko, who has faced and overcome his own confidence struggles in the past. Dzeko, who joined Manchester City in January 2011 after an impressive goal-scoring stint at Wolfsburg, once found adapting to English football and his working relationship with then-manager Roberto Mancini challenging. However, Dzeko eventually regained his confidence and became an important player for City, suggesting that Lewandowski could similarly overcome his current issues at Bayern. In this match, Lewandowski’s difficulties were evident. Although he has already scored five goals this season, four came in a single international game for Poland, and he has only managed to score once in the Bundesliga, away at Schalke. The missing home goal at the Allianz Arena continues to invite questions about his form. Bayern Munich was also missing key players Franck Ribery and Arjen Robben due to injury, changing the team’s usual style of play and possibly making it harder for Lewandowski to thrive. Coach Pep Guardiola and players Philipp Lahm and Jerome Boateng offered support for Lewandowski, but ultimately, goals are what quiet criticism. Lewandowski had opportunities, including a chance in the first half that was wasted due to a poor first touch and another guided narrowly wide from a tight angle after being closed down by Joe Hart. Meanwhile, Dzeko led City’s attack well, earning a place in the starting lineup over Sergio Aguero and showcasing intelligent movement and effective hold-up play. With Alvaro Negredo’s recent move back to Spain, City manager Manuel Pellegrini is expected to continue rotating his remaining strikers throughout the season. On this occasion, Dzeko showed he is capable of making the most of such opportunities, hinting at renewed confidence and form.
translated_content: Robert Lewandowski mallattoo dadhabina amantaa cimaa agarsiise yeroo Bayern Munich fi Manchester City walenta'aan gola tokko malee wal qixxaatan Allianz Arena irratti. Qabiyyee kubbaa isaa jalaa darbu, xumura laafaa fi hubannoo xixiqqoo agarsiisuu isaatiif, Lewandowski taphataa cimaa ta'uu isaa irraa fagaachaa jira. Tapha addaa fi goliwwan baay'ee galmeessuu isaatti beekkamuus, Lewandowski guyyaa kana mufii agarsiise, yoo Edin Dzeko Manchester City waliin rakkoo amantaa ofii isaa darbee injifatee taphateetti wal bira qabamu. Dzeko, bara 2011tti Wolfsburg irraa booda Manchester City seenee, yeroo jalqabaa tapha Ingiliffaa fi walqunnamtii leenjisaa Roberto Mancini waliin rakkachaa ture. Haata'u malee, Dzeko rakkoo isaa guutummaatti darbee, garee isaaf taphataa guddaa ta'ee of argisiise – kunis akka Lewandowskiis rakkoo isaa ammaa irraa ni dachaasuufiin fakkaata. Tapha kana keessatti, rakkina Lewandowski bal’inaan mul’ateera. Waggaa kana golee shan galmeesse keessaa, afur tapha biyya isaa Poland tokkotti galmeesse. Bundesliga irratti ammoo tokko qofa, Schalke irratti bal’inaan galmeesse. Gola Allianz Arena irratti galchuu dhabuu isaa ilaalchisee gaaffiiwwan ni jiraatu. Bayern Munich taphattoota ijoo Ribery fi Robben due to midhaan isaanii dhabdee, taphni garaa garaa jijjiiramee, kunis Lewandowski irratti ulfaatina itti fufe uumeera. Leenjisaa Pep Guardiola fi taphattoonni Philipp Lahm fi Jerome Boateng akka Lewandowski deeggaran dubbatanis, garaagarummaan inni agarsiisu fi dogoggorri gaaffilee taphattoota kanneen akkasumas miidiyaa qunnaamtii dhaga’aman, golee galchuun qofa yo xiqqate isaaniitiin ni fageenya. article_content: Severe storms hit France’s Burgundy wine region on Tuesday, causing significant damage to valuable vineyards through hail and strong winds. In some vineyards, as much as 90% of the crop was lost, raising fears over the upcoming grape harvest. The Beaune area, famous for winemaking villages like Pommard, Meursault, Volnay, and Aloxe-Corton, suffered particularly severe losses. Cecile Mathiaud of the Burgundy Wine Board said hail destroyed much of the crop, and many vineyards were also affected by flooding. She noted that split grapes can’t be harvested. In the top-tier region of Aloxe, about 50% of vineyards were hit, while Meursault saw 40% damaged. Winemaker Jean Yves Devevey described hailstones the size of marbles, estimating his Beaune vineyard’s losses at 70% to 80%. Burgundy is known for some of France’s most expensive wines, with Premier Cru Meursault fetching up to £1,050 per bottle and Grand Cru Aloxe-Corton costing £150. Producers worry they won’t be able to meet usual production levels, warning that reduced supply will likely drive prices higher for the 2013–2014 vintage. Last year’s hailstorms also caused big losses, making the situation even worse. Winemaker Caroline Parent-Gros described it as a major setback, after a 2012 harvest that was already cut in half. Jasper Morris, Burgundy director at Berry Bros. & Rudd in London, warned that some winemakers might not survive these setbacks, as a year’s work can be undone by one storm. More storms — and possible hail — are forecast for France soon, adding to concerns.

article_content: Rooster Teeth has removed some of its most popular shows, including most seasons of Red vs. Blue, from YouTube and relocated them to its own website. Kerry Shawcross, senior writer and showrunner for RWBY at Rooster Teeth, announced the move in a video on Thursday, stating, “YouTube revenue is just not cutting it for us right now.” Shawcross also confirmed that Camp Camp is now available exclusively on the company’s website, where episodes will remain free with ad support. He explained that Rooster Teeth makes about five to ten times more from ad revenue on its own platform compared to YouTube, adding, “animation’s hard and it’s expensive.” Shawcross did not detail what content was removed or when, but various Reddit threads from late September note that most of Red vs. Blue is no longer available on YouTube.

article_content: Charlotte Hawkins, a 64-year-old from Loganville, Georgia, has spent decades coping with type 1 neurofibromatosis, a genetic disorder that causes harmless, bubble-like tumors to develop on the skin. Her first encounter with the condition began at age 15 when she noticed a patch of odd skin on her back. Surgery initially removed the lumps, but as years passed, they returned and spread, especially on her face and body. Once celebrated for her appearance, Hawkins’ looks were changed by the progression of neurofibromatosis. The unpredictability of the disease and the way others reacted made her feel self-conscious, resulting in periods of depression. A particularly distressing moment occurred when a child was scared by her appearance in public. Hawkins withdrew from public life for many years. Her perspective shifted when a church community invited her to volunteer at a children's playgroup. There, she felt welcomed and valued, and the supportive environment helped her overcome some of the stigma surrounding her condition. Today, Hawkins is a joyful grandmother of three, often caring for neighborhood children, an experience she finds rewarding and uplifting. She continues to see her doctor, Dr. Coruna Shah, for regular checkups to monitor the tumors and her vision, since neurofibromatosis can also affect the eyes. Type 1 neurofibromatosis is caused by a genetic mutation present from birth and affects about one in 3,000 individuals. While the tumors typically remain benign, there is no cure, and management relies on symptom monitoring and sometimes surgery. Hawkins is thankful her son, Charlie, and her grandchildren have not inherited the condition. With ongoing encouragement from her church community and friends like Anne Schuffer, Hawkins has built a fulfilled life, facing her condition with courage and optimism.

article_content: Sarah Burton, creative director at Alexander McQueen, has been awarded an OBE in recognition of her impact on British fashion. Known for designing the Duchess of Cambridge's acclaimed wedding gown, Burton’s association with Alexander McQueen began in 1996, ultimately leading her to the creative director role in 2010 after McQueen’s passing. Currently pregnant with twins, Burton described the opportunity to work with the Duchess on the royal wedding dress as a profound highlight of her career. She called the process a collaborative one and expressed her honor at receiving the royal assignment, which came as a surprise. The Duchess’s gown—unveiled at Westminster Abbey during her wedding to Prince William—featured a nearly nine-foot train and elaborate lace appliqué. The lace, created using the historic Carrickmacross technique from Ireland, incorporated the rose, thistle, daffodil, and shamrock to represent the four parts of the UK. After accepting her OBE from Prince Charles at Buckingham Palace, Burton voiced her gratitude and sense of humility. When asked about designing maternity wear for the Duchess, soon to become a mother, Burton said she would welcome the opportunity. She also commended the distinct fashion sense of both the Duchess and Prince of Wales, noting Prince Charles’s connection to Savile Row tailoring. Burton reflected on her long-standing role at Alexander McQueen, appreciating the unique experiences she’s gained, particularly designing the royal wedding dress. She underscored the importance of British craftsmanship and the teamwork involved in her projects with the royal family.

article_content: Nintendo reported an 18% increase in net profit for its first fiscal half, driven by strong sales from its successful Super Mario movie and popular video game software. For the April-September period, Nintendo Co. posted a profit of nearly 271.3 billion yen ($1.8 billion), up from 230 billion yen the previous year. Sales surged 21% to 796 billion yen ($5.3 billion). Demand for Nintendo Switch game software remained strong, boosted by the release of 'The Super Mario Bros. Movie.' 'Mario Kart 8 Deluxe' sold 3.2 million units during this period, reaching total sales of 57 million copies, according to Nintendo. The Super Mario Bros. Movie became one of the highest-grossing animated films ever, ranking second only to 'Frozen II' and the top animated film based on a video game. Another success for Nintendo was 'The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom,' which sold 19.5 million units worldwide since its release in May. Hardware sales increased to 6.84 million Nintendo Switch consoles, up from 6.68 million last year, bringing cumulative sales to 132.5 million units. Nintendo projects sales of 15 million consoles for the fiscal year through March 2024, including the crucial holiday season. Leading up to the holidays, Nintendo plans to release 'Super Mario RPG,' new Pokémon games, and other titles. Software sales grew to 97 million games in the fiscal half, up from 95 million. 'Pikmin 4,' launched in July, is also performing well. Nintendo encourages households to own multiple Switch consoles for shared play among family and friends. Last month, Nintendo released 'Super Mario Bros. Wonder,' the first entirely new side-scrolling Mario game in over a decade. The company aims to keep its platform vibrant by offering new games and add-on content. Nintendo raised its full-year profit forecast to 420 billion yen ($2.8 billion), higher than its previous estimate but still about 3% below last year's record set during the COVID-19 pandemic, when entertainment companies saw a surge in demand. The weaker yen has further boosted Nintendo's overseas earnings, with the company expecting the U.S. dollar to average 140 yen compared to 130 yen previously. The dollar recently traded around 150 yen. — Reported by Yuri Kageyama. (X, formerly Twitter: https://twitter.com/yurikageyama)

article_content: Oxfam has called upon the government to raise the minimum wage, aiming to shield low-income workers from a combination of welfare cuts, limited job opportunities, and climbing living expenses. This plea comes as new government data is expected to show more employed people are struggling with poverty. The charity highlights that, among the UK’s 7.9 million working-age adults living in poverty, the majority actually belong to households where someone is employed. Oxfam claims that recent austerity policies have hit the lowest-paid workers the hardest. Oxfam also points out that with average wages dropping by 4.4 percent, more people are turning to food banks and charities for help. Meanwhile, executive pay in FTSE 100 companies jumped by 49 percent. To improve this situation, Oxfam recommends upping the minimum wage, reversing cuts to working tax credits, and reducing the amount of income Universal Credit claimants lose after starting work from 65 percent to 55 percent. Chris Johnes, Oxfam’s director for UK poverty, stresses that having a job is no longer enough to lift people out of poverty. He notes that more working-age adults in poverty are now in employed households than in those without work. Johnes criticizes government policy, arguing that large welfare cuts are being justified as work incentives, even though there are not enough well-paying jobs. He cautions that continued inequality could push the UK toward poverty levels last seen in Victorian times. A spokesperson for the Department for Work and Pensions counters that £150 billion was spent on tax credits between 2004 and 2010, and yet the UK is set to miss its own child poverty goals. They state that Universal Credit, designed to simplify welfare and make employment pay, could help lift hundreds of thousands out of poverty.

Gaafii kana waggaa lakkoofsi hojii irratti argaman hiyyummaa keessa jiran dabalu irraa kan ka’e dhiyeesse. Oxfam akka jedhutti, mindaan giddugaleessa %4.4 gadi bu'uun fi namoonni hedduun bankoota nyaataa fi gargaarsa barbaadan amma dabalaa jiru; yeroo sanatti mindaan hoggansa FTSE 100 %49 ol dabalee jira. Rakkoo kana furuuf, Oxfam mindaa xixiqqaa olkaasu, hanqina mindaa irratti hafee gargaarsa deebisuu fi hojii jalqabanii Universal Credit keessaa madaallii maallaqa darbu %65 irraa gara %55 gadi xiqqeessuu akka barbaachisu yaada kenna. article_content: An underwater photographer has taken stunning photos of a Caribbean sponge that bears a striking resemblance to Sesame Street’s Cookie Monster. This sea creature, called the stove pipe sponge, features bulging eyes, a wide mouth, and a blue color—making it look almost identical to the famous puppet. Mauricio Handler, the photographer, discovered this quirky sponge while diving near Curaçao in the Dutch Caribbean. Although it looks just like the cookie-loving character, the sponge actually eats plankton. Handler emphasized how the sponge's cartoonish face made it an unforgettable find. Unlike Cookie Monster, who first appeared on television in the 1960s, this aquatic animal lives in warm Caribbean waters and is made entirely of living tissue instead of fur.

article_content: British pop-artist George Ioannou, known for his 'Gangster Art' style, has unveiled a new collection called 'Dead Famous'. The series explores celebrity culture by painting the skulls of world-famous icons, emphasizing those defining details that make each star recognizable. Ioannou became widely known in the late 1990s for his bold movie-inspired works, notably his portrayals of Al Pacino’s Tony Montana in 'Scarface'. His unique approach has established him as a sought-after contemporary artist in the UK, with works selling for as much as £30,000. His clientele includes big names like Adele, Roman Abramovich, and Theo Paphitis. The 'Dead Famous' collection consists of thirteen paintings, all illustrating well-known personalities—Amy Winehouse, Freddie Mercury, Marilyn Monroe, David Bowie, Audrey Hepburn, Bob Marley, Madonna, and others—as skulls rendered with signature features. Details like dreadlocks, distinctive hair, or jewelry help pinpoint each subject’s identity. Among the other figures represented are Steve McQueen, Jimi Hendrix, Michael Jackson, Sid Vicious, Kurt Cobain, Michael Caine, John Travolta, Uma Thurman, Jack Nicholson, Elvis Presley, and Jim Morrison. The paintings invite viewers to reconsider what makes someone an enduring icon and how personal style can become timeless. Ioannou says he is fascinated by how minimal visual hints can reveal a celebrity’s identity and how the influence of such figures can persist long after their passing. He poses questions about which matters more in fame: naturally-given talent or carefully crafted image. Beyond his artwork, Ioannou operates an art collective from his coffee shop in Coulsdon, Surrey. His paintings remain popular among collectors eager for a fresh interpretation of famous faces.

article_content: Popular television programmes like The Great British Bake-Off and Big Allotment Challenge are inspiring a rise in people starting their own businesses, according to government officials. New research shows that one in ten people with a creative hobby, such as baking or gardening, hope to turn their passion into a new career this year. Employment Minister Esther McVey noted that people are 'turning their cakes into cash' by establishing small businesses, inspired in part by shows like Bake-Off and Masterchef. The government encourages this entrepreneurial spirit with new support schemes. A Dragons’ Den-style business support plan helps aspiring entrepreneurs by offering guidance from experts to develop business plans. If a plan is approved, individuals can receive financial support through a weekly allowance for up to 26 weeks, totaling up to £1,274. Mentors also continue to offer ongoing advice and guidance once businesses have launched. According to ministers, nearly 500 new businesses were set up every week over the last year through this support programme. Esther McVey stated: 'The most important ingredient when setting up your own business is a passion for what you’re doing – and nothing beats turning your hobby into a career. If you're inspired by these programmes, you could turn your cakes into cash.' Through the New Enterprise Allowance, the government says it has helped launch over 60,000 new businesses, many of which began as hobbies. The scheme supports jobseekers, lone parents, and people on sickness benefits who have a viable business idea. Mentoring has helped establish businesses ranging from cake makers and pastry enterprises to olive oil producers and bakers. Other successes include businesses started from hobbies like restoring old carousel horses or designing greetings cards. Official figures reveal that over 4,000 young people, more than 11,000 disabled individuals, and over 14,000 people aged over 50 have benefited from the scheme. Further, research from online print and design firm MOO found that nearly a fifth (19%) of Brits with a creative pastime plan to begin making money from their talents in 2015.

Qorannoon haaraan agarsiisa, namoota harka keessaa tokkoffaa keessaa tokko hojii aartii ykn bashannanaa qaban hojii ofii isaanii jalqabuuf hawwii qaban. Sagantaan deeggarsaa fakkaataa Dragons’ Den maqaa qabu, namoota hojii jalqabuuf fedhii qaban gorsa ogeessota irraa kennuuf carraa kenna. Deeggarsi ‘New Enterprise Allowance’ jedhamu jalatti, mootummaan hojii haaraa 60,000 ol jalqabsiise jedhu, baay’een isaaniis bashannana irraa ka’anidha. Sagantichi, hojii barbaadattoota, maatii ijoolle tokko qofaa qabaniifi, akkasumas namoota fayyaa hin qabne, hojii dhuunfaa ofiitiif deeggarsa kenna. Qorannoon dhaabbata MOO jechuun beekkamu irraa argame, Britaannotaa keessaa 19% hojii aartii irratti carraa maallaqa argamsiisuuf bara 2015 irratti karoorfachuu isaanii mul’iseera.

article_content: A Walmart employee has been arrested after allegedly luring a young boy into a store bathroom and assaulting him. Matthew Bulmer, 22, of Long Island, New York, was taken into custody at the Islandia Walmart and charged with first-degree sexual abuse and endangering the welfare of a child. Police say Bulmer attacked the five-year-old boy on Saturday night at around 8:45 p.m. Walmart spokesperson Kory Lundberg told CBS News, 'We’re clearly concerned about these allegations, and we’re cooperating fully with the Suffolk County Police Department.' Bulmer has been suspended from his job pending the investigation. He was arraigned Sunday at First District Court in Central Islip. Authorities have not confirmed whether Bulmer has retained an attorney. Comments are not being accepted due to legal reasons.

article_content: While Rory McIlroy was preparing in Dubai, Ian Poulter faced frustration during a rainy third round at the Turkish Airlines Open. Poulter had previously led by six shots after two rounds but struggled with a three-over-par 75 on Saturday, tying him with Lee Westwood and putting him one shot behind Australia's Wade Ormsby, who leads at 12 under par. Poulter openly criticized his third round, describing it as disappointing. Westwood, after a strong five-under-par 67, joins Poulter at 11 under. England’s Danny Willett is also in contention at 10 under, and veteran John Daly remains in the mix at 8 under. Poulter’s difficulties allowed Germany’s Marcel Siem to stay close at 11 under. Siem, along with Jamie Donaldson and Sergio Garcia, still has a mathematical chance to overtake McIlroy in the Race to Dubai. For this to happen, Siem must win both the Turkish Airlines Open and next week's event in Dubai, with McIlroy finishing outside the top 17. McIlroy is currently practicing in Dubai, preparing for his return to competitive golf after a month off to focus on a legal dispute with his former management company. Poulter's third round included three bogeys and a double bogey at the 15th hole due to a wedge miscalculation. Although he fell from 12th to 44th in the world rankings this year, Poulter has shown signs of improvement. After the round, Poulter expressed disappointment over losing his rhythm, while Westwood was pleased to be back in contention. Other notable players in the field include Luke Donald, Darren Clarke, and Martin Kaymer.

article_content:
MotoGP returns to Argentina this weekend for the third round of the 2014 season, marking its first appearance there since 1999. The event is generating excitement across the country, with many fans traveling to the Santiago del Estero circuit—redesigned by Italian engineer Jarno Zaffelli. Over 65,000 tickets were sold ahead of the season opener, and full grandstands are expected.

Carmelo Ezpeleta, CEO of MotoGP’s commercial rights holder Dorna, praised Argentina’s commitment to meeting FIM's high standards and emphasized the country's enthusiasm for the sport. He believes Argentina fully deserves to host MotoGP and expects the new Termas de Rio Hondo circuit will make for intriguing racing, as none of the riders have prior experience there.

Yamaha’s Valentino Rossi, a seven-time world champion, and teammate Jorge Lorenzo are preparing to adapt quickly to the unfamiliar track. Lorenzo, after two difficult races—including a crash and a false start—is looking to regain momentum in Argentina. He has been training in Cancun to prepare.

Ducati’s Cal Crutchlow will miss the race due to injury, while Andrea Dovizioso arrives with renewed confidence after earning third place in Austin. Honda’s Marc Marquez and Dani Pedrosa are also well-prepared, with Marquez aiming to extend his dominant start to the season.

Ezpeleta expressed satisfaction with the impact of the new Open Class regulations, intended to reduce costs and raise competition. He also mentioned future growth ambitions for MotoGP, including potential races in Brazil and Africa.

Riders and fans are eager to see how the unfamiliar Argentine circuit will challenge the field and possibly create unpredictable results.

article_content: The Great Pacific Garbage Patch is a vast region of floating plastic waste about 1,000 miles off California’s coast, stretching over hundreds or even thousands of square miles. Unlike a solid island, this patch mostly consists of tiny, broken-down plastic fragments spread through the water. A team from the University of California’s Scripps Institution of Oceanography has launched a three-week mission aboard the New Horizon vessel to study this enormous debris field. Robert Knox, the research deputy director at Scripps, clarifies that the patch is not always visible: while larger items occasionally appear, much of the plastic is only noticeable through water samples. Researchers are focused on unresolved issues—mainly, how much debris there is overall, what size particles make it up, how material is spread throughout the ocean, and how it affects marine life, especially smaller animals at the base of the food web. Previous findings indicate the Garbage Patch is potentially as large as Texas and has grown for years, first noticed by fishermen encountering scattered trash in the area. While similar garbage patches exist elsewhere, this is the largest known. Rusty Brainard from NOAA highlights that, along with plastic, massive fishing nets also harm marine ecosystems, especially near Hawaii. Plastic poses the biggest threat, breaking into fine pieces that seabirds and other creatures may consume—sometimes these plastics move up the food chain to humans. The patch’s size isn’t fixed, since circulating Pacific currents constantly reshape its edges, sometimes over distances of a thousand miles, and shift further during El Nino episodes. Trash comes both from ships and coastal regions washed out to sea. The purpose of the Scripps study is to better understand the scale and impact of this growing oceanic problem and to explore possible cleanup strategies.

Qubannaan kun baayyee guddachuudhaan, bal’inni isaa kiiloomeetira hedduu ykn kuma hedduutti jiran jechuu dha. Akkuma balaa bal’inaan argamu sanatti, balbala isaa fakkaattee hin jiru; baay'inni isaa xixiqqaa fi murannoo pilastikii ta’ee, galaana keessatti faca’ee jira. Koorsii qorattootaa Yuunivarsiitii Kaaliifoorniyaa Scripps Institution of Oceanography irraa, qorannoo torbaan sadii doonii New Horizon irratti taasisaa jiru. Robert Knox, itti-aanaa Daayirektera qorannoo Scripps, qubannaan kun kallattiin balbala pilastikii akka hin mul’anne ibsa. Olka’aan pilastika tokko tokko yeroo hunda hin mul’atu; garuu baay’inni isaa tokko tokko bishaan keessaa midhamni. Kana ammoo samplii bishaan booda qofa adda baafamuu danda’a. Qorannoowwan gaaffilee hin deebi’amne irratti xiyyeeffatan; kana keessaa baay’inni qabeenya balleessaa, bal’inni fi qooddattonni, akkamitti balbalatti faca’aa jiru, akkasumas lubbuqabeeyyii galaana irratti miidhaan jiru, keessattuu pilastikii xixiqqaa soorata gosa xixiqqaa nyaatan ilaalu. Akka qorannoo duraaniitti, qubannaan kun lafa Texas caalaa bal’achuu danda’a, waggoota hedduu keessatti guddachuu isaa fi, dhuma irratti, qunamtii isaa duraan gareewwan warra konkolaataan beeksifameen beekama. Bakka garaagaraa keessatti qubannaan akkasii jiraatus, kan kun isa olaanaa dha. Rusty Brainard, NOAA irraa, pilastikii fi rifeensa bineeensota galaana irratti miidhaa fidu, keessattuu naannoo Hawaiitti, kaasuu isaa ibsa. Pilastikii bal’inaan jiru bigaa cimaa dha, jawwee xixiqqatti badanii lubbuqabeeyyii nyaataman. Sana booda, namarraa yeroo nyaatamaa deemu nyaata namaa seenuu danda’a. Guddaan qubannaan kun bakka tutuqaa hin qabne, sababni isaas, argannoon galaanaa yeroo hunda socho’uu fi bakka garaagaraa dabsuu isaati, yeroo El Nino fi sochiin lakkuu yeroo dheeraa kessatti bal’achuu isaati. Qabeenya balleessaa keessaa fi kan bakka baddaa galaana irraa faana raataa galaana dhufe. Kaayyoon qorannoo Scripps kun, bal’ina, balaa fi mala furmaata rakkoo guddaa kanaa ittiin furamu addaan baasuudhaaf.

article_content: OnePlus 12 is scheduled for its global launch on January 24, 2024, as confirmed through the company's official marketing activities. The initial launch took place in China on December 5 before its international release was announced. Official websites for OnePlus in the UK, US, and India published launch details, including a 'OnePlus 12 subscribe to win' contest offering fans the chance to win the phone. Running from November 27, 2023, to January 23, 2024, the contest hinted that January 23 is 'the day before the OnePlus 12 launch event,' confirming the January 24 global launch. Succeeding the OnePlus 11 5G, the OnePlus 12 is powered by the Snapdragon 8 Gen 3 processor and features a Sony LYT808 primary rear camera. The device is designed with a circular camera module, curved edges, and will be available in Pale Green, Rock Black, and White colors. Notable specifications include a 6.82-inch LTPO OLED display with a resolution of 1440x3168 pixels and peak brightness of 2600 nits, developed with BOE and holding DisplayMate's A+ certification. The camera system consists of a 50 MP main sensor, 48 MP ultra-wide lens, and a 64 MP periscope lens with 3x telephoto zoom, enhanced through a partnership with Hasselblad. Elsewhere, India's Nifty stock index recently closed above 20,000, driven by positive market sentiment. The Enforcement Directorate (ED) has raised concerns regarding Byju's compliance with foreign exchange regulations. HCL Group is advancing plans to set up a chip packaging (OSAT) facility in Karnataka.

article_content: Veteran actor George Cole, 88, is reportedly experiencing severe stress due to a dispute over a saw mill being built next to his long-term rural home, according to his wife Penny, 75. The couple, who have lived in Stoke Row, Oxfordshire for seventy years, are distressed over local businessman James Morris’s plan to build a large metal barn—20 feet high and 90 feet long—for his saw mill business. Together with other villagers, the Coles have taken legal action to try to halt Morris’s construction. The South Oxfordshire district council ruled that the barn did not need planning permission. Penny Cole said the conflict has worsened their health: George is already dealing with serious illness, and she herself is suffering from a new skin condition and heart palpitations for which she is taking medication. Villagers argue the barn will spoil the rural landscape by removing trees and introducing loud machinery, shifting the peaceful character of the area. Penny described the structure as being out of place, likening it to an industrial building amid the countryside. The couple’s legal advisers contend the council’s process was flawed and failed to consider noise and visual impact. Planning consultant Nick Groves has lodged an official objection. Despite community opposition, the council maintains the barn fits within permitted development rules and is appropriate in design and placement. The Coles hope the council will reconsider after review. George Cole, widely known for portraying Arthur Daley in Minder, has appeared in numerous films and television series. James Morris, the saw mill owner who lives near the Coles, has yet to comment.

article_content: Illinois police have arrested 36-year-old Danny Coston from Carmi for the alleged murders of Jessica Evans, 17, and Jacob Wheeler, 22. The young couple disappeared during a recent camping and fishing trip by the Little Wabash River. Evans was found dead in the back of Wheeler’s pickup truck, which had crashed in a forested location. Investigation revealed evidence linking Coston to the scene, including parts from a wrecked vehicle. Coston confessed to the killings during a police interview. Guided by Coston’s information, authorities found Wheeler’s body in a rural area of Wayne County on Saturday. Officials describe the crime as random; Coston had no prior relationship with the victims, though he did know Wheeler’s father. The specific motive has not been released. Wheeler, a separated U.S. Army veteran who served in Iraq, and Evans, a well-regarded high school senior, were reported missing after Evans didn’t arrive at work. Multiple agencies joined the search using various methods. Coston faces preliminary charges of first-degree murder and is being held in White County Jail on a $3 million bond pending further charges.

article_content: Liverpool clinched a hard-fought 1-0 win over Stoke City at Anfield, thanks to Glen Johnson's late goal. The result was a much-needed boost for the team, coming after a string of disappointing Premier League performances. The occasion also marked 16 years since Steven Gerrard made his Liverpool debut. However, due to a congested fixture list, manager Brendan Rodgers kept Gerrard on the bench for most of the game, only realizing the significance of the date after seeing the match programme. The first half saw both sides struggle to create clear chances, with Liverpool looking disjointed and Stoke content to absorb pressure. After halftime, the intensity lifted, with Stoke's Bojan Krkic standing out for his creativity and forcing several saves from Simon Mignolet. Liverpool’s Raheem Sterling also posed a threat, both in attack and defense. With the game heading for a draw, Glen Johnson decided the contest in the 85th minute. Jordan Henderson supplied a pinpoint cross, Rickie Lambert’s header struck the bar, and Johnson reacted first to head in the rebound, sustaining a head injury in the process. Gerrard was introduced after 75 minutes but was not involved in the goal. The win was significant for Liverpool, yet Rodgers noted that the team still faced a tough road ahead. He emphasized the need for experienced players, pointing out that only Rickie Lambert among Liverpool’s recent signings started the match. The game, officiated by Craig Pawson, drew a crowd of 44,735 and highlighted resilient performances from both teams.

article_content: Student-loan borrowers are facing a host of challenges as they begin to resume repayment. The administration's top education official said Congress can help. October 1 marked the official end of pandemic relief for federal student-loan borrowers. Bills are now coming due after a pause of more than three years, and interest began to accrue again in September. This means millions of borrowers are experiencing an unprecedented transition back into repayment. It's a huge administrative task for the Education Department and federal student-loan companies. Borrowers have been experiencing consequences in the form of long wait times to reach customer service, as well as inaccurate billing statements. Education Secretary Miguel Cardona told Insider in an interview that he is aware of the challenges this transition is bringing to both borrowers and loan servicers. 'Never in our country's history have we had 26 million people start repayment at once. We're doing that now. We're in daily communication with our servicers, working closely with them,' Cardona said. 'We recognize there are bottlenecks in some areas and people are waiting excessively long. We recognize these issues and are working to make sure they improve, while also supporting our servicers who are, again, doing a task that has never been done before,' he added. One thing that Cardona said would help make the process smoother is increased funding. President Joe Biden's budget request to Congress for the upcoming fiscal year included a funding boost for Federal Student Aid to help implement the range of reforms the student-loan industry is undergoing, including the return to repayment. Cardona said, 'We're going to continue to push and fight for dollars to make sure that we have adequate resources to provide our students, our borrowers, with the support that they need out of our Federal Student Aid office.' However, with Republicans holding a majority in the House, it's unlikely they will fulfill Biden's budget request. In fact, some have recently proposed funding cuts for Federal Student Aid, and Under Secretary of Education James Kvaal previously told Insider he is concerned about the impact on borrowers from a lack of funding. 'The servicers do not have the funding that we would like to give them to better serve borrowers,' Kvaal said. However, some lawmakers do not think funding is the problem. Massachusetts Sen. Elizabeth Warren recently told Insider that servicers were paid during the pandemic even when they were not servicing millions of borrowers, which is why she believes they should be fully prepared—and funded—to ensure a smooth transition into repayment. 'For them to come in now and cry poverty because it's hard to send out accurate bills to people who owe money does not prompt much sympathy,' Warren said. 'They signed contracts to administer the loan system accurately. Those are profitable contracts. But the servicers want even more money? I have no sympathy at all.' Still, some student-loan servicers point to a lack of resources when faced with customer service complaints. The servicer MOHELA, for example, told Warren and other lawmakers in August that it expects customer service delays to extend 'well into 2024' because of insufficient funding for the industry. 'The immediate return-to-repayment amid ever-increasing changes to the contract administration requirements and expanded training needs, combined with the lack of sufficient funding from FSA, means extensive servicing delays are a likely outcome,' MOHELA said.
translated_content: Barattootni liqii barnootaa mootummaa irraa fudhatan rakkoowwan hedduu mudachaa jiru yeroo kaffaltiin liqii isaanii jalqabu. Angawaan olaanaan dhimma barnootaa mootummaa akka jedhanitti, Kongirasii ni gargaara jedhamee eegama. Onkololeessa 1, tajaajila gargaarsa weerara koronaan kenname dhumee jira. Liqiileen ammas kafalamu jalqabanii, erga ji’a sadii oliif turanii booda dabalataan faayidaan liqii dabaluu jalqabeera. Kunis, barattoota miliyoona heddu irratti jijjiirama hanga ammaa hin beekamneen gara kaffaltii deebi’uuf taasisee jira. Kun hojii olaanaa gareewwan liqii mootummaa fi Ministira Barnootaa Ameerikaa irratti ta’ee jira. Barattootni yeroo dheeraaf tajaajila maamilaa eegaa argachuuf rakkataa jiru, akkasumas gabaasa kaffaltii sirrii hin taaneef saaxilamaa jiru. Ministira Barnootaa Ameerikaa, Miguel Cardona, Insider dhaaf haasawaa taasiseen, rakkoleen yeroo kana mudatan barattoota fi tajaajiltoota liqii irratti mul’achaa jira jedhan. “Yeroo kana biyya keenya keessatti namoota miliyoona 26 walitti kaffaltii jalqabsiisuun hangii hin jirree dha. Amma kana hojjachaa jirra. Guyyaa guyyaatti tajaajiltoota keenya waliin hojjachuuf waldhabbii addaa hin qabnu,” jedhan. “Boodaan darba jira. Namoonni qilleensi dheeratu eeggachaa jiran ni jiru. Rakkoowwan kana ni beekna; fooyya’u qabna; tajaajiltoota, hojii duraanii hin jiraanne raawwatan cinaa dhaabbanna,” jedhan. Cardona akka jedhanitti, maallaqa dabalataa argachuun rakkoo kana haalaan furuu ni danda’a. Prezidaantii Joo Baayiden, waajjira Kongirasii bara baajata itti aanutti gargaarsa maallaqaa Federal Student Aid (FSA) dabaluu gaafateera. Kutaaleen liqii deebi’uu jalqabuufi jijjiirama sektara kanaa deggeruuf fedha qabu. Cardona, “Ammas fedhii fi carraaqu; maallaqa gahaa argachuuf carraaqna, barattootaaf liqii qabaniif tajaajila gaarii dhiheessuuf,” jedhan. Garuu, kana hundaaf paartiin Ripubliikaanota mana maree keessa aangoo waan qabanif, gaafii Biden fudhachuun hin hafu. Baasiin baajataa Federal Student Aid irratti hir’isuuf yaada dhiyaateera, akkasumas Itti Aanaan Ministeera Barnootaa James Kvaal, dura buummaan barattoota irra dhiibbaa uumuu isaatiif yaaddoo qabaachaan ibsaniiru. “Tajaajiltoonni liqii maallaqa nuti kennuu feenu dhabanii, liqii fudhattootaaf tajaajilaa gaarii kennu hin danda’an,” jedhan Kvaal. Garuu, miseensonni Kongirasii muraasni hanqina maallaqaa rakkoo hin jedhan. Senetaraa Massachusetts Elizabeth Warren yeroo dhihoo as Insider’f haasawaa kennanitti, tajaajiltoonni liqii yoo tajaajila hin kennineyyuu weerara keessa baasii argataniiru, kanaaf gareen liqiin deebi’uu jalqabuuf qophaawuu qabu jedhan. “Amma ‘maallaqa hin qabnu’ jechuun rakkoo akka natti hin fakkaanne. Kontraataa liqii sirnaan hojjechuun nurraa eegama. Galii argachuu qabu. Maallaqa dabalataa barbaaduun immoo narraa hanbise!” jedhan Warren. Haa ta’u malee, tajaajiltoonni liqii muraasni haala hamaa keessatti deeggarsa dhabuu qabattee dubbatan. MOHELA, tajaajiltoota keessaa tokko, Hagayya keessatti Warren fi miseensotaa biroo Kongirasii irratti ibsa kennan, tajaajila gahaa kennuuf carraan gahaa hin jiru, rakkoon tajaajilaa bara 2024’tti fufuu mala jedhe. “Deebi’ee kafaltii jalqabuun saffisa guddaa, jijjiirama gumii fi leenjiin bal’inaan guddachaa jiruu, deeggarsi gahaa FSA irraa dhufu dhabamuun, rakkoo tajaajilaa gara fulduraatti fida,” jedha MOHELA.

article_content: Workers on a construction site in Western Australia have been filmed using a crane as a makeshift carnival ride. Footage shows a tradesman wearing a harness attached to the crane, which spins and lifts him into the air. Colleagues are heard laughing and encouraging him during the dangerous stunt. In the video, the man in the harness waves at the camera and shouts 'Hi mum!' He is seen wearing a high-visibility shirt and a backwards baseball cap, apparently without a safety helmet. The worker moves his arms and strikes poses as a coworker operates the crane. At one point, someone off-camera shouts, 'Faster, Jeremy!' When the crane stops suddenly, the man swings and almost hits the crane's arm. WorkSafe has said it is aware of the video and is reviewing the incident. The footage was uploaded to LiveLeak, tagged under Western Australia, and has nearly 1600 views since being posted on Tuesday. The incident is reported to have taken place on December 17, according to Perth Now.

article_content: Former referee and Sportsmail columnist Graham Poll has expressed concern that the standard of refereeing is at its lowest level in memory. Responding to strong criticism from former Professional Game Match Officials Ltd (PGMOL) chief Keith Hackett, referee leaders maintain that officiating standards are better than ever. Hackett has called for his successor, Mike Riley, to be removed from his role at PGMOL, describing the current group of officials as 'the worst that we have seen', and citing 'over 20 major errors' during the Christmas period. Although PGMOL declined to respond directly, they shared statistics indicating standards have improved on every metric since Hackett left the organization. According to PGMOL data, the accuracy of major decisions has increased to 95 percent from 94.1 percent, with decisions in the penalty box reaching 98 percent accuracy, and offside decisions improving to 99 percent, compared to 92 percent five years ago. Hackett, who now offers refereeing kits and training through his website, singled out referees Mike Jones, Andre Marriner, Lee Mason, and Chris Foy for criticism, suggesting they should be replaced at the end of the season. He also stated that Lee Probert should lose his position if he fails a fitness test. Recent controversial refereeing decisions highlighted by Hackett include: Mike Jones awarding Liverpool two penalties for handball against Leicester City at Anfield; Lee Mason issuing only a booking to Stoke's Jon Walters for a last-man foul on Everton's Leighton Baines; Andre Marriner giving only a yellow card to Manchester City's Eliaquim Mangala for a tackle on Everton's Samuel Eto'o; and Chris Foy sending off Tottenham's Kyle Naughton for handball despite inconclusive evidence. Hackett also cited the dismissal of Wayne Routledge of Swansea City as a major error. PGMOL asserts that referee fitness has improved, particularly in terms of sprinting, and remains confident that statistics support the direction taken since Hackett's departure. Periods of controversy involving multiple refereeing decisions occur in almost every season, often leading to calls for new measures such as video replays. The International FA Board is set to discuss this at its meeting in Belfast on February 28, though any final decision may be several years away as trials are needed first.

article_content: U.S. President Barack Obama hosted French President Francois Hollande at a state dinner on Tuesday night, the first such event of Obama's second term. Held at the White House, the dinner is a prestigious occasion featuring guests from government, Hollywood, business, and the community. The invitation list included recommendations from the President and First Lady Michelle Obama, along with senior officials from the Pentagon, Congress, the Supreme Court, and the State Department. Notable guests included J.J. Abrams, Bradley Cooper, Stephen Colbert, Julia Louis-Dreyfus, CNN Worldwide President Jeff Zucker, Defense Secretary Chuck Hagel, Supreme Court Justice Elena Kagan, and Secretary of State John Kerry. Upon arrival, guests walked past cameras, with some stopping to speak with reporters. First Lady Michelle Obama wore a billowing black and blue dress by Carolina Herrera and greeted Hollande, alongside President Obama, on the White House steps. Inside, Mrs. Obama walked behind the two presidents as they descended a staircase, since Hollande attended without a plus one. The main event took place in a tent on the South Lawn, with a four-course meal including osetra caviar and quail eggs, a winter salad in a glass bowl, Colorado-raised beef, and chocolate dessert from Hawaii. The White House released details about the wines served: reds from California and Washington State, and sparkling wine from Virginia, all priced under $50 per bottle. While the dinner was festive, the White House emphasized that these events also serve a diplomatic role, allowing for exchanges of information and building connections among influential leaders. Presidents Obama and Hollande used the evening to discuss critical international issues such as the civil war in Syria, Iran’s nuclear program, and economic challenges in Europe. Hollande attended the dinner alone, following his separation from longtime partner Valerie Trierweiler, who had been regarded as France’s first lady even though they were not married. It is not unprecedented for French presidents to attend such events alone: Nicolas Sarkozy also preceded Hollande in attending a White House state dinner after a separation. Reporting by CNN’s Kevin Liptak.

article_content: Dwayne Johnson has announced he will contact a Paris art gallery after a wax figure of him unveiled at the Grevin Museum appeared with a noticeably lighter skin tone. Fans were quick to point out the discrepancy, criticizing the figure for inaccurately representing his true appearance. Sharing a video by comedian James Andre Jefferson Jr—who joked about whether the artist had even Googled him—Johnson called on the museum to update the waxwork: 'Update my wax figure with some important details, starting with my skin colour.' 'For the record, I'm going to have my team reach out to our friends at Grevin Museum,' The Rock wrote on Instagram. 'And next time I'm in Paris, I'll stop in and have a drink with myself,' he added humorously. Dwayne Johnson was born in California to a Black Nova Scotian father and a Samoan mother. His father, Wayde Douglas Bowles—known professionally as Rocky Johnson—was a wrestler and part of the first Black tag team to win a WWE championship. The Grevin Museum unveiled the wax figure on October 16. According to its website, artist Stéphane Barret created the sculpture using photos and videos of Johnson. A press release mentioned that the figure's eyes were redone three times to avoid making the star's face appear too harsh or lose its warmth. Officials from the museum told Deadline, 'Dwayne Johnson is right and we noticed it and will obviously remedy it as quickly as possible.' BBC Newsbeat, which also attempted to contact the museum, has not yet received a response. Johnson's representatives have also been approached for comment.

Fannoon si'eessa garaagaraa fi dogoggora mul’ate argaa turan, gara faallaa fakkeessicha sirriitti hin agarsiifne jechuun komatan. article_content: Parity Technologies, the creator of the Polkadot blockchain platform, has announced plans to reduce its workforce by 30%, resulting in nearly 100 employees losing their jobs. This decision comes as the company shifts its focus to advancing the technology behind Polkadot, a decentralized platform that enables cross-chain communication and data transfer. As part of this strategic move, Parity will reallocate resources to prioritize research and development, particularly in enhancing cross-chain compatibility and interoperability within Polkadot. The layoffs will mostly affect staff involved in go-to-market activities. The company believes that optimizing operations and concentrating on technological innovation will better position Polkadot for long-term growth. Parity's goal is to develop a scalable and flexible infrastructure that can adapt to a rapidly evolving market. By streamlining processes and focusing on core technology, Parity expects to improve user experience, accessibility, and create a broader positive impact for the wider blockchain community. The organization has laid out a comprehensive plan that includes strengthening Polkadot’s architecture, designing innovative solutions for cross-chain transactions, and fostering collaboration with other blockchain projects. Interoperability remains a major challenge in the blockchain industry, often leading to fragmented communities and slowed adoption of new technologies. Parity Technologies is focusing on improving cross-chain communication features to address these challenges and create a more connected blockchain ecosystem. Photo credit: Leeloo Thefirst via Pexels.

article_content: Arsene Wenger has stated that Arsenal's position at the top of the Barclays Premier League is not down to luck, following their 2-0 win over Crystal Palace. Although Arsenal might be overtaken if Manchester City beats Chelsea at the Etihad, Wenger insists his team remains serious title contenders, saying, "You cannot be lucky over 24 games. We've faced questions about our ability all season, but our position is not a coincidence." Alex Oxlade-Chamberlain scored both goals for Arsenal, and Wenger praised his versatility, expressing his belief that Oxlade-Chamberlain's future lies in central roles. Wenger stated, "He proved me right today, not just by scoring but through his overall performance." Wenger said he would closely watch the Manchester City vs. Chelsea match, as the results could affect Arsenal’s position. He also highlighted that Arsenal has gained points over rivals such as Liverpool and Manchester United and stressed the importance of their results at Emirates Stadium for the rest of the season. Wenger disclosed that new signing Kim Kallstrom completed his move on deadline day, even after a scan revealed a micro-fracture in the Swedish midfielder’s back. Spartak Moscow, Kallstrom’s former club, agreed to pay his wages for six weeks during his recovery. Wenger admitted that he considered withdrawing from the signing due to the injury but decided to proceed. Kallstrom is expected to be available to play at the end of February at the earliest.

Laafinni keenya yeroo hunda gaaffii keessa ture, garuu iddoo amma jirtu sababa carraa miti." article_content: Joe Paterno's last will and testament has been permanently sealed from public view, along with all related court records. This measure was taken at the request of a family attorney, and the judge’s order and related legal filings have also been sealed. According to county records, Paterno’s will is the only one to be sealed in the county in the past 18 months. A family spokesperson, Dan McGinn, stated that the decision was intended to preserve the family’s privacy and is not unusual for individuals in the public eye. Joe Paterno, the renowned Penn State football coach who achieved 409 victories over more than forty years, died of lung cancer in January at age 85. He passed away just months after being removed by the university’s board of trustees in the wake of child sex abuse allegations against retired assistant coach Jerry Sandusky. The sealing of Paterno’s will occurred as Sandusky’s trial was set to begin; Sandusky faces 52 counts related to child sex abuse, with a 12-member jury scheduled to hear the opening statements. On April 5, Paterno’s will entered probate, and the estate’s attorney, Raymond Parker, petitioned for the proceedings to remain confidential that same day. Four days later, a judge ordered the records sealed. Wilkes-Barre attorney Jerry Chariton commented that, while maintaining confidentiality is understandable for many families, this situation was 'very strange' and did not appear to present any unique circumstances. Court officials could not confirm which judge ordered the sealing, and both Judge Thomas Kistler and attorney Parker declined to comment. McGinn reiterated that the step was recommended by the estate attorney to protect the family’s privacy and that all parties agreed to the request. He emphasized that such requests are not uncommon for high-profile individuals. The Paterno family has been transparent about Coach Paterno’s contract and pension, and Sue Paterno remains committed to supporting charitable causes tied to Penn State and the State College community. Only the court docket sheet remains accessible as a public record, offering limited information about Paterno’s will and estate. Paterno completed his will in June 1997 and amended it in February 2010, naming his wife, Sue, as the executor. The estate paid a $200,000 inheritance tax on April 23; depending on tax rates, the taxable portion of the estate ranged from $1.35 million to $4.45 million. Other financial details include more than $3 million in salary and benefits issued by Penn State to Paterno’s estate, the university’s forgiveness of $350,000 in unspecified loans and debts, and Sue Paterno inheriting $13.4 million in pension benefits. Sue Paterno has pledged to donate $1.5 million to charity, including $500,000 to the Suzanne Pohland Paterno Catholic Student Faith Center. For years, Joe Paterno’s salary remained a private matter; it was not disclosed publicly until a 2007 court order revealed his base salary of $512,664.

article_content: James Rodriguez is reportedly close to joining Real Madrid in a transfer worth £40 million, provided the Champions League winners sell Angel Di Maria. Real Madrid is expected to complete the signing of Rodriguez after they finalize Di Maria's departure.

article_content: The board of South Korea’s Asiana Airlines has agreed to sell its cargo business, a move that aims to facilitate a proposed merger with Korean Air Lines, according to Yonhap news agency. This sale, along with the divestment of some European routes, is part of Korean Air’s strategy to obtain European Union antitrust approval for its acquisition of Asiana, South Korea’s second-largest carrier. Korean Air is expected to submit a package detailing the cargo business sale to the European Commission as early as Thursday. However, the merger still requires approval from regulators in the EU, the United States, and Japan. Asiana could not immediately be reached for comment. Creditors, including the state-run Korea Development Bank, have been seeking a new owner for the financially troubled airline for several years. Korean Air first agreed to acquire Asiana during the COVID-19 pandemic in 2020. As of the first half of 2023, Asiana operated 11 cargo planes flying 21 routes to 25 cities in 12 countries, including the United States, Germany, and Russia. The cargo division accounted for 20.7% of South Korea’s overseas cargo market. Following the announcement, Asiana shares rose 5.90%, outpacing the benchmark KOSPI’s 1.64% increase as of 0312 GMT.

article_content: Stephen Gerard Kelly and Garry Keane’s documentary 'In The Shadow of Beirut' has been selected as Ireland’s entry for the 2024 Oscar International Feature Film competition. The film, executive produced by Hillary Clinton, Chelsea Clinton, and Siobhan Sinnerton of HiddenLight Productions, was chosen on Thursday by the Irish Film & Television Academy (IFTA). Last year, IFTA selected 'The Quiet Girl,' directed by Colm Bairéad, which became the first Irish film nominated in that category. For 'In The Shadow of Beirut,' first-time filmmaker Kelly spent five years living among four families in the Sabra and Shatila neighborhoods near Beirut, capturing their lives as the area faced economic and political turmoil after the 1982 massacre. The film’s primary language is Arabic. The film was funded by Screen Ireland and ZDF/Arte. It had its world premiere in June at the Doc Edge Festival in New Zealand and also qualifies for the Oscar Feature Documentary category. Áine Moriarty, CEO of IFTA, stated, 'This is such an important film for a global audience to connect with. The raw storytelling is delivered with heart-breaking honesty. Stephen brings us up close and personal into the lives of families full of love as they try to survive, with hope and human resilience at the core.' 'In The Shadow of Beirut' is produced by Brendan J. Byrne and Myriam Sassine with Cyprus Avenue Films (Belfast), and production partners Abbout Productions (Beirut), Real Films (Ireland), and Gebrueder Beetz Filmproduktion (Berlin). Co-producers include Myriam Sassine, Christian Beetz, and Alison Toomey.

article_content: Jean Marriott, a 94-year-old from Norfolk, is still happily driving and has marked nearly 80 years at the wheel with the purchase of a brand-new Nissan Micra. Her love for motoring started back in 1934 at age 15, when her motor engineer father let her drive their Austin 12 Tourer during a vacation. The empty roads of the time and the car’s memorable registration, WW 999, left a lasting impression. Jean recalls family road trips from their Skipton home to destinations like the Lake District and Blackpool—sitting in the backseat with her younger brother, bundled up for warmth. At 17, she passed her driving test just a year after its introduction in the UK, overcoming a tricky moment with the car’s clutch thanks, in part, to her father’s friendship with the examiner. Throughout her long driving life, Jean’s record has been nearly perfect, interrupted only by a single speeding fine in her 80s for slightly exceeding the speed limit. Nowadays, she still enjoys driving to visit her daughter Barbara in Wiveton and handles her own errands in Cromer and Holt. Jean says driving gives her joy, she’s extra cautious these days, and she plans to keep driving as long as her health allows—excited, especially, to get out on the road in her new car.

article_content: CLEVELAND -- The Cleveland Museum of Art has filed a lawsuit against New York City authorities following the seizure of a headless bronze statue believed to represent the Roman emperor and philosopher Marcus Aurelius. A Manhattan judge signed a warrant on August 14 ordering the statue’s seizure. The museum, which obtained the statue in 1986, describes it as a centerpiece of its ancient Roman collection. The museum argues in its lawsuit that the statue was acquired legally and that the Manhattan District Attorney’s office, led by Alvin Bragg, lacks the legal authority to seize it. The warrant was issued as part of an ongoing investigation into an antiquities smuggling network believed to have trafficked looted items from Bubon, in southwestern Turkey, through Manhattan, according to a spokesperson from the DA’s office. The statue stands 76 inches (1.9 meters) tall, dates from A.D. 180 to 200, and is valued at $20 million. The museum’s suit, filed Thursday, requests that a judge confirm the museum as the rightful owner of the statue, which is described as 'one of the most significant works in the museum’s collection' of around 61,000 objects. According to the lawsuit, museum officials have told the DA’s office their evidence is insufficient and have proposed other investigative routes, which were declined. Experts consulted by the museum have also questioned the identification of the statue as Marcus Aurelius, suggesting it may actually portray another Greek philosopher. A spokesperson for District Attorney Bragg said the office is reviewing the lawsuit and 'will respond in court papers.' The spokesperson also noted that the office has successfully recovered more than 4,600 trafficked antiquities. Museum spokesman Todd Mesek said the museum does not comment on ongoing litigation but takes provenance issues seriously. The museum removed the statue from public view earlier this year and altered its website description. Instead of linking the figure to Marcus Aurelius, it is now listed as 'Draped Male Figure.' Turkey first raised claims about the statue in 2012, publishing a list of nearly two dozen objects in the Cleveland museum's collection that it contended were looted from Bubon and elsewhere. At the time, museum officials stated Turkey had provided no concrete evidence of looting. In recent years, the Manhattan DA's office has worked to repatriate hundreds of looted artifacts to countries including Turkey, Greece, Israel, and Italy. It is unclear who may be the focus of the current investigation involving the seized statue. Marcus Aurelius, who ruled as Roman emperor from A.D. 161 to 180, was a noted Stoic philosopher and author of 'Meditations.' The statue depicts a robed man with one hand raised in a regal gesture.

World champion boxer Amir Khan has set his sights on facing Floyd Mayweather Jr., believing a victory over the undefeated American would confirm his status as the world’s best pound-for-pound fighter. Khan, 24, unified the WBA super and IBF light-welterweight titles by defeating Zab Judah in Las Vegas. Mayweather recently returned to the ring, extending his professional record to 42-0 after a controversial win over Victor Ortiz.

While many boxing fans hope to see Mayweather fight Manny Pacquiao—widely regarded as the top pound-for-pound boxer—ongoing disagreements over drug testing and financial terms between Mayweather’s and Pacquiao’s teams have prevented the match from happening. Khan, who won a silver medal at the 2004 Athens Olympics, says both he and Pacquiao want to fight Mayweather, but the bout remains unlikely for now.

Khan aspires to be recognized as a boxing legend, motivated daily by his dream of becoming world pound-for-pound champion. In the last 18 months, Khan’s profile has grown internationally, with several fights in the United States, including his first U.S. bout against Paulie Malignaggi at Madison Square Garden in March 2010.

His prominence has extended beyond the ring; he recently met U.S. Secretary of State Hillary Clinton at an event honoring influential Muslim athletes, and he is expected to meet President Barack Obama later this year. Khan expressed pride in these honors and said he intends to make the most of these unique opportunities.

article_content: Jamie Carragher has called Newcastle United's players a 'disgrace' after their 4-0 defeat to Southampton, while Gary Neville described the squad as 'letdowns.' Newcastle fans are increasingly frustrated with manager Alan Pardew after the club's disappointing start to the season, but Carragher argues that the players are primarily to blame. Speaking on Sky Sports' Monday Night Football, Carragher commented on Newcastle’s lackluster performance at St Mary’s, saying: 'There’s a lot of talk about Alan Pardew, but some of those players are a disgrace.' Newcastle boss Alan Pardew has struggled to stop his team's poor run of results in the Premier League. Carragher and Neville believe Alan Pardew deserves more time at St James' Park, despite unrest among some supporters who displayed anti-Pardew banners and shouted abuse during the defeat. Carragher continued: 'This isn’t an end of season game—this is just four or five games into the season.' He recalled playing against some of these players toward the end of his Liverpool career when Liverpool beat Newcastle 6-0 at St James' Park, describing the current performance as shocking. 'Fans want to see players work hard and show heart and intensity,' Carragher added, noting Newcastle’s decline in recent years as a 'disgrace.' Neville shared Carragher's sentiment and stated, 'I wouldn’t want to manage those players; they’re just a letdown in my opinion.' Both pundits believe Newcastle's team should be doing more to support Alan Pardew. When asked if Pardew was being treated unfairly, Neville replied, 'I don’t think he’s getting a raw deal. He knows the job and the pressure after being here four years. Alan Pardew has experience and knows what to expect if results don’t improve.' He also said, 'It’s not all on Pardew; there are issues above him, and the club likely hasn't invested enough for its size and fan base.' Neville emphasized that several factors contribute to Newcastle’s current situation and that not all responsibility falls on Pardew. Carragher concluded that fan unrest could make Pardew’s position as manager untenable.

article_content: Firefighters in Grozny, the capital of Chechnya, managed to extinguish a large blaze early Thursday that had severely damaged the exterior of a 40-story apartment building, as reported by Russia's RIA Novosti news agency. There were no reports of deaths or injuries, but several dozen people were evacuated from the tower and adjacent buildings, according to an emergencies services spokesperson. Initial findings point to a short circuit as the likely cause of the fire. The plastic cladding on the building's facade was heavily damaged, while the building’s interior remained unharmed. Officials told CNN that nobody was living in the building at the time of the incident; it is unclear whether the evacuees were construction workers or other temporary occupants. The skyscraper, described as the tallest in Chechnya and a relatively new construction, had fire spread across most of its floors, according to a police source. Over 100 firefighters worked to bring the fire under control.

article_content: British Prime Minister David Cameron made an unannounced visit to British soldiers in Afghanistan on Thursday, just one day after announcing significant plans to reduce the UK’s military deployment in the region. According to Downing Street's official Twitter, Cameron thanked the troops and said they made the country proud. Cameron stated that UK forces in Afghanistan would be scaled down to approximately 5,200 by the end of 2013, from the current figure of about 9,500; 500 are anticipated to leave before the end of this year. Officials pointed to progress in Helmand province, with Afghan security forces now taking on greater security responsibilities, as the reason for the faster withdrawal. Cameron highlighted that although the UK came to Afghanistan to combat terrorism, the ultimate aim was always for Afghanistan to handle its own security, with a self-sufficient army and police. With training efforts succeeding, the UK is in a position to begin returning its troops home. Cameron characterized the reduction as occurring 'because of success, not failure.' Separately, France finished its removal of combat troops over the weekend, but around 1,500 French service members will remain into next year to manage equipment withdrawals and continue training Afghan forces, a French Defense Ministry spokesperson said. Britain is the second-largest contributor to NATO’s security mission in Afghanistan, mostly operating in Helmand. Since Operation Enduring Freedom began in 2001, the UK has recorded 438 military fatalities, the most of any coalition member aside from the United States. US troops are the largest contingent, with 68,000 still present in Afghanistan and 2,162 having died during the mission. The coalition continues to prepare Afghan security forces to take full control as NATO’s role in Afghanistan is set to conclude at the end of 2014. CNN correspondent Laura Smith-Spark contributed to this report.

Paris Saint-Germain’s determination paid off as the defending champions secured a deserved 1-1 draw against French league leaders Lyon on Sunday. Zlatan Ibrahimovic scored an equalizer from the penalty spot, converting on his second attempt after his initial shot was saved by Anthony Lopes but retaken due to encroachment by Lyon’s players. Ibrahimovic fired the retake powerfully into the top corner with Lopes diving in the opposite direction.

Lyon opened the scoring in the 31st minute through Cameroon striker Clinton N’Jie, who finished clinically from close range after receiving a pass from Nabil Fekir. PSG came close several times, but Lyon goalkeeper Anthony Lopes made a string of outstanding saves, including notable stops from Edinson Cavani and two strong headers from Ibrahimovic.

The match saw intense action. In the first half, Lyon’s Corentin Tolisso rattled PSG keeper Salvatore Sirigu’s post from 25 meters, while PSG’s David Luiz headed wide from close range after a Cavani flick. Blaise Matuidi also sent a shot over the bar just before halftime.

PSG pressed relentlessly in the second half. Their persistence was rewarded in the 66th minute when Marco Verratti won a penalty after being challenged by defender Lindsay Rose. Though Lopes saved Ibrahimovic’s first attempt, referee Clement Turpin ordered a retake for encroachment. Ibrahimovic then made no mistake, bringing PSG level. The result keeps Lyon two points ahead of both Marseille and PSG at the top of the standings.
