Ian Lynch, a member of the band Lankum, hosts 'Fire Draw Near,' a monthly podcast dedicated to the history and stories behind Irish folk songs. In each episode, Lynch delves into a particular folk song, exploring its narrative, origins, and the various interpretations and versions that have emerged over time. Many of these songs originated in oral tradition, passed from person to person—often in pubs, where much of the world’s oldest popular music began. Over time, some songs were committed to print in the form of broadsides, which circulated widely and were adapted by singers across the country. While certain songs became standardized in print, others continued to evolve orally, leading to notable changes in lyrics and morals before eventually being recorded.

'Fire Draw Near' highlights the complexity of how oral tradition intersects with the printed word, revealing rich layers of beauty and history in these evolving tunes. Topics within the songs range from warnings about deceitful lovers, tales of scorned romances, unorthodox unions, and sensational stories reminiscent of old tabloid tales. The podcast examines the many versions of each song, noting how interpretations can diverge dramatically—from somber, funeral-like renditions to lively, raucous drinking songs—sometimes making it hard to recognize they share the same origins. The show catalogs a range of performances including field recordings, acoustic sets, and psychedelic folk revivals.

Lankum themselves often perform these traditional songs in the style of a funeral dirge. For example, compare their version of 'Wild Rover' with that of The Dubliners: while The Dubliners tell the raucous tale of a pub regular recounting his drinking exploits, Lankum’s take transforms the same lyrics into a mournful lament on the curse of alcohol. Despite similar lyrics, the emotional tone is entirely different. As a fan of elegiac music, I find Lankum’s sound especially powerful, reflecting their deep historical appreciation for the genre—a quality evident even without prior knowledge. You can listen to 'Fire Draw Near' on Spotify or SoundCloud.

Kutaa keessa kanatti, Lynch sirba aadaa tokko filatee, seenaa isaa, maddaa fi garaagaraa ilaalcha sirboonni sun qabatan qorata. Sirboonni baay'een isaanii seenaaf afaaniin dulloomanii gara namarraa namaatti, yeroo baay’ee manneen dhugaatii keessa dabarfamanii jiru. Sirboonni muraasni yeroo dheertuuf afaaniin dabarfamaa turanii, yeroo booda barruu broadsides jedhamanii bakka gara garaatti fassilamu. Karaa birootiin, sirboonni kanneen garaagaraa ta’anii, hiikkaa fi gatii isaanii wal-dhiibee gara garaatti geeddarama. Gochi aadaa afaanii gara barruu geeddarumaan wal-simuun isaa hegeree faa’aa fi badhaadhina qaba, wanti kunis sirboota keessa tolaan mul’ata. Mata dureewwan sirbootaa keessaa, akeekkachiisa dubartoota hin amannee, jaalatamtota mufatanii, walitti dhufeenya hin eebbifamnee fi oduun yeroowwan darbanirratti xiyyeeffatan ni jiru.

'Fire Draw Near' sirboota garaagaraa fi hiikkaa isaanii walbira qabee ilaala; hiikkaa tokko gara gaddaa fi rifaasatti ta’uun yoo ta’u, tokko garuu gootummaan keessattuu dhugaatii waliin wal-qabatee haala gammachuu ibsuu danda’a. Sirboonni aadaa fi jijjiirama yeroo garaa garaa keessa darban – fakkeenyaaf, reekordii fieldii, setii akustuikii fi bosona folk haaraa – bakka bu'aa paadiikaastiichatti galmaa’u.

Lankum mataan isaanii dhugoomsaan sirboota kana gara modaa fi gowwummaa du'aa fakkaataniin dhiyeessu. Fkn, 'Wild Rover' Lankum fi The Dubliners irraa walbira qabda: The Dubliners dhugaa waliin tapha gammachuu ibsuun hikuu isaanii, Lankum garuu jechoota wal fakkaatan gara gadda alkolii fi dheekkamsaatti jijjiira. Jechoonni isaanii wal-fakkaatu ta’uus, hiikkaa fi qajeelfamni isaanii garagara. Lankum sagaleen isaanii seenaa fi hibboo sirboota kanaaf qaama guddaa qaba – kana paadiikaastiin hubachuun ni danda’ama. 'Fire Draw Near' Spotify yookiin SoundCloud irratti ni dhaggeeffachuu dandeessu.

article_content: The United States will supply $553 million to finance a new terminal at Colombo’s port in Sri Lanka, in partnership with Indian billionaire Gautam Adani’s group. Through its International Development Finance Corporation (DFC), this marks the agency’s largest infrastructure project in Asia and is part of a broader effort to boost Sri Lanka’s economy while reducing China’s influence in South Asia. The funding is aimed at promoting economic development in Sri Lanka and strengthening trade integration, especially with India—a key partner for both Sri Lanka and the US. DFC will work with John Keells Holdings Plc and Adani Ports & Special Economic Zone Ltd., using their regional know-how and standards for quality. China has emerged as Sri Lanka’s main foreign investor, with around $2.2 billion invested in the country’s infrastructure by last year. US officials have criticized projects like the Chinese-funded Hambantota port, describing them as unsustainable and an example of 'debt-trap diplomacy.' Following last year’s economic crisis, which left Sri Lanka heavily indebted to Beijing, the US aims to help Sri Lanka’s recovery without increasing its debt. The DFC says all projects are carefully vetted. Given its position along vital international shipping routes, Colombo’s port handles nearly half of all container traffic in the area and has run at over 90% capacity for two years, highlighting the need for added capabilities. The Adani Group, the majority owner of the new terminal, faces ongoing scrutiny and fraud allegations, all of which the company denies. Some local politicians have questioned the transparency of the project, but Adani insists its investments support Sri Lanka’s development. US officials view this initiative as a demonstration of renewed participation in Indo-Pacific growth and as an alternative to China’s Belt and Road Initiative. AidData Institute reports the DFC has expanded its international investments in recent years. Scott Nathan, the DFC’s CEO, stated that the goal is to support Sri Lanka’s prosperity and reinforce alliances across the region, without increasing the country’s sovereign debt.
translated_content: Yunaayitid Isteetis doolaara miiliyoona 553 fiigii maallaqaa, garee Adani kan Indiyaan hoogganamu waliin, buufata doonii haarawaa Kolomboo, Siri Lanka keessatti ijaaruuf dirqama fudhate. Deeggarsi kun kan Dhaabbata Misoomaa Faayinaansii Yunaayitid Isteetis (DFC) irraa dhufe yoo ta’u, inni projektii ijaarsaa Asia keessatti taasifamu keessaa isa guddaa dha. Maallaqni kun dabalataan diinagdee Siri Lanka cimsuu fi dhiibbaa Chaayinaa gara naannoo sanaatti hir’isuuf oola. Kaayyoon maallaqaa kanaa diinagdee Siri Lanka guddisuu fi waliin daldalaa, adda durummaan Indiyaa waliin, cimsuuf. DFC’n John Keells Holdings Plc fi Adani Ports & Special Economic Zone Ltd waliin hojii gaggeessa, tartiibota hojii sadarkaa biyya isaanii fayyadamu. Chaayinaan doolaara biliyoona 2.2 bu’uuraalee misoomaa Siri Lanka keessa bara dabre qofa galchuun, biyya alaa keessaa kan maallaqa guddaa biyya kanaa jirtu taatee jirti. Hojjettoonni mootumma US proojektoota akka buufata doonii Hambantota Chaayinaa deeggarame ‘debt-trap diplomacy’ jedhanii qeequ. Mudannoo rakkoo diinagdee waggaa darbeen, kan Siri Lanka liqii guddaa Chaayinaa jala gale, Yunaayitid Isteetis guddina biyya kanaa dagaagsuuf deeggarsa laachuun liqii dabalataa jalaa baasuu barbaaddi. DFC’n hojiiwwan hunda irratti qorannoo ulfaataa taasisa jedha. Buufati Kolomboo iddoo geejjiba doonii addunyaa irratti argamuun, kontaayineriwwan naannoo sanarra darbaniif harki caalu keessa darbaa jira; waggaa lamaaf 90% ol fayyadamaa tureet, guyyaa guyyaatti baay’ina isaa dabaluun barbaachisaa ta’e jira. Gareen Adani kan harka caalaa isaa buufata kana qabu, shakkamtoota fi himatamoota dhara maallaqa irratti hundaawaa jira; gareen sun himannaa kana hunda ni haala. Hoggantoonni siyaasaa biyya keessaas iftoomina irratti yaadannoo qaban; Adani immoo gargaarsa isaanii faayidaa Sirii Lankaaf jedhani. US’n karoorri kun dandeettii misoomaa Indo-Pacific keessatti fiigii haarawaa taasisuu fi madda walhormaataa Belt and Road Initiative Chaayinaa irratti hudha kennuuf akka deemu tilmaaman. AidData Institute gabaasee DFC faayinaansii addunyaa irratti hojii isaa guddisuudhaaf jabaatee hojjataa jira jedhe. Scott Nathan, DFC’n CEO’n isaas iddoowwan kun injifannoo Siri Lankaaf fiduu fi dabalataan walitti dhufeenya biyyaalee isaanii cimsuu dandeessisa malee liqii dabalataa hin uumu jedhan.

article_content: The rise of picture-sharing on social media platforms like Twitter, Facebook, and Instagram has increased the pressure to look good online. Celebrities such as Kim Kardashian and Rosie Huntington-Whiteley frequently post polished 'selfies', making online appearance feel more important than ever. Now, a photo-editing app called Facetune is helping image-conscious users enhance their looks, becoming a best-seller as a result. Facetune is a £1.99 photo editing app that allows users to retouch portrait photographs for a 'perfect' look. The app provides tools to remove blemishes, improve skin texture, enhance eyes, fix gray hair, reshape faces, and conceal bald patches. It also whitens teeth, smooths out wrinkles, and can alter face shape. Retouched photos can be instantly shared to Facebook, Instagram, Twitter, Flickr, Tumblr, or sent by email. Most Facetune tools are simple to use: users can zoom, pan, and apply effects with their fingers. According to Zeev Farbman, CEO of Lightricks, 'Facetune is different: it lets anyone achieve high-end, realistic results similar to professional Photoshop editing on a desktop.' He added that the team used their academic background to integrate advanced technology into the app in an accessible way. The app’s popularity suggests many people want to improve their online images—it is currently the third most popular app on iTunes, behind WhatsApp and Catchphrase. User reviews are extremely positive, describing Facetune as an 'amazing' and 'must-have' app.

Appiin kun boba’aa balleessuu, gogaa suuraa bareechisuu, ija ifoomsuu, rifeensa gurraacha gochuu, fuula halluu jijjiiruu, fi barcuma bal’isuuf ni fayyada. Akkasumas ilkaan addeessu, rukoota gogaa qaxxamuraa fooyyeessu, fi fuula gabaabsuu/dheeressu danda’a. Meeshalee Facetune hedduun salphatti fayyadamuun ni danda’ama: fayyadamtoonni suura zoom, panii fi harka isaanii fayyadamuun saxaxaa irratti hojjachuu ni danda’u. Akkasumas, gareen isaanii qorannoo barnootaa ol’aanaa irraa ka’uun, teknoolojii ammayyaa gara appichaatti foyyeessuudhaan hojii salphaa ta’e godhaniiru. Appii kun beekamtii guddaa argachuun namoonni hedduun suura isaanii marsariitiirratti fooyyeessuuf fedhii qaban agarsiisa — amma iTunes irratti appii sadaffaa beekamaa, WhatsApp fi Catchphrase booda ta’ee jira.
